title: VP of Quality
description:
**About Lumilens**

At Lumilens we are building the critical photonics infrastructure that powers tomorrow’s AI supercomputing. From chip-to-chip optical interconnects to scalable photonic engines, Lumilens is unlocking a new era of computing - faster, cooler, and massively more efficient.

We’re a well-funded startup backed by Mayfield and led by veterans who’ve built and scaled some of the most transformative technologies in the industry. At Lumilens, we’re developing high-speed photonics products purpose-built to power the future of AI infrastructure and high-performance computing.

This isn’t incremental innovation, it’s a ground-floor opportunity to rethink the optical layer from the silicon up. You’ll work alongside a team of world-class engineers solving some of the hardest challenges in scaling optical systems. Every line of code, every design decision, every breakthrough you help deliver will shape the infrastructure of tomorrow.

If you're looking for mission, momentum, and the chance to make an outsized impact, jump on the rocket ship. We’re just getting started.

**About the role**

We are looking for a VP of Quality to build and lead Lumilens' global quality and reliability organization as we scale our optical interconnect products, including 800G/1.6T pluggable transceivers, near-package optics, and co-packaged optics, from qualification to high-volume production for hyperscale data center customers. You will own quality end to end, from design and suppliers through manufacturing, customer qualification, and field performance, and you will be the company's quality voice with our most demanding customers. This is a senior leadership role that partners closely with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Sales, and reports to executive leadership.

**Responsibilities**

* Define the quality and reliability strategy for Lumilens, and grow and lead a high-performing team spanning quality engineering, reliability engineering, supplier quality, customer quality, and quality management systems.
* Establish and scale a Quality Management System (QMS) certified to ISO 9001, including document control, change management, internal and external audits, and quarterly business reviews for our own sites and our contract manufacturing and OSAT partners.
* Own product reliability and qualification for lasers, photonic integrated circuits (PICs), and optical modules, including test strategy aligned with Telcordia GR-468, JEDEC, and customer-specific requirements (e.g., HTOL, damp heat, temperature cycling, accelerated aging, storage), reliability modeling (FIT rates, wear-out, MTTF), and ongoing reliability testing (ORT).
* Serve as the primary quality interface for hyperscaler and OEM customers. Lead customer qualifications, audits, and quality agreements, and own quality scorecards, RMAs, and 8D corrective action responses within committed timelines.
* Build a supplier quality program for critical components, including lasers, PICs, DSPs, optics, substrates, fiber array units, etc. Partner with contract manufacturers and OSATs to meet our corporate quality standards.
* Embed quality into our new product introduction (NPI) process: Partner with Engineering on DFMEA/PFMEA, design reviews, control plans, and phase-gate exit criteria to ensure products are designed for reliability and manufacturability.
* Drive manufacturing quality through the production ramp: set and achieve DPPM, yield, and outgoing quality targets, and deploy SPC, process capability (Cpk), test coverage, and containment practices.
* Build failure analysis (FA) capabilities for optical, electrical, and materials analysis, in-house and with external labs, to drive fast and rigorous root-cause analysis.
* Implement quality data systems and end-to-end traceability (serial- and lot-level, integrated with MES and test data) to provide early warning of yield, reliability, and field issues.
* Monitor field performance of deployed products in customer data centers, and lead escalations, containment, and corrective actions when issues arise.
* Ensure compliance with relevant standards and regulations, including ESD control (ANSI/ESD S20.20), cleanroom and contamination control, laser safety (IEC 60825-1), and environmental requirements (RoHS, REACH, conflict minerals).
* Report quality KPIs and cost of quality to the executive team and Board, and build a culture of continuous improvement, data-driven decision making, and ownership of quality across the company.
* Lead quality across multiple sites and regions, including manufacturing operations and partners in Asia.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of experience in quality and reliability for optical, photonics, or semiconductor hardware, including at least 5 years leading quality organizations at Director or VP level.
* Proven track record of taking products from NPI to high-volume production, ideally for transceiver, hyperscale data center or major networking OEM customers.
* Deep expertise in optoelectronic reliability and qualification and in failure mechanisms of lasers, PICs, and optical packaging.
* Experience building or scaling an ISO 9001 QMS, and leading customer and third-party audits.
* Strong supplier quality experience with contract manufacturers and OSATs, particularly in Asia.
* Strong command of statistical and quality methods. Six Sigma Black Belt or ASQ CQE/CRE certification is a plus.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work under pressure in customer escalations and to influence across Engineering, Operations, and leadership.
* Bachelor's degree in Quality Management, Supply Chain, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Optics, Materials Science, or a related field. Master's or PhD preferred.
* A builder's mindset suited to a fast-scaling startup, and willingness to travel internationally to sites, suppliers, and customers.

title: Account assistant-bookkeeping and supplier payments
description:
Full-Time Accounts Assistant – Bookkeeping & Supplier Payments
  
  
S$2,170 gross per month · Full-time · Primarily work from home, with one restaurant visit per week
  
  
We’re hiring an Accounts Assistant to keep our restaurant’s books up to date, prepare monthly supplier payments for approval and report on the business’s financial performance.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
Visit the restaurant once a week to collect supplier invoices, credit notes and supporting documents.
  
  
Record invoices, reconcile supplier statements and follow up on missing documents, discrepancies and outstanding credits.
  
  
Prepare the monthly supplier payment list and payment vouchers with supporting invoices.
  
  
Enter draft payments in the company’s online banking portal and submit them with the vouchers to the Director for approval. The Director approves and releases payments.
  
  
Record completed payments and file vouchers and payment confirmations.
  
  
Reconcile weekly POS sales against cash deposits, card settlements and delivery-platform payouts, where applicable.
  
  
Prepare a simple monthly
  
  
profit and loss report
  
  
showing sales, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses and net profit or loss. Highlight significant changes from the previous month, including changes in food cost as a percentage of sales.
  
  
What we’re looking for
  
  
Experience in bookkeeping or accounts payable, including supplier reconciliations and payment vouchers.
  
  
Comfortable using accounting software, Excel or Google Sheets, and an online banking portal to prepare draft payments.
  
  
Able to prepare a basic monthly P&L, work independently and meet deadlines.
  
  
Careful with figures and confidential financial information.
  
  
Restaurant or F&B accounting experience is an advantage.
  
  
Apply through MyCareersFuture
  
  
with your CV and a brief summary of your experience with bookkeeping, supplier payments and monthly reporting.

title: Head of Regional HR and AI Transformation
description:
Leads the regional human-resources function for Axclusive Pte. Ltd. and its affiliated entities in Singapore, Malaysia and Vietnam (200+ staff): organisation design, workforce planning, compensation and benefits, performance management, senior and specialist hiring, HR policy and employment compliance in each jurisdiction. Concurrently owns the group's AI transformation programme: redesigning roles and operating models for an AI-native way of working (Year 1: the 150-person Vietnam engineering team), deploying AI-enabled workflows for reporting, customer success and HR operations, building heads-of-department capability, and establishing AI governance (data protection, model-usage policy, human oversight). Member of the leadership team; reports to the Managing Director; owns the HR and transformation budgets. Requires 15+ years of HR leadership, regional Southeast Asian experience, SHRM-SCP/SPHRi certification, proven AI-transformation delivery, and professional fluency in English and Mandarin.
  
  
Must-have
  
  

* At least 15 years of human-resources experience, including 5 or more years leading an HR function as head of department or above.
* Regional Southeast Asian experience across at least two of Singapore, Malaysia and Vietnam, including cross-border compensation and employment-law compliance.
* Senior HR professional certification: SHRM-SCP (Society for Human Resource Management) and/or SPHRi (HR Certification Institute).
* Demonstrated delivery of AI or automation transformation inside an operating business —operating-model redesign, workflow automation with large-language-model tools, and governance — not advisory slideware alone.
* Experience advising founders, boards or listed-company management on organisation and compensation decisions.
* Professional fluency in English and Mandarin (working language with Taiwan, Malaysia and Vietnam leadership); Bahasa Malaysia an advantage.
* Willingness to be based in Singapore and to travel regionally.

Good-to-have
  
  

* Experience in fintech, digital platforms or other high-volume technology businesses.
* Accredited trainer status (e.g. HRD Corp) and a coaching or mentoring certification.
* Hands-on exposure to an AI vendor partner programme (e.g. Anthropic Claude Partner Network)and to building AI agents or skills for business workflows.
* Postgraduate qualification in management psychology, organisational behaviour or a related field.

Axclusive is a Singapore-based telecommunications and managed services provider, delivering enterprise connectivity, network infrastructure, data centre solutions and IT managed services. With a growing international network presence, we help businesses stay connected through reliable, scalable and innovative technology solutions.

title: Director of Business Development Acquisitions and Integration
description:
The opportunity
  
  
LinkEdge is a Singapore distribution business serving consumer brands across retail and trade channels. We plan to expand into Malaysia and explore company acquisitions in Singapore and Malaysia. This role will establish and develop those initiatives while leading the commercial and operational performance of our existing Singapore business.
  
  
Reporting to the CEO, you will develop new principal partnerships, evaluate market entry and acquisition opportunities, and plan the integration of approved businesses and portfolios. You will also remain accountable for Singapore revenue, margins, operating profit, working capital and service, working closely with Finance, HR and specialist advisers.
  
  
Business development acquisitions and integration
  
  
·
  
  
Develop regional business.
  
  
Develop opportunities for new principal partnerships, distribution mandates, categories and channels. Build the Malaysia market entry strategy, assess routes to market and potential partners, and recommend a phased plan to the CEO.
  
  
·
  
  
Build an acquisition pipeline.
  
  
Establish acquisition criteria and identify potential companies in Singapore and Malaysia. Assess strategic fit, commercial potential and operating capability, and prepare initial recommendations for further evaluation.
  
  
·
  
  
Evaluate opportunities.
  
  
Coordinate commercial and operational due diligence with Finance, legal and other advisers. Assess valuation assumptions, working capital, investment needs, risks and potential benefits. Support negotiations and prepare business cases for the company's investment approval process.
  
  
·
  
  
Plan and lead integration.
  
  
Create onboarding plans for new principal portfolios and integration plans for proposed acquisitions. Lead implementation after the necessary approvals and transaction completion, covering people, customers, stock, systems, supply chain and service continuity.
  
  
·
  
  
Strengthen partnerships.
  
  
Lead joint plans and business reviews with principals and key customers. Work with the CEO on strategic relationships and major negotiations, and translate approved commitments into disciplined execution.
  
  
Commercial and operational leadership
  
  
·
  
  
Own Singapore business performance.
  
  
Lead annual plans, budgets and reviews for existing and new Singapore portfolios. Manage revenue, margins, operating costs and profitability, and take timely corrective action.
  
  
·
  
  
Deliver reliable execution.
  
  
Lead commercial, trade marketing, retail operations, supply chain and IT/data teams. Improve forecasting, inventory availability, order fulfilment, warehousing and delivery performance through coordinated planning.
  
  
·
  
  
Build a scalable organisation.
  
  
Develop accountable leaders and clear decision rights. Create repeatable onboarding processes and shared capabilities so new portfolios can be added efficiently, with dedicated resources where commercially necessary.
  
  
·
  
  
Improve decisions and productivity.
  
  
Use business analytics, dashboards, process simplification and automation to improve visibility and reduce cost to serve. Partner with Finance on working capital, controls and business performance, and with HR on capability, succession and workforce planning.
  
  
·
  
  
Maintain commercial discipline.
  
  
Protect confidential information and manage competing portfolio interests. Maintain governance, safety and service standards. Keep commercial commitments within delegated authority; acquisition and investment decisions require the relevant CEO or Board approvals.
  
  
Experience and capabilities
  
  

* At least 15 years of relevant experience in FMCG, FMEG, consumer products or distribution, including at least 5 years in senior leadership with profit and loss accountability and responsibility across multiple functions.
* A record of profitable growth, developing principal or customer partnerships, and launching or integrating new portfolios. Experience evaluating acquisitions, coordinating due diligence or integrating acquired businesses is an advantage.
* Strong understanding of Singapore distribution channels and practical supply chain and retail execution experience. Knowledge of Malaysia distribution markets and market entry planning is an advantage.
* Sound commercial judgement and financial capability, including margins, trade investment, budgeting, inventory, receivables and working capital.
* Clear leadership communication, effective negotiation and the ability to develop managers, align teams and lead change in a growing business.
* A degree in business, management or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

What success looks like
  
  
Profitable Singapore performance; a credible Malaysia expansion plan; a qualified opportunity pipeline and sound investment recommendations; successful launches and integration of approved opportunities; dependable service; and stronger teams, working capital and productivity.
  
  
Please apply through MyCareersFuture with your CV and examples of relevant business development, operational leadership and integration experience.
  
  
LinkEdge International Pte Ltd
  
  
Where FMCG and FMEG careers accelerate.
  
  
LinkEdge International is one of Singapore's fastest-growing Go-To-Market distribution companies. We partner with world-class global FMCG and FMEG brands to deliver end-to-end distribution — retail sales, e-commerce, warehousing, transportation, merchandising and trade marketing — across 2,300+ outlets in five channels: Modern Trade, General Trade, Food Service, Specialty and eCommerce.
  
  
Founded in 2018 and led by veterans of leading multinationals, we combine MNC-grade discipline with entrepreneurial speed. Our data-driven approach to retail execution sets us apart in the market — and our people are the ones who bring it to life every day.
  
  
Why join LinkEdge?
  
  
Work with iconic brands.
  
  
Represent some of the world's most trusted FMCG and FMEG names in one of Asia's most competitive markets.
  
  
Grow faster.
  
  
In a lean, high-performance team of 130+, you'll take real ownership early — no waiting years for responsibility.
  
  
Learn from the best.
  
  
Our leadership brings decades of experience from top global companies, and we invest in developing every team member.
  
  
Be part of the growth story.
  
  
We're scaling rapidly, adding new brands, channels and capabilities — and creating new opportunities for our people as we grow.
  
  
If you're ambitious, hands-on and passionate about winning at retail, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Join us. Let's build the future of Go-To-Market distribution together.

title: Sales Director, Japan & Korea Market, CreditSights, Singapore based
description:
**Job Description**  
  
**CreditSights is currently seeking a** **Sales Director/Account Manager - Japan & Korea (Based in Singapore | Hybrid) .** **Please understand that fluent in Japanese is required for this role (business level and above).**  
  
CreditSights is the world's leading independent credit research firm, relied on by over 1,000 institutional clients globally to make prudent, profitable investment decisions in the global markets. Our exceptional team includes nearly 100 analysts with deep experience, allowing us to provide a unique micro-to-macro perspective across 35 industries in a way our clients could never achieve on their own.
  
  
CreditSights provides unparalleled credit intelligence and tools supporting our clients' growth, efficiency, and risk management objectives. We provide business leaders with the knowledge to confidently navigate an evolving marketplace.
  
  
CreditSights is a Fitch Solutions Company and part of Fitch Group.
  
  
**How You'll Make an Impact:**  
  
This is a hybrid sales role combining **account management** of an existing book of business with **new logo acquisition** across the Japan and Korea markets. You will bring a "hunter" mindset-identifying, qualifying, and closing opportunities-while also deepening relationships within existing accounts to ensure retention and expansion. This role is central to driving CreditSights' growth engine in two of our most strategically important markets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Account Management**

* Manage and grow an existing book of business, working closely with Client Success Managers, product specialists, and fellow account managers to deliver a coordinated client experience.
* Drive company revenue growth while maximizing client value and embedding CreditSights into clients' workflows.

**New Business Acquisition**

* Identify and engage prospective clients across Banks, Insurers, Private Wealth, Hedge Funds, and Asset Managers.
* Develop and execute business development strategies targeting both greenspace (new logos) and whitespace (expansion within existing accounts) opportunities.
* Build and maintain a robust, well-qualified sales pipeline.

**Market Outreach & Strategy**

* Design and execute market outreach programs aligned with regional strategic priorities.
* Partner with the market development team and senior management to identify and cultivate emerging market opportunities.
* Expand your professional network through industry associations, relevant forums, and close collaboration with Marketing.

**Sales Process Management**

* Source leads, progress opportunities, and maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all sales activity and client interactions in the CRM.
* Continuously uncover new business opportunities within existing accounts across all CreditSights service lines.
* Own the full sales cycle, from initial engagement through to closed-won.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**

* 8+ years of experience in customer-facing, quota-carrying sales, account management, or relationship management roles-ideally within data, financial information vendors, banking, or broker/dealer environments.
* Strong understanding of the Asia Pacific financial markets landscape, particularly credit markets.
* Demonstrated ability to articulate and position the value of CreditSights' content and products to solve clients' key business challenges.
* A proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas.
* Strong relationship-building and client management skills, with the ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder accounts.
* Comfort collaborating cross-functionally with senior management and internal teams.
* A self-starter mentality with a hands-on approach, well-suited to a growth-phase business.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Excellent written and verbal English.
* **Fluent Japanese is required** (business level or above).
* Willingness to be based in Singapore with frequent travel to Japan and Korea.

**What Would Make You Stand Out**

* A growth-oriented mindset and entrepreneurial drive.
* Experience within DCM, fixed income, or credit investment functions.
* Fluency in Korean.
* A consistently strong sales track record, evidenced by quota attainment history.
* Comfort and fluency using AI tools to enhance productivity and client engagement.

**Why Choose Fitch**

* **Hybrid Work Environment** : 3 days a week in office, based on your line of business and location.
* **A Culture of Learning & Mobility** : Dedicated training, leadership development, and mentorship programs to support continuous growth.
* **Investing in Your Future** : Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs to help you achieve short- and long-term goals.
* **Promoting Health & Wellbeing** : Comprehensive healthcare offerings supporting physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing.
* **Supportive Parenting Policies** : Family-friendly policies, including generous global parental leave, to help balance career and family life.
* **Inclusive Work Environment** : A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, supported by Employee Resource Groups worldwide.
* **Dedication to Giving Back** : Paid volunteer days and matched funding for charitable donations.

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day-supporting smarter decision-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We're looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment-or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.
  
  
Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch's credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest.

title: GENERAL DIRECTOR
description:
百铺乐现招聘一名经验丰富的餐饮总经理,全面负责餐厅的经营管理、业务发展、财务表现及团队建设。该职位需要制定并执行经营策略,优化日常运营流程,提升服务质量及盈利能力,确保餐厅持续稳定发展。
  
  
Baipule is seeking an experienced General Manager to oversee the restaurant's overall business operations, strategic development, financial performance and team management. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing business strategies, improving operational efficiency, enhancing service standards and profitability, and ensuring sustainable business growth.
  
  
Key Responsibilities / 主要工作职责
  
  
1. 整体经营与战略管理 / Business Operations & Strategic Management
  
  
负责餐厅整体经营管理,制定年度经营计划、业务目标及发展策略。
  
  
Oversee overall restaurant operations and develop annual business plans, operational objectives and growth strategies.
  
  
监督经营绩效,分析营业收入、成本结构及市场趋势,制定改善方案。
  
  
Monitor business performance, analyse revenue, cost structures and market trends, and implement improvement initiatives.
  
  
评估业务发展机会,推动品牌推广、市场拓展及长期业务增长。
  
  
Evaluate business development opportunities and drive brand promotion, market expansion and long-term business growth.
  
  
2. 财务与成本控制 / Financial Management & Cost Control
  
  
制定及监督餐厅运营预算,管理营业收入、采购成本、人力成本及日常营运开支。
  
  
Develop and oversee operational budgets, including revenue, procurement costs, manpower expenses and daily operating expenditures.
  
  
定期分析财务及经营报告,提出提高盈利能力及成本效益的改善措施。
  
  
Review financial and operational reports regularly and recommend measures to improve profitability and cost efficiency.
  
  
监督供应商合作及采购管理,确保采购成本合理、供应稳定及产品质量符合要求。
  
  
Oversee supplier relationships and procurement activities to ensure cost efficiency, supply continuity and product quality.
  
  
3. 团队管理与人力资源规划 / Team Leadership & Human Resource Planning
  
  
领导及管理餐厅前厅与后厨团队,明确各岗位职责及工作绩效标准。
  
  
Lead and manage front-of-house and kitchen teams, establishing clear responsibilities and performance standards.
  
  
负责员工招聘规划、培训、绩效评估及团队发展,提升整体工作效率。
  
  
Oversee manpower planning, recruitment, training, performance evaluation and team development to improve overall productivity.
  
  
建立良好的内部沟通及团队合作机制,确保餐厅各部门协调运作。
  
  
Foster effective internal communication and teamwork to ensure smooth coordination across restaurant functions.
  
  
4. 服务品质与运营管理 / Service Quality & Operational Excellence
  
  
监督餐厅日常运营,确保服务流程、食品品质及顾客体验符合公司标准。
  
  
Oversee daily restaurant operations to ensure service procedures, food quality and customer experience meet company standards.
  
  
建立及优化标准操作流程(SOP),提升运营效率及服务一致性。
  
  
Develop and improve standard operating procedures (SOPs) to enhance operational efficiency and service consistency.
  
  
处理重大顾客反馈及运营问题,推动服务改善并维护餐厅品牌声誉。
  
  
Manage significant customer feedback and operational issues, implement service improvements and maintain the restaurant's brand reputation.
  
  
5. 合规管理与风险控制 / Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management
  
  
确保餐厅运营符合新加坡相关食品安全、卫生、消防、工作场所安全及雇佣法规要求。
  
  
Ensure restaurant operations comply with applicable Singapore food safety, hygiene, fire safety, workplace safety and employment regulations.
  
  
监督相关营业执照、监管要求及内部合规程序的执行情况。
  
  
Oversee compliance with applicable business licensing requirements, regulatory obligations and internal procedures.
  
  
识别及管理运营风险,建立适当的预防措施及应急处理机制。
  
  
Identify and manage operational risks, and establish appropriate preventive measures and contingency procedures.
  
  
Job Requirements / 任职要求
  
  
具备工商管理、酒店管理、餐饮管理或相关领域的文凭、学位或同等专业经验。
  
  
Diploma or degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Food & Beverage Management or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  
  
具备至少5年餐饮、酒店或相关服务行业管理经验,其中包括团队领导或高级运营管理经验。
  
  
Minimum 5 years of management experience in the food and beverage, hospitality or related service industry, including team leadership or senior operational management experience.
  
  
熟悉餐饮企业运营管理、财务预算、成本控制及人员管理。
  
  
Strong knowledge of F&B operations, financial budgeting, cost control and manpower management.
  
  
具备良好的领导能力、沟通协调能力、商业判断力及问题解决能力。
  
  
Strong leadership, communication, coordination, commercial judgement and problem-solving skills.
  
  
了解新加坡餐饮行业相关法规、食品卫生标准及工作场所安全要求。
  
  
Knowledge of relevant Singapore F&B regulations, food hygiene standards and workplace safety requirements.
  
  
能够独立制定经营计划、监督执行进度,并对整体经营表现负责。
  
  
Ability to independently develop business plans, monitor implementation and take accountability for overall business performance.
  
  
能够根据餐厅运营需要,灵活安排工作时间,包括必要的周末及公共假期。
  
  
Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and public holidays when required by business operations.
  
  
BAIPULE PTE. LTD.
  
  
operates
  
  
Baipule Korean-Chinese BBQ (百铺乐烤串)
  
  
, a casual dining restaurant located at 44 Mosque Street in Singapore’s Chinatown.
  
  
We specialise in Korean-Chinese style barbecue and grilled skewers, offering a variety of freshly prepared meats, skewers, cold dishes and other Asian-inspired dishes in a lively and welcoming dining environment.
  
  
At Baipule, we believe that good food goes together with good service. Our front-of-house and kitchen teams work closely together to provide customers with an enjoyable dining experience.
  
  
As our business continues to grow, we welcome motivated and responsible individuals to join our team. We value teamwork, a positive working attitude, good customer service, food quality, hygiene and workplace safety.
  
  
Join Baipule and grow with our team.
  
  
百铺乐私人有限公司(BAIPULE PTE. LTD.)
  
  
旗下经营
  
  
Baipule Korean-Chinese BBQ(百铺乐烤串)
  
  
,餐厅位于新加坡牛车水 Mosque Street,是一家以韩式及中式烧烤、烤串为特色的休闲餐饮品牌。
  
  
百铺乐提供多种新鲜制作的肉类、烤串、凉菜及亚洲风味餐点,致力于为顾客打造轻松、热闹且舒适的用餐体验。
  
  
我们相信,优质的餐饮体验不仅来自好的食物,也来自好的服务。前厅与后厨团队相互配合,共同为顾客提供高效、友善及愉快的用餐体验。
  
  
随着业务持续发展,我们欢迎积极、有责任心的伙伴加入百铺乐团队。我们重视团队合作、积极的工作态度、良好的顾客服务,以及食品品质、卫生与工作场所安全。
  
  
欢迎加入百铺乐,与我们一起成长。

title: Business Development Executive (Furniture B2B – Experienced Only)
description:
**Please read before applying:**  
We are only considering candidates who have
  
  
direct, proven experience in furniture B2B business development
  
  
. We are not looking to train someone on how the furniture trade works—we are looking for a seasoned closer who already knows the industry, understands the buyers, and knows exactly how to bring in more B2B furniture sales from day one.
  
  
If you already know how to get specified on projects, win over interior designers, navigate commercial budgets, and turn one-off trade inquiries into high-value repeat accounts, we want to talk to you.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
You will take immediate ownership of growing our B2B revenue, applying your proven sales playbook to expand our commercial and trade footprint. Your daily duties will include:
  
  
**Immediate Pipeline Generation:**  
Leverage your existing industry knowledge and outreach strategies to bring in new B2B clients—including interior design firms, architecture studios, fit-out contractors, hospitality groups, property developers, and corporate offices.
  
  
**Winning Specifications & Tenders:**  
Work directly with designers and project managers to get our pieces specified into mood boards, BOQs (Bills of Quantities), and commercial fit-out tenders.
  
  
**High-Ticket Closing:**  
Present custom capabilities, materials, and trade pricing with authority—negotiating commercial terms, bulk discounts, and payment schedules while protecting company margins.
  
  
**Account Expansion:**  
Convert first-time trade buyers into loyal, recurring accounts that come to you first for every new residential or commercial project.
  
  
**Seamless Handover:**  
Collaborate with our dedicated sales support, procurement, and logistics teams to verify production lead times, stock availability, and delivery schedules so your clients stay happy.
  
  
**Revenue Accountability:**  
Maintain a disciplined CRM pipeline and consistently hit or exceed monthly and quarterly B2B sales targets.
  
  
Who We Are Looking For (Non-Negotiable)
  
  
**Direct Furniture B2B Experience:**  
2+ years working specifically in B2B business development, trade sales, or project sales for a
  
  
furniture brand, distributor, or manufacturer
  
  
. Applications without furniture B2B experience will not be shortlisted.
  
  
**You Know How to Get Sales:**  
You don't need a script or hand-holding. You already have a tested playbook for finding decision-makers, booking meetings, and closing commercial furniture deals.
  
  
**Active Industry Network:**  
You ideally bring warm relationships—or know exactly how to quickly build them—with interior designers, architects, procurement managers, and commercial developers.
  
  
**Fluent in Furniture Specs:**  
You already understand lead times, MOQs, upholstery/material grading, custom fabrication limits, and how to read floor plans or BOQs.
  
  
**Commercially Driven:**  
You are motivated by closing big deals, hitting numbers, and maximizing your commission.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
**High Earning Potential:**  
Competitive base salary paired with an aggressive, transparent commission structure built to reward proven rainmakers.
  
  
**Zero Admin Drag:**  
You sell; our dedicated procurement, logistics, and customer service teams handle the backend execution so your time stays focused on revenue.
  
  
**Autonomy & Growth:**  
We don't micromanage people who deliver. Prove you can grow the B2B book, and you have a direct path to Senior BD, Key Account Director, or Head of Commercial Sales.
  
  
Comfy is committed to working directly with world-class sofa manufacturers from around the globe. We have partnered with factories that have combined the very best of designer styles, high tech functionality, and honest pricing. In our effort to bring you the best options in style, comfort, and utility, we have essentially removed the need for furniture retailers. Keeping cost low, and streamlining your process has always been a top priority at Comfy. Therefore, all of our products are perfectly optimized to contain the best possible pricing, and the highest quality options available on the furniture market.

title: Regional Demand Planner
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**  
1. Generation of Forecast using multi-view approach.
  
  
Forecasting Strategy – Identify and collaborate on changes to demand strategy relative to market and business changes, including demand pattern changes, seasonal influences and shifts in business focus.
  
  
Forecasting policies - Shape and refine forecasting policies to support business needs and system capabilities.
  
  
Co-ownership of Salesforce.com (CRM) opportunity pipeline integrity and trends, along with Regional Commercial Director (RCD).
  
  
Lead monthly customer forecast collection in a way that does not overload the Sales team.
  
  
Gain cross-functional alignment on the consensus forecast and its assumptions.
  
  
Consolidate and interpret information from multiple demand inputs, including Salesforce opportunities, statistical models, marketing strategic plans, and commercial/customer forecasts.
  
  
Use leading and lagging indicators to pressure test forecast assumptions. Understand market environment and dynamics that impact the demand plan.
  
  
Identify and document risks and upsides to the consensus forecast.
  
  
2. Support the monthly Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process.
  
  
Follow the workday calendar for loading forecast into APO (ERP) and preparing for Global Demand Review.
  
  
Ensure Americas Business Leadership are informed of key demand trends and implications.
  
  
Act as a trusted key leadership partner on behalf of Americas region to other functional leaders (Marketing, Finance, Product Management, Supply Chain etc.)
  
  
Identify gaps in the plan that require escalation. Perform what-if scenarios(simulations) to resolve demand/supply imbalances and equip business leadership to make educated decisions. Propose solutions to achieve business targets.
  
  
Monitor and respond to deviations in forecast KPIs and produce improvement resolutions.
  
  
3. Active participation in short- and long-term sales outlook processes.
  
  
Support the annual process to create and propose a regional Profit Objective/Business Plan for the upcoming year.
  
  
Collaborate with Regional Commercial Director (RCD) and Regional Enablement Leader (REL) to support a weekly pulse outlook for current quarter revenue.
  
  
Assist the commercial team to generate a monthly CY Sales Outlook, overlaying supply constraints and risks on unconstrained forecast.
  
  
4. Lead continuous improvement activities focused on growth and demand generation.
  
  
Demand segmentation - Continually assess and improve the demand segmentation framework to determine companywide approach to forecasting of different demand types (e.g., high volume, low volume, high volatility, seasonal, specific customers, segments).
  
  
Forecast model usage & back testing - Help identify, assess and implement best in class forecast models & techniques for different demand types; conduct back testing regularly to refine approaches.
  
  
Support effort to shift organization to Demand Generation culture, supporting improved business performance.
  
  
Utilize key working relationships across multiple functions in the business to facilitate and support improvement opportunities, including in reporting, analytics, inventory strategies, profit reviews etc.
  
  
**Key Qualifications:**  
BS degree in Engineering, Science, Supply Chain, Business, or related field.
  
  
Preferred experience with Forecasting, APO, Excel, Power BI, Salesforce.com, and other statistical models.
  
  
**Key Competencies:**  
Comfortable with complex datasets, SKU-level accuracy, and error prevention
  
  
Analytical Skills – creating insights/decisions from large datasets using Excel or PBI.
  
  
Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  
  
Able to inspire others to accept change and take action.
  
  
Innovative thinking through creative ideas and taking calculated risks.
  
  
Self-accountable for driving fast results, entrepreneurial spirit
  
  
Ability to collaborate effectively across functions, geographies, and levels in the organization and build positive working relationships with coworkers and internal customers.
  
  
DuPont is a leading advanced solutions provider focused on markets that shape the future—healthcare, water, and advanced industrials. We’re a global innovation leader in technology-based materials and solutions that help transform industries and everyday life. Our passion for, and proven expertise in, science and innovation enable us to partner with our customers to create sustainable solutions for the complex challenges facing our world.
  
  
Innovation is at the core of who we are—from solutions that help provide clean water to communities to breakthroughs that enable advances in healthcare. We bring ideas, expertise, and capabilities together to deliver critical supplies and technologies that make a meaningful difference. Explore the innovations that define who we are and shape what’s possible.
  
  
"At Dupont, we're fueled by curiosity and committed to innovation. By unlocking the power of advanced science and technology, we're not only addressing today's challenges - we're shaping what's next for our customers, our industries, and our world."
  
  
Lori Koch, DuPont Chief Executive Officer

title: PMO & Change Management Lead (3 years fixed-term contract)
description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

**Project Introduction:**

ZENITH, a business transformation program aiming at making significant gains in agility, control and competitiveness within Thales Operations and its Support Functions. With a new generation of ERP system, SAP S4/Hana and the Digital Tools ecosystem, to modernize and optimize its data and operational processes.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

**Project Tracking**:

Monitors and tracks project timelines, resource capacity, critical paths, risks and action plan.

**Change Management**:

Manages the Change strategy, plan the actions at different phases of the change journey, communication, deployment readiness, project impact analysis to operations and organization, and training plan adapting to the local culture and environment. Plan and execute with the domains and functions, the localization gap analysis, the system and process testing (UAT), ensuring a smooth operation after go-live until official handover and closure of project.

**Reporting (Dashboard)**:

Builds dashboards to track project progress and for executive status report.

This position is acting as a deputy to the Project Director and covers both Singapore and China.

Objectives are to deploy the ERP transformation and ecosystem tools adoption on-time as per plan without delay and plan the training in-time to ensure employees readiness to go-live without disruption to the operations.

**Job Duties & Responsibilities:**

  

* Track the project progress:
  + project milestone
  + critical paths
  + deliverables
  + risks
  + actions
* Identify any potential risks or opportunities that will impact the project or will bring value to the entity
* Coordinate and align across multi business domains and functions within the country
* Close collaboration between country and France project core team, and alignment among PMOs of other countries outside France
* Measure the country readiness at different stages and track actions closely to achieve the targeted result before Go-Live
* Define Change Management strategy for local deployment adapting to the local culture and environment, while in alignment with France project directives.
* Plan and execute communication sessions to stakeholders and affected employees (either through newsletter, team brief…etc)
* Assess the project impact to the employees’ roles & responsibilities and/or organization, and work on the action plan with the business domains and functions to minimize impact
* Define the training plan with each business domains and functions (on train the trainers and the users)
* Build the dashboards to track Project progress on monthly basis

**Education Level, Qualifications and Certifications:**

  

* Degree holder in Business Management, Business Administration, Information Systems & Technology, or Supply Chain Management
* Project Management Professional certified

**Experience Level:**

  

* At least 2 years of PMO experience
* ERP migration experiences is an advantage

**Knowledge and Skills:**

  

* Strong communication skill
* Analytical problem-solving skill
* Cross-Functional leadership
* SAP knowledge mandatory
* Primavera and JIRA knowledge is an advantage

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Registered Qualified Individual (RQI) / Corporate Services Compliance Lead
description:
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Act as the company’s appointed Registered Qualified Individual (RQI) and support the company in maintaining its regulatory standing as a Corporate Service Provider.
  
  
2. Perform, review, or supervise transactions and statutory filings submitted to ACRA through Bizfile.
  
  
3. Support company incorporations, annual returns, changes to directors, shareholders, company secretaries, registered addresses, share capital, and other corporate matters.
  
  
4. Review incorporation, company secretarial, and corporate transaction documents to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with Singapore regulations.
  
  
5. Supervise customer due diligence, including identity verification, beneficial ownership checks, risk assessments, sanctions screening, and ongoing monitoring.
  
  
6. Develop, implement, and maintain internal policies and controls relating to AML, CFT, and CPF compliance.

The Senior Director, Program Management PMO – Network Operations IT is accountable for leading the end-to-end program management, strategic planning, and governance across the Network Operations technology landscape. Reporting directly to the VP, Global Head of Network Operations IT, this role ensures that all technology initiatives and portfolios are aligned with strategic priorities, operational needs, and long-term transformation objectives.

It ensures cohesive portfolio management, clear prioritization, and effective execution across a complex, interdependent ecosystem.
  
  
This role establishes and continuously enhances governance, planning, and delivery standards to drive transparency, predictability, and performance across all initiatives. It provides a unified view of the technology portfolio, proactively managing dependencies, risks, and investment trade-offs, and enabling data-driven decision-making at the senior leadership level.
  
  
Working closely with domain leaders, product and engineering teams, and the central PMO, this role bridges strategy and execution—translating enterprise objectives into actionable roadmaps and ensuring consistent delivery of committed outcomes. Ultimately, it enables scalable, resilient, and future-ready operations across the global network.

**How will you contribute to the success of DHL?**
==================================================

**1. Enterprise Portfolio Leadership**  

* Define, own, and continuously evolve the end-to-end program and portfolio management framework across Network Operations IT.
* Provide strategic, operational, and financial oversight, including governance of the domain portfolio, budget management, and alignment of investments with enterprise priorities.
* Lead the integrated technology portfolio, ensuring all products, programs, and investments are aligned with strategic priorities and enterprise transformation objectives.
* Establish a unified planning and prioritization model that enables clear visibility, effective trade-off decisions, and optimal allocation of resources across Sort Automation, First, Middle, and Last Mile, Customs, and Life Sciences & Healthcare domains.

* Define and implement a comprehensive performance management framework across the portfolio, including KPIs, OKRs, and value-based success metrics aligned to customer outcomes and business impact.
* Lead the development of executive dashboards and reporting capabilities that provide real-time visibility into portfolio performance, risks, and outcomes.

title: Admin Executive
description:
About Us
  
  
HEYMONSTER Pest Control is a Singapore-based specialist pest management company providing services to vessels, warehouses, offices and commercial facilities.
  
  
We are looking for an organised and responsible Admin Executive to support our daily operations and take ownership of the company's administrative matters.
  
  
You will work closely with the Managing Director and our operations team to ensure service jobs are properly tracked, documents are completed, invoices are prepared on time and the office runs smoothly.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Job Coordination & Administration
  
  
Maintain and update records of upcoming, ongoing and completed pest control jobs.
  
  
Follow up with the operations team to collect service reports, photographic reports, certificates and other required documents.
  
  
Track outstanding documents for each job and ensure all required documentation is received and properly filed.
  
  
Prepare customer invoices and draft emails with the relevant reports and documents for management review and approval.
  
  
Send approved invoices and service documents to customers and update job and billing records accordingly.
  
  
2. Inventory & Stock Management
  
  
Maintain inventory records of chemicals, equipment and other supplies.
  
  
Conduct regular stock checks, including monitoring stock levels and chemical expiry dates.
  
  
Prepare stock replenishment lists and submit purchasing requirements to management for approval.
  
  
3. General Office Administration
  
  
Maintain proper organisation and filing of physical and digital documents.
  
  
Monitor expiry dates of company licences, insurances, permits and passes, and coordinate renewals with management.
  
  
Monitor office and pantry supplies and arrange replenishment when necessary.
  
  
Maintain a clean, tidy and well-organised office environment.
  
  
Assist with staff records and other general administrative matters as required.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
At least 1 year of experience in administration, operations support or a similar role preferred.
  
  
Well-organised, responsible and attentive to detail.
  
  
Proactive in following up on tasks and ensuring work is completed.
  
  
Comfortable using Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook.
  
  
Good communication skills and able to work independently after training.
  
  
Experience with invoicing or document management will be an advantage.
  
  
Why Join Us?
  
  
5-day work week, Monday to Friday.
  
  
Regular working hours, 9:00am to 6:00pm.
  
  
Convenient office location at Jurong East, beside IMM Building.
  
  
Small and friendly working environment.
  
  
Work closely with the Managing Director and operations team.
  
  
Annual salary review based on performance.
  
  
Medical and annual leave benefits.
  
  
Only shortlisted candidates will be notified. We look forward to welcoming someone who is ready to grow with us.
  
  
HEYMONSTER Pest Control Pte. Ltd. is a specialised vessel pest control and fumigation company in Singapore, supporting commercial vessels including oil tankers, bulk carriers, container ships and cruise ships, as well as FPSOs and drilling rigs at anchorage, PSA terminals and in shipyards.
  
  
Our services are delivered through VPMP™, HEYMONSTER’s proprietary Vessel Pest Management Programme developed specifically for marine environments. Built on practical onboard experience, the programme focuses on identifying pest risks at source and delivering consistent, well-documented treatments suited to vessel operations and port health requirements.
  
  
In addition to our marine services, we also provide pest management support for warehouses, offices and other commercial facilities.

title: Manager, Butler Service
description:
**WE TAKE YOU ABOVE BEYOND**

Take your passion to the next level and work alongside other masters of their craft to build a fulfilling and rewarding career at Marina Bay Sands.

**Job Responsibilities**

Operational Related

* Coordinate the preparation and service execution for Paiza Collection guests and Paiza Chairmans with Front Office, Groups, Guest Services, Paiza Services, Food & Beverage, Housekeeping, Facilities and In-Room Dining, ensuring that departmental arrangements work together throughout the guest experience.
* Review guest comments, requests and complaints and resolve in a timely and professional manner; take personal responsibility to resolve issues and identify how to minimize reoccurrences with various stakeholders
* Hold regular meetings to review operational standards and guest feedback; brainstorm and decide on ways in which operational flow can be improved
* Attend briefing which is conducted by Supervisors and/or Asst. Managers at the start of each shift
* Manage respective tower operations and supervise operations of all areas
* Handle meet and greet of VIPs
* Plan, coordinate and manage staff and services to ensure the department functions efficiently and effectively according to established standards
* Manage and develop team members
* Prepare the roster and manage leave applications for all Assistant Managers, Butler Supervisors and Butler to ensure adequate manning for operations
* Monitor fiscal budget, operations of assigned departments and marketing strategies to produce both short-term and long-term profitability for the company
* Manage the delivery of services to guests consistent to the company’s core service standards, brand attributes and compliance
* Be conversant with all facets of Butler Services operations including fire safety and emergency related procedures
* Monitor activities in both front and back of the house; report any suspicious characters, items and/or activities to Security Department

Departmental Related

* Liaise with senior management to ensure that Marina Bay Sands’ short- and long-term goals are met with respect to Butler Services, and lead the team towards the goal of service excellence
* Spearhead the achievement of Forbes Travel Guide 5 stars rating
* Be directly involved in any service enhancement activity or review and in the delivery and measurement of the Net Promoter Score (NPS), including following through of strategic planning to improve the score index
* Establish, assess, conduct and maintain appropriate performance appraisals based on objective departmental KPI’s and according to agreed standards and take necessary action to communicate/advise/assist according to performance levels.
* Be responsible for motivating, coaching and counseling of Team Members appropriately and in ensuring their job skills are constantly being improved and developed to exceed guests’ expectations
* Ensure that all team members are well-mannered and always groomed as per company standard
* Be conversant with all areas of the Butler Services Department including FIT, Group and Casino reservations; can be assigned to certain specialist areas to manage at any one time
* Maintain close liaison with all other Departments to have a good understanding of other Departments’ operational flow, thus ensuring seamless guest services throughout the hotel
* Contribute ideas to and cooperate in the execution of strategic plan initiatives in support of the company vision, mission, value and guiding principles
* Recommend appointments, promotions and development of all Team Members
* Perform any other duties and responsibilities as and when assigned by Hotel Manager

Focused Responsibilities

* Align departmental training with applicable Forbes Travel Guide to Five-Stars service standards to support achievement of the rating. Use practical service training, coaching and follow-up assessments to address gaps identified through guest feedback and internal audits, and reinforce consistent delivery of personalized guest experiences.
* Develop and maintain a departmental training plan aligned with Butler Service priorities. Use Forbes Audit (Internal/External) results, guest feedback, operational reviews, and service standards to identify knowledge and skill gaps and determine training needs.
* Plan and coordinate new Team Member onboarding, hotel orientation, cross-departmental exposure and Butler Academy participation to support readiness for guest-facing duties.
* Work closely with Hospitality Training & Quality Assurance and departmental leaders to deliver Butler Academy, refresher training and practical service training covering the guest journey from pre-arrival to departure.
* Review Butler Academy modules and content to ensure relevancy.
* Develop and update training materials, service guides and learning activities to reinforce technical skills, service mindfulness, communication and personalized guest service.
* Coordinate training schedules with operational leaders to maintain adequate staffing while ensuring Team Members complete required learning activities.
* Guide departmental trainers and mentors in delivering consistent on-the-job coaching, practical demonstrations and service simulations.
* Maintain accurate training attendance, learning journals and completion records; coordinate practical skills assessments and follow-up learning to address identified knowledge or skill gaps.
* Review training effectiveness using participant feedback, learning outcomes and departmental guest feedback, including NPS trends; recommend improvements and report training progress to the Director of Butler Service.

**Job Requirements**

Education & Certification

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree, preferably in Hotel Management or business related

Experience

* Minimum 3 years’ management experience in a luxury hotel environment
* Proven ability to recruit, motivate and direct a professional group of team members
* Proficient in the use of Property Management System and Microsoft Office applications
* Experience in preparing presentation materials

Other Prerequisites

* Strong leadership skills and ability to operate and successfully arbitrate in a complex international, multicultural environment
* Excellent guest relation and problem-solving skills
* Good planning and execution skills with ability to be persistent while focusing on detail elements of tasks
* Excellent time management, organizational, communication and motivational skills
* Meet the attendance guidelines of the job and adhere to departmental and company policies
* Organize staffing effectively in the situation of sudden increases of business volume.
* Candidates must have a good command of spoken and written English
* Pays attention to details and have strong customer service skills
* Mature, meticulous, resourceful, organized and able to work independently
* A team player and takes initiative to assist other Team Members when required
* Have an impeccable follow-through; and “Can Do” attitude and mindset.
* Be willing to work any day and any shift
* Well-groomed and professional disposition.
* Ability to identify training needs from guest feedback, operational reviews and service standards, and translate them into structured learning plans.
* Strong learning design skills, with the ability to develop practical training materials, service guides, and activities tailored to different learning needs.
* Effective facilitation and presentation skills to engage Team Members through practical demonstrations, service simulations and interactive learning.
* Strong coaching and mentoring skills to guide departmental trainers and reinforce consistent on-the-job learning and service delivery.
* Ability to coordinate onboarding and training schedules across departments, balancing learning priorities with operational staffing needs.
* Sound skills in practical learning assessment and constructive feedback to identify knowledge or skill gaps and guide follow-up learning.

description:
**Opportunity**

Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and have been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation, we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organisation reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.

  

**Purpose of the Role**

The Client Program Director is the senior programme leader responsible for connecting customer strategy, operational execution, performance governance and account growth. Working across customer and company leadership, Commercial, Product, Operations, Technology and Finance, this role develops and delivers a joint programme roadmap that strengthens service continuity, supply chain visibility and measurable value creation.

  

The role requires a trusted advisor who can translate complex supply chain priorities into actionable plans and lead global, cross-functional teams through influence. Experience supporting a technology OEM, Tier 1 supplier or manufacturing-led supply chain is strongly preferred.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Strategy and Growth**
--------------------------------

* Partner with customer and company leadership to develop the account strategy, programme roadmap and growth priorities.
* Build trusted relationships across supply chain, logistics, procurement, manufacturing, technology, finance and senior leadership.
* Translate customer requirements and market developments into integrated logistics solutions and improvement opportunities.
Support new business development, solution design and value-creation initiatives.  

  

**Operational and Programme Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Establish and govern operational KPIs, ensuring accurate reporting, clear ownership and timely corrective action.
* Lead regional and global governance forums covering performance, risks, root causes, decisions and action closure.
* Manage production-critical risks, supplier escalations, inventory concerns, transport disruptions and service failures.
* Own the programme plan and project pipeline, including scope, governance, resources, milestones, dependencies and executive reporting.
Lead the transition of new business from implementation into stable operations.  

  

**Performance and Continuous Improvement**
------------------------------------------

* Drive structured exception management, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement across the operating model.
* Identify and deliver measurable improvements in cost, productivity, service, resilience and supply chain visibility.
* Maintain customer satisfaction and strengthen internal stakeholder engagement.
Ensure Standard Operating Procedures, billing processes and operational documentation remain accurate and controlled.  

  

**Executive Governance, Risk and Compliance**
---------------------------------------------

* Prepare monthly executive updates and lead Quarterly Business Reviews and strategic customer sessions.
* Maintain clear visibility of account performance, projects, customer sentiment, risks and value creation.
* Establish controls that minimise operational, commercial, compliance, trade-control and HSSE exposure.
Escalate material risks with clear impact assessments, ownership and mitigation plans.  

  

**Team and Community Leadership**
---------------------------------

* Support team onboarding, capability development and succession planning.
* Contribute to objective setting, coaching, recognition and performance management.
Share best practices across local, regional and global programme-management communities.  

  

**What we are looking for**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering or a related discipline.
* At least 10 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, programme management, customer operations or operational leadership.
* Proven experience leading complex customer programmes and cross-functional initiatives across multiple geographies.
* Strong capabilities in operational governance, KPI management, continuous improvement, risk mitigation and value creation.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and deliver results within a global matrix organisation.
* Excellent relationship-management, communication, negotiation, facilitation and executive-presentation skills.
Working knowledge of Lean or business-improvement methodologies.  

  

Preferred Experience

* Experience within a technology OEM, Tier 1 supplier or manufacturing supply chain.
* Understanding of JIT/JIS operations, supplier management, production planning and plant logistics.
* Experience with production-critical logistics, multi-tier supplier networks and operational disruption management.
* Knowledge of inbound, outbound, aftermarket and supplier logistics.
* Experience in Lead Logistics, LLP/4PL, control tower or integrated supply chain environments.
* Familiarity with supply chain measures such as on-time delivery, ASN performance, supplier compliance, transit performance and inventory health.
* PMP, APICS CSCP/CLTD or Lean Six Sigma certification would be advantageous.

title: Head of Regional Security, APAC
description:
At AIG, our business spans the globe. To achieve our objectives, we must be able to navigate complex and rapidly changing landscapes with confidence.

The Senior Manager - Head of Regional Security, Asia Pacific, is based in Singapore and reports to the Director, Global Security Operations in United States. This role provides the leadership, structure, partnerships, processes, and technology needed to protect AIG employees, facilities, operations, and reputation across the region.

The role leads physical security operations and investigations across 14 countries supporting approximately 4,600 colleagues. This role serves as the senior regional security advisor, translates global security strategy and standards into effective regional execution, and ensures that emerging risks are identified, communicated, and mitigated.

The ideal candidate will bring substantial multi-country security leadership experience, strong program and people-management capability, sound business judgment, and a highly collaborative approach. AIG is seeking a leader who embraces teamwork, change, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Lead AIG's physical security and protective-risk program across Asia Pacific, establishing regional priorities, operating objectives, and long-term capabilities that protect employees, facilities, operations, and corporate reputation.
* Serve as the principal regional security advisor to APAC business leadership and Global Security, providing strategic counsel regarding geopolitical developments, emerging threats, security incidents, and organizational risk and exposure.
* Translate global security strategy, standards, and policies into consistent regional execution while adapting controls to local threat, regulatory, cultural, and operating environments.
* Lead, develop, and mentor a geographically dispersed regional team, establishing clear accountabilities, succession capability, and a culture of operational excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators, operational metrics, risk trends, remediation activity, project delivery, and program maturity measures to evaluate effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.
* Manage regional security budgets, vendors, guard-force arrangements, contracts, service-level expectations, and capital investments to ensure effective resource allocation and measurable value.
* Develop and maintain strategic relationships with internal stakeholders, including Human Resources, Legal, Corporate Real Estate, Facilities, Communications, Technology, Resiliency, Procurement, and business leadership.
* Represent Global Security in regional enterprise initiatives, cross-functional projects, and external industry engagements, and maintain strong relationships with government, diplomatic, military, law-enforcement, and industry partners.

**Regional Security Operations & Risk Management**

* Oversee regional physical security operations, including site risk assessments, corrective-action planning, office security, guard-force delivery, and consistent application of Global Security standards.
* Maintain awareness of geopolitical, economic, social, environmental, and security developments across APAC and translate relevant intelligence into timely, actionable advice for business leaders and security stakeholders.
* Establish and maintain regional security procedures, escalation pathways, and site security profiles that support effective risk-based decision-making.
* Partner with Corporate Real Estate and Facilities on new offices, relocations, renovations, and other capital projects to embed appropriate physical security controls from design through commissioning.

**Investigations & Workplace Risk**

* Support the Global Investigations Department by leading / overseeing investigations involving theft, fraud-related physical-security matters, vandalism, burglary, workplace violence, extortion, threats, vendor misconduct, and other incidents affecting employees, clients, assets, or operations.
* Ensure investigations are supported by appropriate fact-finding, evidence gathering, interviews, case documentation, reporting, escalation, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
* Analyze incident and investigation trends to identify vulnerabilities, recurring risks, and control gaps, and recommend practical measures to reduce future losses and employee concerns.
* Partner with Human Resources, Legal, and business leadership on workplace violence prevention, sensitive employee-risk matters, and security support for workforce reductions, terminations, suspensions, and other elevated-risk actions.
* Provide Security oversight and subject-matter expertise for relevant personnel and third-party risk processes in accordance with applicable law and AIG requirements.

**Executive Protection, Travel Risk & Event Security**

* Provide regional leadership for executive protection, high-risk travel, journey management, and traveler incident response, including risk assessments, briefings, advance work, monitoring, and escalation.
* Plan and oversee proportionate security support for major corporate events, Board and executive meetings, conferences, and other elevated-risk business activities.
* Deliver concise, intelligence-led risk assessments and mitigation options that enable informed travel and business decisions without unnecessarily impeding operations.

**Security Technology & Asset Protection**

* Oversee security technology projects and lifecycle activities, including design, integration, installation, testing, maintenance, repair, and remediation.
* Partner with adjacent departments within Global Security and Corporate Real Estate, Facilities, and Information Technology teams to ensure solutions are resilient, supportable, appropriately standardized, and aligned with AIG requirements.
* Conduct or oversee site security assessments and support applicable assurance and compliance reviews, including PCI DSS-related physical security requirements where assigned.

**Training & Security Culture**

* Develop and deliver regional security awareness, crisis-readiness, workplace-violence, travel-risk, and role-specific training for employees, managers, Human Resources, incident-management teams, and local security partners.
* Promote shared ownership of security risk and ensure employees and stakeholders understand relevant procedures, reporting channels, and response expectations.

**Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience required; advanced degree is preferred.
* 10+ years of progressively responsible corporate, government, military, law-enforcement, intelligence, or private-sector security experience, including substantial leadership responsibility across multiple countries or jurisdictions.
* Strong drive and desire to develop and motivate teams.
* Results oriented – positive attitude – problem solver – team oriented.
* Demonstrated experience leading physical security operations, investigations, crisis management, executive protection or travel risk, security technology, and security-related projects.
* Proven ability to lead and develop geographically dispersed teams and to influence effectively in a complex matrix organization.
* Strong knowledge of the APAC geopolitical, regulatory, cultural, and security environment, with experience translating risk information into practical business decisions.
* Strong familiarity with physical security technology, including access-control systems, security video, intrusion detection, sensors, and integrated security platforms.
* Business acumen, financial discipline, vendor-management experience, and the ability to develop risk-based investment recommendations.
* Well-developed written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills, including the ability to provide clear executive briefings and incident updates.
* Fluency in English is required; additional APAC language capabilities are desirable.

**Key Relationships**

**Internal Interactions**

* APAC business and functional leadership
* Corporate Functions - HR, Enterprise Resiliency, Real Estate, Facilities, Legal, Communications, Global Sourcing/Procurement
* Security Operations, Security Technology, Security Investigations, Executive Protection

**External Interactions**

* Government, diplomatic, military, law-enforcement, and emergency-management organizations
* Security Industry Community (ACGS, ASIS, OSAC, DSAC, etc.)
* Security/Crisis response vendors
* Guard-force providers, security-technology integrators, intelligence providers, crisis-response partners, and other security vendors

**Job Challenges**

* Ability to operate both strategically and operationally across a large, diverse, and rapidly changing region.
* Ability to work effectively in a matrix organization and influence stakeholders not directly under the job holder's control.
* Ability to balance global standards with local legal, cultural, threat, and business requirements.
* Ability to prioritize competing demands, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and communicate clearly during fast-moving incidents.
* Ability to lead across multiple time zones and maintain effective regional coverage during significant security events.

**Other Dimensions**

* This role requires periodic travel across Asia Pacific and occasional travel outside the region.
* In addition to normal office hours, the job holder will need to be flexible to work outside of core office hours (e.g. during operational support activities, conference calls with people in countries on other time zones or run with major security events as they develop

At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike.

At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.

title: Director of Sales & Marketing
description:
JOB SUMMARY
  
  
Functions as the leader of the property’s sales department for properties with bookings over 300 peak rooms and significant local catering revenue. Manages the property's reactive and proactive sales efforts. Provides day to day leadership to sales associates to achieve property sales objectives with overall responsibility for achieving booking goals and property revenues. Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the sales process and focuses on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of the hotel’s’ sales objectives. Evaluates the property’s participation in the various sales channels (e.g., Area Sales, Group Sales within the Sales Office, electronic lead channels, etc.) and develops strong working relationships to proactively position and market the property. Manages the marketing budget to enable development of property specific campaigns, promotions and collateral to drive revenue and meet property objectives. Interfaces with regional marketing communications for regional and national promotions pull through. Develops and implements property–wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer profile and property associates and provides a return on investment to the owner and Marriott International.
  
  
CANDIDATE PROFILE
  
  
Education and Experience
  
  
**Required:**  

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR
  
  

* 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

**Preferred:**  

* 4 year college degree.
* Demonstrated skills in supervising a team.
* Lodging sales experience.
* Hotel industry work experience, demonstrating progressive career growth and a pattern of exceptional performance.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
  
  
Managing Sales Activities
  
  

* Manages the development of a strategic account plan for the demand generators in the market.
* Manages the property's reactive and proactive sales efforts.
* Determines and develops marketing communication activities, in conjunction with Regional Marketing Communications.
* Provides customer intelligence in evaluating the market and economic trends that may lead to changes in sales strategy to meet or exceed customer expectations.
* Reviews the Strategic Alignment Review (STAR) report, competitive shopping reports and uses other resources to maintain an awareness of the hotel’s market position.
* Researches competitor’s sales team strategies to identify ways to grow occupancy and RevPAR and increase market share.
* Attends sales strategy meetings to provide input on weekly and overall sales strategy.
* Suggests innovative marketing ideas and develops deployment strategies to continue to grow market share.
* Evaluates and supports participation and account deployment with Area Sales and Group Sales within the Sales Office.
* Serves as the sales contact for the General Manager, property leadership team, Group Sales and Area Sales leaders.
* Serves as the sales contact for customers; serves as the customer advocate.
* Serves as hotel authority on sales processes and sales contracts.
* Serves as the property sales liaison with Area Sales, Group Sales, Revenue Management, Event Management, Regional Marketing Communications and other hotel departments as appropriate.
* Participates in sales calls with members of the Sales and Marketing team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
* Identifies public relations opportunities and coordinates activities to augment the overall marketing communication strategy.
* Supports the General Manager by coordinating crisis communications.
