Full time

J0110031

Iron Mountain is seeking a strategic, results-oriented Director, Data Center Construction – APAC to join our Data Center Construction team.

In this role, you will lead multi-site hyperscale data center builds and phased campus developments across the APAC region. By combining our trusted operational foundation with forward-thinking infrastructure execution, your leadership will directly shape the physical capacity that powers modern digital solutions. You will mentor a high-performing team of project managers while setting the benchmark for safety, quality, and on-time delivery from construction mobilisation through to commissioning and operational handover.

**What You’ll Do**

In this role, you will:

* Lead Sub-Regional Portfolio Execution: Oversee active data center builds, campus expansions, and major capital projects across APAC to ensure strict alignment with safety, schedule, CapEx, quality, and Ready for Service (RFS) targets.
* Develop and Mentor Delivery Teams: Line-manage, coach, and build capability across a team of Senior Project Managers and Project Managers, driving resource allocation, succession planning, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate will have:

* 10+ years of progressive leadership experience delivering data center, mission-critical, or major infrastructure capital programs across multi-project portfolios.

* Generous paid time off and holiday allowance.
* Flexible work options to support work–life balance.
* Comprehensive health, wellness, and retirement plans.
* Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.

title: CEO
description:
About Cloudwise
  
  
Cloudwise is a cloud services and software company that specialises in IT Service Management (ITSM), observability and AIOps. We help enterprises run complex, hybrid IT environments more reliably and efficiently. We have teams in Singapore, Hong Kong, Mainland China and the Middle East, and Singapore is our regional hub for growth across Asia Pacific and beyond.
  
  
The Role
  
  
We are looking for a Chief Executive Officer to lead our Singapore entity and drive regional growth. Reporting to the Board / Group Management, the CEO is fully accountable for the strategy, commercial results, operations and organisational development of the Singapore business. You will turn the Group’s vision into a clear regional plan, build strong client and partner relationships, and lead a lean, high-performing multinational team.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategy & Business Leadership
  
  
Set and carry out the business strategy and annual operating plan for Singapore and the markets it covers, in line with Group direction.
  
  
Own full P&L responsibility, including revenue, gross margin, operating costs and cash flow.
  
  
Find and prioritise growth opportunities across industries such as financial services, telecommunications, government and large enterprises.
  
  
Commercial & Market Development
  
  
Lead the go-to-market strategy for our ITSM, observability and AIOps solutions, covering direct sales, channel partners and alliances with cloud providers.
  
  
Build and maintain relationships with key clients, strategic partners, industry bodies and government agencies.
  
  
Personally lead major deals, strategic accounts and important negotiations.
  
  
Operations & Governance
  
  
Make sure the Singapore entity complies with all corporate governance, regulatory, data protection (PDPA) and contractual requirements.
  
  
Set up sound management systems, KPIs and reporting to the Board, and present regular business reviews and forecasts.
  
  
Work with Finance, Legal and HR to manage risk, budgets and internal controls.
  
  
People & Organisation
  
  
Build, lead and develop a multi-functional team spanning sales, pre-sales, delivery, customer success and support functions.
  
  
Encourage a culture of customer focus, accountability, innovation and collaboration across offices.
  
  
Plan for key roles and develop the next generation of leaders.
  
  
Cross-regional Collaboration
  
  
Work closely with Group HQ and the regional offices in Hong Kong, China and the Middle East to align product roadmaps, share resources and deliver to clients.
  
  
Bring local market insights and customer needs back to the Group’s product and R&D teams.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. An MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
  
  
At least 15 years of professional experience in enterprise software, SaaS, cloud or IT services, including at least 5 years in a General Manager, Country Manager, Managing Director or equivalent senior leadership role with full P&L responsibility.
  
  
Strong understanding of enterprise IT operations. Domain knowledge in ITSM, observability, APM, monitoring or AIOps is highly preferred.
  
  
Proven track record of growing revenue in the Asia Pacific B2B enterprise market and building channel and partner ecosystems.
  
  
Experience leading teams across countries, and working effectively in a matrix organisation with an overseas headquarters.
  
  
Strong business sense, executive presence, and communication and negotiation skills, including at C-level.
  
  
Excellent command of English. Proficiency in Mandarin is required, because the role works closely with Group HQ, colleagues and clients in Mainland China and Hong Kong.
  
  
Willing to travel regionally as business needs require.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
Competitive base salary plus performance-based incentives
  
  
【Long-term incentive / equity scheme, if applicable】
  
  
Annual leave, medical and insurance benefits
  
  
The chance to shape and scale a fast-growing AIOps business across the region
  
  
Interested candidates, please click “Apply Now” and submit your updated resume. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
  
  
Cloudwise is a pioneer vendor that provides high quality digital operation products and solutions on ITOM and ITSM. We assist in monitoring and improving business operations based on the original business service logic, and help optimize user experience.

title: Customer Success Executive
description:
About NexGen
  
  
NexGen Concepts Pte Ltd is a Singapore based, full service digital marketing and creative agency. We deliver integrated campaigns, creative and video production, events, SEM, SEO, AEO, social media, web development and AI solutions for brands in Singapore and the region.
  
  
We also build our own products, including NexPulse (unified marketing analytics) and GiftLab (corporate gifting). We expect every team member to use AI tools to work faster and better.
  
  
The role
  
  
At NexGen, Customer Success means project management. The Customer Success Executiveturns signed work into delivered work: on time, on budget and to the brief. You plan projects, coordinate our internal teams and suppliers, keep clients updated and resolve issues before they escalate.
  
  
Our Director of Business Development and Account Manager lead the client relationship and new proposals. You own delivery.
  
  
**Reports to:**  
Customer Success Lead
  
  
**Location:**  
Singapore
  
  
**Employment type:**  
Full time, permanent
  
  
**Responsibilities:** project planning and delivery
  
  
Turn approved scopes and quotations into project plans with milestones, owners, budgets and deadlines.
  
  
Brief department heads on each project's requirements; they assign team members, you track progress against the plan.
  
  
Run several concurrent projects across traditional work (events, print, video production) and digital work (campaigns, social, SEO, websites, AI builds).
  
  
Track timelines and budgets; flag risks early and escalate with options, not just problems.
  
  
Check deliverables against the brief before they reach the client.
  
  
Manage revision rounds within scope, approve one extra round where justified, and route anything beyond that for requoting.
  
  
Close each project with a short review of timeline, cost and client feedback.
  
  
**Responsibilities:** client communication, costing and suppliers
  
  
Be the client's day to day contact for project updates, approvals and issues.
  
  
Run status calls and send clear written updates; log every decision and change.
  
  
Resolve client issues quickly, and escalate to the Director when the relationship or revenue is at risk.
  
  
Prepare RFQs, source and compare suppliers, and agree markups with Business Development.
  
  
Manage suppliers on brief, timeline, quality and cost against the quotation.
  
  
Document change requests and pass out of scope work to Business Development for requoting.
  
  
Keep project records, files and trackers current in our project management tools.
  
  
Use AI tools for status reports, meeting notes and documentation, while checking accuracy and protecting client confidentiality.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
Must have
  
  
2 to 5 years of project management or client servicing at a marketing, creative, digital or events agency.
  
  
Hands on management of several concurrent projects from brief to delivery.
  
  
Experience preparing RFQs, comparing supplier quotes and working to a project budget.
  
  
Enough understanding of how creative, digital and production work gets made to plan realistic timelines and spot problems early.
  
  
Calm, firm client communication, including saying no to out of scope requests.
  
  
Strong written English and organised documentation.
  
  
Comfort with project management tools (Asana, Monday.com or similar) and spreadsheets.
  
  
Daily, practical use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini.
  
  
Nice to have
  
  
Experience across both traditional (events, print, video) and digital projects.
  
  
Website or app development project experience.
  
  
Agile, Scrum, PMP or PRINCE2 training.
  
  
Bahasa Indonesia or Mandarin, useful for working with our regional team and clients.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
Ownership of delivery across a varied client portfolio.
  
  
Base salary of S$3500 to S$4,200 per month, depending on experience.
  
  
Work across creative, digital, events, tech and AI projects, and NexGen's own products.
  
  
Structured training in AI tools and workflows.
  
  
Leave and medical benefits in line with company policy.

title: Account Director
description:
Req ID: 64773

Job Function: Sales and Commercial

Posting Start Date: 19/11/2026

Posting End Date: 30/11/2026

Division: BT International

Job Location: Marina One East Tower

Advertised Salary: Competitive

**About the role**
------------------

The role holder is responsible for driving substantial sales growth across strategic and high-potential customers in the South East Asia region. This includes both MNCs headquartered in Singapore (A-Ends) and inbound MNCs (B-Ends).

  

ASEAN is the world’s fifth-largest economy, and is on track to become the fourth-largest by 2030. Singapore sits at the heart of this growth, home to over 5,000 multinational corporations that use it as a base for their regional and global operations. These MNCs are undergoing rapid digital transformation - driven by rapid advancements in AI, infrastructure upgrades, and sustainability priorities - creating both disruption and opportunity for innovative solutions.

  

Against this backdrop, Singapore has been identified to be a Key Market for BT International, and is home to key strategic customers, as well as HiPo accounts, across industries such as BFSI, Manufacturing, FMCG.

  

The role holder will: (1) lead client engagement across existing strategic customers to retain and grow our Share of Wallet with the customer, and (2) lead the pursuit of acquisition customers. All activities will need to be strongly underpinned by BT International’s GTM Strategy and the associated sales initiatives (e.g. HiPo Program, Account Growth Plans, etc.).

  

Why join this role? Make your mark by opening new enterprise relationships in Singapore and turning customer transformation priorities into business wins. The opportunity combines prospecting, relationship-building and complex solution selling, with Secure Connectivity and Digital Workplace at the heart of the customer conversation. It is a role for someone who wants to create opportunities, shape the pursuit and see the deal through—not simply inherit a portfolio.

  

Success will be measured through incremental sales margin (ICGM), revenue growth, and other key metrics such as recurring revenue and profit, in line with the Financial Year Payplan Structure.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

This role is all about building and growing pipeline across the direct channel in Singapore, through a two-pronged approach:

  

**Existing Strategic Customers**

* Hunt for growth within existing accounts, driving year-on-year expansion through upsell and cross-sell opportunities aligned to BT’s Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and HiPo criteria, with a sharp focus on Secure Connectivity and Digital Workplace.
* Deepen client engagement and build trusted relationships that deliver measurable satisfaction, reflected in strong NPS scores and Gartner Peer Insight reviews.
* Partner across teams and with external stakeholders to deliver winning, profitable outcomes for customers and BT.
* Take full ownership of your accounts in Salesforce - keeping data accurate, forecasts reliable, and visibility strong on Revenue and EBITDA.
* Shape and execute proactive account plans that unlock new opportunities, expand services, and strengthen BT’s footprint.
* Build influence across key networks and use innovative approaches to spark fresh conversations and introduce new services.
  

**Acquisition Customers**

* Hunt for new growth by identifying high-potential target accounts aligned to BT’s Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).
* Research prospects in depth to uncover their IT and business priorities, assess existing BT touchpoints and map the decision-making landscape. Qualify opportunities against a clear customer need, a credible sponsor, the funding path, the buying process and timing, and BT’s ability to compete and deliver.
* Proactively generate leads through partners, prospecting tools (e.g. Propensity Model, LinkedIn Sales Navigator), and outbound activity including email, social media, and calls.
* Engage customers to uncover their challenges and objectives, and position BT’s solutions in terms of clear business outcomes and value.
* Build and nurture long-term relationships with decision-makers, confidently handling objections and articulating compelling use cases.
* Develop targeted hunting plans that map out priority deals to pursue, the competitive landscape, key decision-maker contacts, and clear next actions.
* Own the end-to-end acquisition sales cycle - from lead generation through to deal closure.
  

Success in this role means consistently growing revenue and margin across both strategic and new acquisition accounts, while building a healthy, sustainable pipeline aligned to BT’s ICP and HiPo criteria. You’ll be recognised for strengthening BT’s position in the market by delivering value-led solutions, expanding our customer footprint, and forging trusted, long-term partnerships. Above all, success is about driving measurable outcomes for customers while achieving ambitious sales targets for BT.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Customer Obsession; Having the empathy and curiosity to understand see things from the customer’s point of view
* Hunter Mentality: A fearless attitude and grit to make things happen and uncover the customer’s unconsidered needs
* Tech Enthusiast: Keen interest in digital transformation and cybersecurity, with an aptitude to learn and convey complex technical concepts in an easy-to-understand manner
* Interpersonal Skills: Possesses strong communication and active listening skills to build rapport and trust with prospects. This includes verbal and written skills (e.g. storytelling, creative emails, etc.)
* Adaptability: Ability to adapt and iterate on the prospecting approach in a fast-paced high growth sales environment
* Growth Mindset; Open and willing to be coached and to learn from others and grow positively

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Proven experience in relationship management and direct sales, ideally with a mix of strategic account management and new business acquisition.
* Prior experience in the Singapore region, with a strong understanding of regional market dynamics and enterprise customer landscapes.
* Proven experience in strategic thinking, influencing decisions, and shaping adoption of complex solutions.
* Proven ability to craft creative solutions to complex business challenges, including navigating cross-geography and cross-cultural environments.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth sales environment, demonstrating adaptability, resilience, and a results-driven mindset.

At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

title: [Travel Retail APAC] - Head of Retail, Aesop
description:
Role Purpose
  
  
The Head of Retail, Travel Retail APAC leads the Retail and Education functions across the region, with the ambition to elevate retail performance while protecting and strengthening the distinctive Aesop experience.
  
  
The role translates regional commercial and brand priorities into exceptional execution at the store level—building capable teams, strengthening retail productivity, and ensuring every customer encounter reflects Aesop’s approach to consultation, hospitality and product knowledge.
  
  
Reporting to the Brand Business Development & Marketing Director, you will partner closely with regional teams, retail partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to curate a consistent yet locally inspired luxury retail experience across a fast-evolving Travel Retail landscape.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Retail Strategy & Performance
* Define and lead the APAC Travel Retail strategy for retail excellence, aligned with regional business and brand priorities.
* Drive sustainable retail performance across the network, with clear focus on productivity, conversion, average transaction value, recruitment and customer engagement.
* Establish retail KPIs and routines to identify opportunities and translate insights into actionable improvement plans.
* Partner with Commercial teams and retailers to elevate store and counter performance.
* Support new openings, renovations and strategic retail projects, ensuring operational readiness and strong execution.
* Identify opportunities to simplify ways of working and improve retail effectiveness across markets.
* Retail Experience & Excellence
* Champion a distinctive and consistent Aesop retail experience across Travel Retail APAC.
* Translate Aesop’s service philosophy into practical retail standards appropriate to the travel environment.
* Elevate consultation quality, storytelling and sensorial experience to build meaningful and lasting customer connections.
* Balance global brand principles with local and traveller relevance.
* Education & Capability Building
* Lead TRAPAC Retail Education team for Aesop and define the regional education strategy.
* Build scalable learning programs that strengthen product knowledge, consultation capability, confidence and leadership skills.
* Evolve education from training delivery towards a strategic capability-building function directly connected to retail performance.
* Establish clear learning journeys for Retail Consultants, Store Managers and field leadership.
* Develop and coach market trainers and retail leaders, creating strong capability within local teams.
* Measure the effectiveness of education through both capability and business outcomes.
* People Leadership
* Lead, inspire and develop the regional Retail and Education teams.
* Build a high-performing community of retail leaders across APAC, encouraging exchange of best practices and collective problem solving.
* Coach teams combine strong commercial acumen with considered customer experience.
* Foster a culture of accountability, curiosity, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Cross-functional & Partner Leadership
* Act as the regional voice of Retail, bringing frontline and customer perspectives into commercial, marketing and business decisions.
* Partner closely with Business Development, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Operations and market teams to ensure integrated execution.
* Connect regional priorities with global Retail and Education direction while representing APAC Travel Retail needs and opportunities.
* Financial Stewardship & Resource Management
* A&P Governance: Oversee Retail & Education and Retail A&P budgets, ensuring strategic allocation of resources across training, stock, promoters, and incentives.
* Commercial Review: Partner with leadership on strategic financial reviews to maximize return on investment.

What We Are Looking For
  

* Significant leadership experience in Retail, Retail Excellence, Education or Commercial functions within luxury, beauty or premium consumer brands.
* Strong understanding of multi-market retail environments; Travel Retail experience is highly valued.
* Proven ability to lead both retail performance and people capability agendas.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate KPIs and consumer insights into practical retail actions.
* Demonstrated experience building and developing high-performing teams across different markets and cultures.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing capability, including experience working with external retail partners.
* Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
* Passionate about customer experience, service, education and developing people.
* Comfortable navigating complexity and building simple, scalable solutions across a diverse regional network.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Success in this role means creating a Travel Retail organization where Retail and Education operate as one engine: stronger people create stronger experiences, and stronger experiences translate into sustainable commercial performance.
  
  
The Head of Retail will ultimately ensure that wherever travellers encounter Aesop across APAC, they experience the same depth of knowledge, generosity of consultation and distinctive sense of place that define the brand.

title: Director of studies
description:

Manage relationships with local and French institutional partners linked to the activity of the Language Centre

**Follow up and support teachers:** to be a resource person for pedagogical matters and / or technical problems (Smart Boards and digital books)
  
  
Be a backup, if necessary, for supervising exam and test sessions, plus some teaching needs
  
  
Manage the administrative team of the LC (2 academic coordinators + 2 registration officers): delegation of tasks, automatization of process, customer follow-up
  
  
Support Finance department in the reconciliation of courses / hours taught / payroll
  
  
Report and advise the Executive Director for the LC organisation, strategy, key figures and budget
  
  
Main KPI
  
  
Number of unique students
  
  
Number of registrations
  
  
Number of hours sold
  
  
Number of hours sold with Corporates
  
  
Number of new Contracts with Corporates
  
  
Number of DELF registrations
  
  
Gross margin of the LC
  
  
**Starting date:** 5 January 2027
  
  
From Tuesday to Saturday 9.30 to 18.30
  
  
Apply by 6 December 2026
  
  
**To Executive Director:** aude-emeline.loriot@alliancefrancaise.org.sg
  
  
**Barbara Chan:** finance-HR@alliancefrancaise.org.sg
  
  
**Virgile Prodhomme :** directorofstudies@alliancefrancaise.org.sg
  
  
Alliance Française de Singapour was founded in 1949. It is a non-profit educational and cultural organization, affiliated to the international network of Alliance Française. With more than 800 locations in 132 countries, the Alliance Française is undoubtedly the world’s largest network of any cultural association; it serves and gathers worldwide a multilingual and multicultural community of Francophiles.
  
  
Each year, Alliance Française de Singapour welcomes around 4,000 members of all ages (from 1 year old onwards) eager to learn the French language and explore French culture. It is also hosting the General Delegation of the Alliance Française in South East Asia, making it the flagship of the region.
  
  
For many years, Alliance Française de Singapour has offered a great array of cinema and performing arts events in its theatre as well as various visual art exhibitions in
  
  
la galerie
  
  
becoming a renowned cultural destination.
  
  
In the buzzing evolving Singaporean cultural landscape, Alliance Française continues to contribute in its modest fashion to the regional influence of the cultural scene of the City-State by positioning itself as a place of cultural expression for emerging artists of all disciplines. It articulates its cultural programming around five major events: the Francophonie Festival in March, the French Animation Film Festival in May, the International Music Day in June, the French Film Festival in November and the Fashion Artisan Week in December. Added to these major events are many other regular cultural
  
  
rendez-vous
  
  
: the Ciné-Club, the Ciné-Kids, the Ciné-Plus and the storytelling in
  
  
la médiathèque
  
  
. Alliance Française also organizes social events (Bastille Day, French Friday) where our students and public can enjoy a taste of French flavors while using the French language.
  
  
Most of our events are organized in partnership with the unfailing support of the French Embassy/Institut Français Singapour and local partners.
  
  
Alliance Française cultural and educational programming is extremely rich and coherent in achieving its goal: to create a desire of France (and French) to an everlasting greater community of people whose strength is built from crosscultural understanding which is at the heart of all dialogue.

title: Senior Manager, Program Management – Insurance
description:
**Job Description:**

DXC Technology (NYSE: DXC) is a leading enterprise technology and innovation partner delivering software, services, and solutions to global enterprises and public sector organizations — helping them harness AI to drive outcomes at a time of exponential change with speed. With deep expertise in Managed Infrastructure Services, Application Modernization, and Industry-Specific Software Solutions, DXC modernizes, secures, and operates some of the world's most complex technology estates. Learn more on dxc.com.

**Senior Manager – Program Management**

**Insurance Software & Business Process Services (ISB)**

About the Team / Offering – Insurance Software & BPS

DXC Technology’s Insurance Software and Business Process Services (ISB) business helps insurers worldwide modernize, transform, and operate their core business operations at scale. By combining deep insurance industry expertise, market-leading software platforms, global delivery capabilities, and innovative AI-driven solutions, ISB enables insurers to accelerate digital transformation, improve operational efficiency, and enhance customer experiences.

As a global leader in insurance technology, ISB delivers solutions spanning policy administration, underwriting, claims management, billing, analytics, and digital engagement across Life & Annuity, Property & Casualty, and Specialty insurance markets.

Join a team at the forefront of insurance transformation, where you will help shape the technology platforms and business processes that support some of the world's leading insurers and millions of policyholders.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an accomplished **Senior Manager – Program Management** to lead a large-scale, multi-year insurance software transformation program for a major global insurance client.

This is a senior, highly visible, client-facing leadership position with end-to-end accountability for program execution, delivery performance, governance, and client satisfaction across multiple countries and complex transformation workstreams.

You will provide strategic direction and operational leadership to a large, geographically distributed delivery organization of approximately 150–200 professionals, including multiple Project Managers and cross-functional delivery teams. Working closely with senior client executives, including CIOs, CXOs, CEOs, and other key stakeholders, you will align business objectives, technology implementation, and delivery commitments.

The successful candidate will bring a strong track record of leading complex enterprise technology transformation programs, managing executive-level client relationships, navigating challenging delivery environments, and driving successful outcomes at scale.

This role offers a unique opportunity to lead a significant global insurance transformation initiative and influence how a leading insurer modernizes its core policy, underwriting, and claims platforms.

**Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities**

* **Program Leadership & Delivery:** Provide overall strategic and operational leadership for a large-scale, complex, multi-year software implementation and transformation program spanning multiple countries, business units, and workstreams.
* **End-to-End Accountability:** Own the program lifecycle and delivery outcomes, ensuring commitments related to scope, schedule, quality, financial performance, and agreed deliverables are met.
* **Large-Scale Organization Leadership:** Lead and oversee a delivery organization of approximately 150–200 resources, including multiple Project Managers, workstream leads, and cross-functional teams.
* **Executive Client Engagement:** Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, including CIOs, CXOs, CEOs, and executive leadership teams. Act as a key point of contact for strategic program matters.
* **Program Governance:** Establish and maintain robust program governance structures, operating models, performance metrics, executive reporting, and decision-making forums to ensure transparency, accountability, and effective oversight.
* **Stakeholder Alignment:** Drive alignment between client business objectives, expectations, implementation strategies, and delivery execution throughout the program lifecycle.
* **Scope and Change Management:** Lead scope management, change control processes, impact assessments, and commercial discussions. Facilitate negotiations on scope changes, priorities, timelines, and associated delivery commitments.
* **Risk, Issue & Dependency Management:** Proactively identify and manage program-level risks, issues, dependencies, and delivery challenges. Lead complex escalations and ensure timely resolution through appropriate governance channels.
* **Global Delivery Coordination:** Orchestrate delivery across multiple countries, locations, teams, and workstreams, ensuring effective collaboration, consistent execution, and adherence to program objectives.
* **Delivery Performance & Continuous Improvement:** Monitor overall program health, delivery milestones, resource utilization, and performance against agreed commitments. Drive corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives where required.
* **Commercial & Financial Oversight:** Provide oversight of program financials, resource planning, delivery costs, contractual commitments, and commercial performance in collaboration with relevant business and account leadership.
* **Leadership & Team Development:** Build a high-performing leadership team, establish clear accountability across Project Managers and delivery leads, and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and results-driven execution.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Extensive experience as a Senior Program Manager, Program Director, or equivalent senior delivery leader, with a proven track record of successfully leading large-scale technology transformation programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex software implementation programs involving multiple projects, workstreams, and delivery teams simultaneously.
* Proven ability to lead and manage large delivery organizations, ideally comprising approximately 150–200 resources and multiple Project Managers.
* Significant experience delivering multi-country, regional, or global transformation programs.
* Experience managing complex, multi-year enterprise technology implementation and transformation initiatives.
* Strong executive-level client engagement experience, with the ability to influence and manage relationships with CIOs, CXOs, CEOs, and senior business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated expertise in program governance, delivery management, scope control, change management, risk and issue management, and executive reporting.
* Strong commercial and financial management capabilities, including experience managing program budgets, resource plans, contractual commitments, and change requests.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong leadership capabilities, with the ability to navigate complex organizational structures, manage competing priorities, and drive accountability across geographically distributed teams.
* Ability to operate effectively in a high-pressure, complex client environment while maintaining focus on delivery outcomes and client satisfaction.
* May require the ability to obtain a security clearance.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the insurance industry, particularly in insurance software implementation, core platform modernization, or business transformation.
* Experience delivering large-scale core insurance platform implementations across Policy Administration, Underwriting, Claims, and Billing.
* Familiarity with Life & Annuity, Property & Casualty, or Specialty insurance business processes and operating models.
* Experience working with leading insurance software platforms and enterprise technology solutions.

title: Safeguarding Controller - APAC
description:
Working alongside an existing team of Safeguarding specialists and reporting to the Global Safeguarding Accountable Owner, your role is to assist each of the existing controllers and product managers in ensuring the APAC safeguarding control framework runs smoothly. The role will span across both safeguarding for payments and e-money and investment business and offers a fantastic opportunity to learn about the handovers between the regimes. You will also be joining at an exciting time of product growth and expansion..
  
  
Your Mission
  
  
You will play a crucial role in ensuring that new product launches are compliant with safeguarding regulations and controlled in a proportionate manner
  
  
You will be responsible for ensuring completeness of our policies and procedures and coordinate with individual controllers to obtain attestations of the controls operation and alignment to the controls framework
  
  
You will be responsible for coordinating and implementing a first line of defence assurance for APAC safeguarding controls
  
  
You will be responsible for maintaining the APAC safeguarding risk and controls matrix for the APAC entities
  
  
You will be the first point of escalation of discrepancies identified by the Reconciliations team for safeguarding reconciliations and provide SME advise on their resolution and treatment
  
  
You will be involved in the incidents management process and link incidents to control failures, which will enable senior management to see themes within the control environment
  
  
You will be responsible for MAS regulatory reporting and other safeguarding regulatory reporting preparation
  
  
You will be responsible for the annual safeguarding audit coordination
  
  
You will help document, challenge and build an end-to-end view of our internal control environment to illustrate key risks, controls and processes. This will all be done within our internal risk management software
  
  
Opportunities
  
  
Own your own path of success - You’ll have a high level of autonomy and responsibility.
  
  
Grow with the role - You will have the exposure and opportunity to speak to key senior members of the organisation getting into the details of remediation steps. You will be able to develop your technical skills and knowledge by being involved in several change management programmes relating to regulatory uplifts across different territories as well as related to implementing new products or features working with our engineering team to ensure these are safeguarding compliant.
  
  
Stepping stone - This role provides an excellent platform for someone looking to step into the safeguarding function of a fast-growing Fintech.
  
  
Develop an in-depth knowledge of Wise’s business - Get to know many teams across the business as you partner with them as part of day-to-day activities.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**A bit about you:**  
Technical knowledge - You have 5-8 years CASS (Client Assets Sourcebook) / Customer Moneys and Assets Protection (CMAP) framework experience in APAC (Singapore preferred) across investment business and payments.
  
  
Theory - You have strong understanding of Payments Services Act (PSA) under MAS.
  
  
Practice - You have sound writing skills and ability to convey regulation in a clear manner to fellow colleagues who are not SMEs and communicate key risks related to these regulations
  
  
Love getting things done - You are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and take responsibility to do whatever needs doing to solve problems. You take a proactive approach in resolving complex issues. We get it done!
  
  
Commercial acumen - You understand the value of taking a balanced approach to risk and controls to support the growth of the business.
  
  
Collaborative - You work well in a multinational team environment and know how to have an impact through others. No Drama Good Karma!
  
  
Development - You are keen to learn and develop your knowledge of how a FinTech and fast growing scale-up operates.
  
  
Our Safeguarding team is spread across the globe, but mainly in London and Tallinn, so there are some video calls and some travel involved for treasury wide initiatives.
  
  
Who we are
  
  
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move money around the world. With the Wise account people and businesses can hold over 40 currencies, move money between countries and spend money abroad. Large companies and banks use Wise technology too; an entirely new cross-border payments network that will one day power money without borders for everyone, everywhere. However you use the platform, Wise is on a mission to make your life easier and save you money.
  
  
Co-founded by Kristo Käärmann and Taavet Hinrikus, Wise launched in 2011 under its original name TransferWise. It is one of the world’s fastest growing, profitable technology companies and is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker, WISE.
  
  
16 million people and businesses use Wise. In fiscal year 2023, Wise processed approximately £105 billion in cross-border transactions, saving customers around £1.5 billion.
  
  
What it’s really like to work here
  
  
At Wise, we do things a bit differently. There’s no corporate nonsense, and no old-fashioned hierarchy. Instead, we work in dozens of self-sufficient, autonomous teams. Think of them like start-ups within a start-up that learn from each other.
  
  
Each team picks the problems they want to solve. So there’s no micro-management. No hiding behind fancy job titles. And no one telling you what to do. You are your own boss. But you’ll get tons of guidance and plenty of support from talented, super-smart colleagues from all over Wise.
  
  
We’re going to be upfront — the way we work doesn’t suit everyone. But if freedom, autonomy, and life-affirming, head-scratching professional challenges rock your world, we could be a match made in heaven.

title: AVP, Audit Manager, Group Governance and Corporate Functions Audit
description:
**WHO WE ARE:**
===============

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

**Why Join**
============

Join OCBC to be part of a dynamic and forward-thinking organisation that values innovation and collaboration. In Group Audit, you’ll enjoy a unique perspective across the Bank, gaining insights into diverse functions while driving impactful change. It’s an opportunity to strengthen governance, assess risks, and contribute to the Bank’s resilience and OneGroup vision. With continuous learning opportunities, it’s a rewarding role for those passionate about making a difference.

**How You Succeed**
===================

To succeed in Group Audit at OCBC, one must combine critical thinking with a keen eye for detail. Build strong stakeholder relationships, ask the right questions, and challenge assumptions. Leverage data analytics for sharper insights and stay updated on emerging risks and trends. Managing multiple priorities, adapting to complex situations, and maintaining independence are key. Resilience and effective communication will help navigate challenges and deliver impactful, high-quality audit outcomes.

**What You Do**
===============

**Audit Management**

* Support the Group Portfolio Leads and/or Senior Audit Managers in Group-wide audit engagements, including planning, scoping, risk assessments and communication. Ensure that risks and control deficiencies related to the governance framework, risk management, regulatory compliance processes and internal control systems of the OCBC Banking Group have been identified, appropriately assessed, and reported.
* Conduct Group-wide audits/reviews on:
* Financial Crime Compliance (including fraud risk);
* Operational Risk Management (including Business Continuity Management, Self-assessment and Third-party Risk Management, etc);
* Legal and Regulatory Compliance and key activities of the corporate functions (including Human Resources, Brand and Communications, Corporate Secretariat, etc); and
* Property and Procurement Services.
Participate in the provision of advisory services and ad-hoc reviews (e.g. special reviews at the request of senior management or regulators) with the objective of adding value and improving the governance, risk management, and control processes of the OCBC Banking Group, without Group Audit assuming management responsibility.  

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work as business partners with stakeholders and senior leadership across the Group, to communicate audit findings and agree on appropriate risk mitigation and remediation actions.
* Foster strong and enduring relationships with the business and act as a trusted advisor on risk and controls related to financial crime compliance, operational risk management as well as the key activities of the corporate functions.
* Support the Group Functional Head and/or Group Portfolio Lead in identifying any need for changes to the audit plan to address any emerging risks and concerns, regulatory developments or shifts in the OCBC Banking Group’s corporate strategy.
Provide regular updates to the Group Functional Head and/or Group Portfolio Lead and senior management on audit progress, key risks and action plans.  

**Team Management**

* Support the execution of guest auditor programs.
* Complete working papers for audits/reviews through documenting the work conducted, describing the work performed and the evidence that supports the observations and conclusions, as well as reviewing the work performed by other team members.
Promote innovation by encouraging the use of advanced data analytics, automation, and AI/ML tools to enhance audit efficiency and effectiveness.  

**Internal Audit Practice Management**

* Apply audit methodology, standards, and practices that are relevant to the OCBC Banking Group, taking into consideration leading practices in internal auditing.

* Support the implementation of a quality assurance and improvement program to assess Group Audit’s conformance with the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing and establish measures to address any gaps and enhance internal audit practices.

Where necessary, assist the Group Portfolio Lead in engaging external service provider for co-sourcing of internal audit activities, ensuring adequate oversight of the external service provider.  

  

**Who You Work With**
=====================

Group Audit is all about oversight. Gaining experience of the bank in its entirety. Gathering insight. Building Risk and Controls expertise. Advising leadership. You might join us in Global Markets, Risk and Finance Audit, Credit Risk Audit, Investigation, Professional Practices and Governance or Audit Analytics. But wherever you are, your work with clients from around the world drives innovation and makes audit an artform.

**Who You Are**
===============

* Holds a bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g. Business, Accountancy, etc.)
* Professional certifications such as CPA, CA, CIA and/or ACAMS are highly preferred
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in auditing or other risk control functions
* Strong understanding of risks and controls pertaining to Banking, with a focus on financial crime compliance (including fraud risk), regulatory compliance, operational risk management and corporate functions
* Good written, verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical issues into relevant business context for senior management
* Ability to work effectively as a team member, with the requisite analytical skills to perform detailed/technical work without losing sight of the ‘big picture’ issues
* High level of integrity, drive, and ability to work under pressure
* Data analytics skills (e.g. knowledge of Python, Power BI or other data analytics tool) are preferred
* undefined

**What we offer:**
==================

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

title: Financial Lines Underwriting Executive
description:

Delta Underwriting Singapore is part of Delta Insurance Group, an independent specialist Managing General Agent (MGA) founded in New Zealand in 2014. Today the Group operates across APAC.

Good knowledge of the Singapore and/or Asian Financial Lines market
  
  
An established broker network, or the drive to build one
  
  
Strong analytical skills and sound commercial judgement
  
  
Clear written and spoken communication, with confidence in negotiating
  
  
A relevant degree and/or professional qualification
  
  
About Us
  
  
Established in 2017, Delta Underwriting is the leading locally owned specialist underwriting firm and the first Financial Lines Lloyd’s Coverholder based in Singapore. We challenge the status quo by reshaping our approach to insurance through product, technology and service innovation. We currently provide insurance solutions to more than ten countries in the Asia Pacific region with Delta Insurance Group offices headquartered in New Zealand.

title: Associate, Internal Control (Job ID:10080744)
description:
MUFG is seeking a dedicated Internal Control Professional to join their Planning Department, Internal Control and Administration team for GCIB in Singapore. This role offers you the opportunity to play a pivotal part in ensuring robust governance and effective control activities across the division. You will be at the heart of maintaining high standards of compliance, supporting business continuity, and safeguarding information security within one of the world’s leading financial institutions. MUFG values your commitment to accuracy, your collaborative spirit, and your ability to connect with stakeholders across departments. The organisation is renowned for its supportive leadership, inclusive culture, and ongoing training opportunities that empower you to grow professionally while contributing meaningfully to the team’s success.
  
  
Join a globally respected financial institution where your attention to detail and commitment to quality will directly impact divisional governance and operational excellence.
  
  
Work closely with diverse teams and stakeholders, fostering strong inter-personal connections and sharing knowledge to ensure seamless implementation of internal controls.
  
  
Benefit from MUFG’s commitment to professional development, working opportunities, and a supportive team environment that values collaboration and knowledge sharing.
  
  
**What you'll do:**  
As an Internal Control professional at MUFG in Singapore, you will take on a multifaceted role spanning internal controls, governance, operational resilience and management support. Working closely with various departments, you will help ensure that GCIB maintains effective controls, appropriate governance standards and accurate control-related records.
  
  
Your responsibilities will include coordinating GCIB self-inspections, managing SOX reporting processes, tracking remediation actions and following up on findings through to closure. You will also coordinate business continuity management activities, including disaster recovery exercises, and maintain critical records such as call trees and next-of-kin information.
  
  
In addition to overseeing and driving greater consistency in SOPs and governance documentation on SharePoint, you will support non-system information security controls to help ensure appropriate standards for information handling are maintained. You will also monitor incidents and support timely escalation and reporting where required.
  
  
Your responsibilities will extend to vault governance, including record reconciliation and periodic access reviews, as well as the maintenance of authorities-related documentation, including Letters of Delegation of Authority, Deeds of Substitution and authorised signature lists.
  
  
You will also provide ad-hoc administrative and management support to help ensure the smooth running of the department. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, sound control awareness and the ability to work effectively across multiple stakeholders, while remaining flexible and adaptable to changing business priorities.
  
  

* Perform and coordinate GCIB self-inspection processes, SOX reporting and spreadsheet controls, including the management of findings, supporting evidence, remediation tracking and follow-up actions.
* Oversee and drive greater consistency in standard operating procedures (SOPs), RACI matrices and internal guidelines, and maintain related governance documentation on GCIB SharePoint.
* Perform and coordinate business continuity management activities, including business impact analysis, call tree and next-of-kin record maintenance, disaster recovery exercises and other related activities.
* Serve as PIC for non-system information security controls, including data-handling requirements and information security exceptions, in accordance with Bank policies.
* Serve as PIC for incident monitoring and reporting, ensuring timely escalation, communication and accurate documentation of events affecting divisional operations.
* Manage GCIB Vault governance, including regular record reconciliation, access reviews and implementation of relevant controls to safeguard sensitive materials.
* Serve as PIC for authorities-related governance, including Letters of Authority, Deeds of Substitution and Powers of Attorney, and maintain the division’s authorised signature list.
* Provide administrative and management support as assigned by the Head of Department or Management, including ad-hoc responsibilities that contribute to the effective operation of the team.
* Collaborate with relevant departments and stakeholders to support the timely and accurate implementation of internal requirements, Head Office procedures and Bank policies.
* Maintain robust control-related records and procedures and support effective governance across GCIB functions.

**What you bring:**  
To excel as an Internal Control professional at MUFG in Singapore, you bring proven experience from roles involving internal control or audit functions, ideally within financial services. Your academic background equips you with essential theoretical understanding while your practical experience ensures you can navigate complex regulatory environments confidently. You possess exceptional attention to detail which allows you not only to spot inconsistencies but also deliver high-quality results every time. Managing competing priorities under tight deadlines is second nature; you remain calm yet responsive even when demands escalate. Communication is one of your strengths—you engage openly with colleagues at all levels fostering trustful relationships that drive collective achievement. Professionalism defines how you handle sensitive matters; integrity guides every decision you make. Your proactive attitude means you anticipate needs before they arise while collaborating seamlessly within teams regardless of pace or change. Technical proficiency across Microsoft tools supports your daily workflow; familiarity with business continuity practices further enhances your contribution during emergencies or disruptions. Ultimately your blend of analytical skills, interpersonal abilities, industry knowledge and unwavering commitment, makes you an invaluable asset for this role.
  
  
Degree qualification is required for this position
  
  
**For Associate:** a minimum of five years’ experience in internal control, audit (internal or external), risk management, compliance or governance roles, preferably within a financial institution is essential for success.
  
  
Your strong attention to detail enables you to critically review information, identify gaps promptly, and deliver accurate outputs consistently.
  
  
The ability to manage multiple priorities under strict timelines demonstrates your organisational skills and commitment to dependable follow-through.
  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills allow you to work confidently with management as well as stakeholders across departments and locations.
  
  
Professionalism, integrity, and discretion are vital when handling confidential or sensitive information within the organisation.
  
  
A proactive approach combined with collaborative teamwork ensures you adapt comfortably in fast-paced environments while supporting colleagues effectively.
  
  
Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and Copilot, to support effective record-keeping, collaboration, and communication.
  
  
Experience supporting business continuity management activities adds value by enhancing operational resilience within the division. Familiarity with incident monitoring/reporting processes strengthens your ability to respond quickly during critical situations.
  
  
**What sets this company apart:**  
MUFG stands out as one of the world’s largest financial groups committed to delivering excellence through responsible banking practices. The company fosters an inclusive workplace where every team member’s voice is valued, encouraging collaboration across departments regardless of hierarchy or location. MUFG’s dedication to integrity permeates every aspect of its operations; employees are trusted partners who contribute meaningfully toward shared goals without compromising ethical standards. By joining MUFG’s Singapore office within GCIB’s Internal Control & Administration team you become part of a global network united by mutual respect, a place where knowledge-sharing thrives alongside innovation in governance practices.
  
  
We regret to inform that only shortlisted applicants will be notified.
  
  
**(Job ID:** 10080744)
  
  
MUFG Bank, Ltd. is Japan’s premier bank, with a global network spanning in more than 40 markets. Outside of Japan, the bank offers an extensive scope of commercial and investment banking products and services to businesses, governments and individuals worldwide. MUFG Bank’s parent, Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Inc. (MUFG) is one of the world’s leading financial groups. Headquartered in Tokyo and with over 360 years of history, the Group has about 120,000 employees and offers services including commercial banking, trust banking, securities, credit cards, consumer finance, asset management, and leasing.
  
  
The Group aims to be the world’s most trusted financial group through close collaboration among our operating companies and flexibly respond to all of the financial needs of our customers, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world. MUFG’s shares trade on the Tokyo, Nagoya, and New York stock exchanges.
  
  
For more information, visit
  
  
https://www.mufg.jp/english

title: Head of Ocean Freight – Singapore
description:
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a commercially driven and entrepreneurial Head of Ocean Freight – Singapore to establish and lead SF Express's ocean freight business in Singapore from the ground up.
  
  
Reporting to the Deputy Regional General Manager, this role will be responsible for building the foundational capabilities of the ocean freight business, including business strategy, product development, carrier and partner networks, operating processes, commercial capabilities and team structure.
  
  
While Singapore will be the primary market, the role will also develop cross-trade opportunities and collaborate with SF's ocean freight teams across Southeast Asia and the wider international network.
  
  
The initial priority will be to establish a sustainable and scalable ocean freight business platform, with a clear roadmap towards commercial growth and profitability.
  
  
Key Requirements
  
  
Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in international freight forwarding or integrated logistics, with substantial ocean freight commercial and management experience.
  
  
Proven experience in establishing, launching or significantly expanding an ocean freight business, business unit, branch or new market.
  
  
Strong end-to-end understanding of ocean freight business operations, including FCL/LCL products, carrier procurement, pricing, business development, operations and financial management.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to develop business strategies, build commercial and operational capabilities, establish industry partnerships and recruit high-performing teams.
  
  
Strong knowledge of the Singapore ocean freight market and regional trade lanes, with established industry relationships.
  
  
Entrepreneurial, commercially driven and hands-on, with the ability to operate effectively in a business-building environment.
  
  
Strong professional proficiency in both English and Mandarin Chinese, written and spoken, is mandatory for communication with local and international customers, business partners and SF's China headquarters.
  
  
Initial Priorities – First 12 Months
  
  
Develop a practical business strategy and phased implementation roadmap for the Singapore ocean freight business.
  
  
Establish the core ocean freight product portfolio, including FCL, LCL, import, export and cross-trade solutions.
  
  
Build carrier, co-loader, overseas agent and service-provider partnerships.
  
  
Design the appropriate operating model, SOPs, pricing framework and service delivery processes.
  
  
Propose and progressively build the ocean freight team in line with approved business plans.

title: Regulatory Compliance Officer
description:
**Job Description:**  
Ensure the Branch complies with all relevant regulatory requirements to support but not limited to Corporate Banking, Financial Institutions, Trade Finance, and Private Banking businesses.
  
  
Monitor regulatory developments and ensure timely updates to management and relevant departments on changes in laws, regulations, and compliance requirements including key regulatory regimes applicable to the Branch, including the Banking Act 1970, Financial Services and Markets Act 2022, Securities and Futures Act 2001 where relevant, MAS Notices and Guidelines, related parties transaction, outsourcing/third party risk assessment, AML/CFT/CPF, sanctions, FATCA/CRS, PDPA, outsourcing, technology risk management, conduct risk and cross-border business requirements.
  
  
Update Bank's obligation register updates, policy & procedures management, including supporting the gap analysis, regulatory system development, review, implementation and enhancements for its branch wide policy and procedures to ensure fulfill with Head Office and local regulatory requirements.

Investigate customer complaints and conduct ad hoc investigations as required.

Perform all other duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Head of Legal and Compliance.
  
  
**Requirements:**  
Degree in Law or finance or business with at least 3 years of relevant compliance experience in a bank or financial institution.
  
  
Practical, solutions-oriented and a keen eye for detail.
  
  
Proficient in English and Mandarin to liaise with internal and external Chinese stakeholders; liaise with head office on occasion.
  
  
Strong communication and negotiation skills to ensure compliance advice and policy and procedures to be followed by across function.
  
  
A good team player capable of working both independently and as a team

title: Project Procurement Manager, Process Excellence
description:
Bring more to life.
  
  
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
  
  
At Leica Microsystems, one of
  
  
Danaher’s
  
  
15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
  
  
You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
  
  
Shape the Future with Us!
  
  
At Leica Microsystems, we have been shaping the future for over 175 years with groundbreaking optical and digital solutions. With a culture rooted in customer focus, innovation, and teamwork, we lead the market in microscopy, imaging, and analysis, unveiling the invisible and empowering our customers to build a better, healthier world.
  
  
Joining Leica Microsystems means contributing to scientific discoveries and supporting surgeons in making critical decisions. Our advanced microscopes and AI-based image analysis solutions enable users to gain profound insights into development and engineering challenges. Here, you will work on meaningful projects alongside passionate colleagues, driving progress and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
  
  
Learn about the
  
  
Danaher Business System
  
  
which makes everything possible.
  
  
The
  
  
Project Procurement Manager, Process Excellence
  
  
is a hybrid individual-contributor role combining New Product Introduction (NPI) and strategic project procurement with procurement process excellence and compliance. The role ensures that sourcing requirements are integrated early into product development while strengthening standardized, scalable, and compliant ways of working across Global Sourcing.
  
  
Acting as a cross-functional interface across R&D, Project Management, Operations, Quality, Commodity Management, Finance, Legal, IT, Audit, and DBS, the role combines hands-on project procurement execution with global process ownership and continuous improvement.
  
  
This position reports to the
  
  
Global Head of Project Procurement & Process Excellence
  
  
and is part of Global Sourcing organisation, located in Singapore and will be an
  
  
on-site role
  
  
.
  
  
**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**  
Lead project procurement and sourcing readiness for assigned NPI and other strategic projects from early development through industrialization and handover, including procurement scope, sourcing plans, milestones, resource needs, budgets, supplier selection, qualification and readiness, prototype and pre-series sourcing, material availability, project risks and recovery actions.
  
  
Drive early supplier involvement, cost optimization and commercial activities by partnering with R&D, Quality, Industrial Engineering, Commodity Management and other stakeholders on design reviews, Design-to-Cost, standardization, modularization and make-or-buy assessments; analyzing cost drivers and Total Cost of Ownership; and negotiating project-related commercial terms and development agreements in alignment with applicable approval processes.
  
  
Design, implement and continuously improve procurement processes across Global Sourcing, including end-to-end processes, procedures, templates, roles and controls; drive standardization and harmonization across regions, sites and teams; maintain assigned procurement playbook content; and support process ownership, governance, version control and training.
  
  
Advance procurement process excellence, performance and digitalization by applying DBS and structured problem-solving methods to identify root causes, eliminate waste and reduce manual effort; identify automation and digitalization opportunities; translate business needs into requirements for procurement systems and tools; and define and track process KPIs, adoption metrics and improvement actions.
  
  
Strengthen procurement compliance, governance and risk management by maintaining procurement-specific governance frameworks, procedures, controls and evidence requirements; performing process compliance reviews and risk assessments; coordinating corrective and preventive actions; supporting supplier due diligence, onboarding and third-party risk management; and representing Global Sourcing in relevant internal and external audits.
  
  
**The essential requirements of the job include:**  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
  
  
Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in project procurement, sourcing, supply chain, procurement process management, compliance, or operational excellence within a manufacturing environment.
  
  
Demonstrated experience supporting NPI or product-development projects, including supplier selection, prototype sourcing, industrialization readiness, cost management, and project risk mitigation.
  
  
Proven experience in procurement process improvement, including process mapping, standardization, continuous improvement, governance, and implementation of sustainable changes.
  
  
Experience in commercial and contract negotiations and working knowledge of procurement systems and digital tools such as SAP, e-procurement platforms, Microsoft Office, Power BI, workflow tools, and process-mapping applications.
  
  
**Travel Requirements:**  
Willingness to travel internationally, estimated up to 20%.
  
  
**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**
  
  
·
  
  
Project management or continuous-improvement certification, such as PMP, Lean, or Six Sigma.
  
  
High-mix, low-volume, medical device, life science, or precision-instrument environments.
  
  
Process-management or audit/compliance training.

Danaher Benefits Info
  
  
.

title: Head of Talent Acquisition, APAC
description:
**Description**

Meltwater is seeking a strategic and hands-on Head of Talent Acquisition, APAC to lead talent acquisition across the Asia-Pacific region. This leader will partner closely with regional business and People leaders to build strong talent strategies, improve hiring quality and speed, strengthen recruiting capability, and ensure a consistent, inclusive candidate experience across APAC markets.

The successful candidate will balance strategic leadership with practical execution. They will use data, market insight, technology, and strong stakeholder partnerships to help Meltwater attract, assess, and hire exceptional talent while building a high-performing regional Talent Acquisition function.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own APAC Talent Acquisition strategy including end-to-end sourcing and recruiting across all functions, with a heavy emphasis on GTM hiring with the ability to support broader regional workforce priorities
* Partner with APAC leadership, people leaders and hiring managers to understand workforce plans, define critical hiring priorities and create practical recruiting strategies
* Lead, coach, and develop the APAC Talent Acquisition team clarifying goals, strengthening capability, and creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Establish consistent, high-quality recruiting practices while adapting appropriately to local market requirements and candidate expectations
* Improve hiring outcomes through structured intake, calibrated assessment, effective interview practices, and clear decision-making and ownership across the hiring process
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and provide market insight, talent data, and recommendations that support sound workforce decisions
* Strengthen sourcing strategies, employer brand, talent pipelines, and regional market presence across the APAC markets
* Partner with People, Legal, HRIS, Total Rewards, and other teams to support compliant and effective hiring practices.
* Use recruiting data and technology to identify trends, improve processes, and increase efficiency and strengthen the candidate and hiring manager experience
* Support Meltwater’s evolving approach to AI in Talent Acquisition, including responsible adoption and safeguards against fraudulent or misrepresented candidate activity.
* Promote inclusive hiring practices and ensure recruitment decisions are fair, consistent and grounded in job-related evidence
* Contribute to global Talent Acquisition programs and represent APAC perspectives in global initiatives.

**How You’ll Work with AI**

At Meltwater, we believe AI fluency, curiosity, and responsible experimentation are increasingly important to how we work and create value for our customers. In this role, you will be encouraged to understand how AI can improve your work, enhance decision-making, increase efficiency, and help us build better experiences and solutions. You do not need to be an AI expert, but you should be curious, open to learning, and thoughtful about using AI responsibly.

As a Talent Acquisition leader, you will help the team build practical AI fluency, identify meaningful opportunities to use AI-enabled tools, and establish safeguards that protect candidate fairness, privacy, authenticity, and human judgment. This includes supporting responsible adoption of AI in sourcing, market analysis, recruiting operations, interview preparation, and reporting, while helping the organization detect and address fraudulent or misrepresented candidate activity. AI should support, not replace, human accountability, candidate relationships, collaboration, and hiring decisions

**What You’ll Bring**

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience leading Talent Acquisition across multiple APAC markets, especially India, China, Australia and Japan
* Strong understanding of APAC talent markets, employment laws, and market considerations.
* Proven experience leading, coaching and developing recruiters across a range of experience levels
* Strong business partnership skills with the ability to influence senior leaders and hiring managers and translate business priorities into hiring strategies
* Experience building, improving and glocalizing regional recruiting strategies, operating models and processes.
* Demonstrated ability to use recruiting data and insights to guide decisions, communicate processes and improve outcomes.
* Experience managing multiple priorities in an agile international organization including the ability to collaborate effectively across cultures, functions and time zones
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, organizational and problem-solving skills.
* A demonstrated commitment to inclusive hiring and a fair, consistent candidate experience.
* Ability to legally work in the country of hire is required for this position.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience recruiting GTM talent in a global technology, SaaS, media intelligence, or similarly fast-paced organization.
* Experience leading recruiting transformation, process improvement, or Talent Acquisition technology initiatives.
* Experience partnering with teams across multiple time zones and cultures.
* Experience using recruiting analytics, AI-enabled tools, or structured assessment practices to improve hiring quality.
* Experience supporting both commercial and corporate hiring across a regional organization.
* Professional fluency in one or more APAC languages relevant to Meltwater’s hiring markets

**What We Offer**

Meltwater offers a competitive total rewards package designed to support our employees’ growth, wellbeing, and success.

Benefits and country-specific offerings vary by location and will be confirmed based on the final hiring country.

**What’s Next**

The interview process is expected to include conversations with Talent Acquisition, People leadership, regional business stakeholders, and relevant global partners.

**Where You’ll Work**

This role will be based in Singapore, our address is 60 Anson Rd, #18-03 #18-03A, Singapore 079. We work in a hybrid environment encouraging in-office time 2-3 days a week.

**When You’ll Join**

Start date: Early 2027

**Our Story**

At Meltwater, we believe that when you have the right people in the right environment, great things happen.

Our platform empowers our 27,000 customers around the world by transforming global media, social, and AI signals into actionable intelligence that leaders rely on to make faster, confident decisions.

But we can’t do that without our global team of developers, innovators, problem-solvers, and high-performers who embrace challenges and find new solutions for our customers.

Our award-winning global culture drives everything we do and creates an environment where our employees can make an impact, learn every day, feel a sense of belonging, and celebrate each other’s successes along the way.

We are innovators at the core who see the potential in people, ideas and technologies. Together, we challenge ourselves to go big, be bold, and build best-in-class solutions for our customers.

We’re proud of our diverse team of 2,200+ employees in 50 locations across 25 countries around the world. No matter where you are, you’ll work with people who care about your success and get the support you need to unlock new heights in your career.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

Meltwater is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind: At Meltwater, we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity and strive to provide a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment.

All employment decisions at Meltwater are made based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by the applicable laws and regulations.

Meltwater does not tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, and we actively promote a culture of respect, fairness, and inclusivity. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities to apply and join us in our mission to drive innovation and make a positive impact in the world.

We may use AI to assist in aspects of our hiring process, such as reviewing candidate information, capturing interview notes, and supporting interview activities. These tools are used only to assist our team through increased efficiencies. Every output continues to be reviewed by humans, and all hiring decisions are made by humans. We remain committed to evaluating candidates fairly, consistently, and in compliance with all applicable laws.
