title: Sales Director APAC (Singapore-based)
description:
**About Kaiko**

Finance is moving onchain. Stocks, funds, bonds and cash are being tokenized, settlement is getting close to instant, and markets are starting to trade around the clock. That shift only works if every participant can trust the data it runs on.

Kaiko is that trusted data partner. Banks, asset managers, exchanges, market makers, fund administrators and regulators use us to price, trade, value, manage risk and report as markets become digital, global and always on.

**What we do**

* Market data: institutional-grade trade and order-book data from traditional, digital and onchain venues, normalized into one reliable source.
* Analytics: liquidity, market structure, derivatives and onchain insight that turn raw data into decisions.
* Indices and reference rates: transparent, rules-based 24/7 benchmarks and continuous pricing used to value portfolios, mark collateral and build investment products.
* Data infrastructure: resilient, always-on delivery through APIs, cloud, partner channels and AI-ready access, built into the systems our clients already use.

In September 2026, Kaiko extended its Series B to $110M, led by S&P Global, with BNP Paribas, Bpifrance, Broadridge, Canton, Coinbase Ventures, DRW Venture Capital, Nasdaq Ventures, Royal Bank of Canada, Stellar, and Susquehanna. This year we also acquired Amberdata and Cometh, which broadens our analytics, data and onchain capabilities. Kaiko is SOC 1 and SOC 2 certified and MiCA- and DORA-compliant: the standards institutions expect from a critical data provider.

**Who We Are**

We’re a team of over 100 passionate individuals with a deep interest in building data solutions and supporting the growth of the digital finance economy. We’re proud of Kaiko’s talented team and are committed to our international representation and diversity. Our people and their values are the foundation of our continued success.

### **About the Role**

The Sales Director - APAC will execute Kaiko’s APAC GTM strategy, set and track clear KPIs, achieve regional sales targets, and be a leader to the Kaiko APAC team.

The role is based out of Kaiko’s Singapore office, with necessary regional travels.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build a healthy, growing pipeline: generate opportunities (inbound and outbound) by identifying, contacting, qualifying prospects.
* Meet and exceed ARR booking quotas: prospect in a smart way and book qualified meetings with decision-makers, negotiate contracts, work with legal to write agreements, and close deals.
* Participate in events in your region to proactively approach new prospects.
* Execute sales strategies to accelerate growth. Influence and implement the sales playbook, create and execute territory plan, and prepare and drive accurate revenue forecasts.
* Actively participate in closing complex opportunities in collaboration with Kaiko team members and develop an extensive partner network, building effective relationships across the target landscape and across the broader ecosystem.
* Leverage and maintain internal Sales dashboard and tools.
* Effective coordination with the Kaiko global sales team, and operations, product, engineering, and legal teams to execute and meet sales objectives.
* Mentor juniors and lead by example.

  

**Must Haves**

* Background and experience in decentralized finance and blockchains
* Understanding of traditional finance markets and financial concepts (rates, indices, risk management tools such as implied volatility and surface vol, trades and order-book data, etc.)
* Excellent commercial skills with a strategic mindset
* Ability to develop and nurture relationships
* Excellent communication skills
* Fluent English - both written and spoken, with proficiency in at least one additional language (Mandarin, Korean, Japanese)

  

**Nice to have**

* Strong affinity and exposure to the financial data industry, specifically with experience in crypto or similar markets.
* Ability to listen carefully, understand needs and build trusted relationships, including at senior executive level in large complex organisations.
* Have sold to financial institutions and bring strong pattern recognition in this space along with the exposure to broader B2B SaaS.

**What we offer**

* 24 paid holidays
* Great health insurance
* Contribution to your monthly gym subscription
* Remote-friendly position
* Multiple team events (annual retreat, casual drinks, etc.)
* An entrepreneurial environment with a lot of autonomy and responsibilities
  

**Talent Acquisition Process**

* Call with HR
* Call with the Hiring Manager
* Cross team interview with 2-3 team members
* Case study
* Reference Check & Offer

**Interested?**

Write a short letter to tell us why you’d be a good fit for this opportunity and why you’d like to join Kaiko then send it to us along with your CV. We look forward to reading your application.

As our working language is English, we would appreciate it if you send us your application and accompanying documents in English.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

At Kaiko, we believe in the diversity of thought because we appreciate that this makes us stronger. Therefore, we encourage applications from everyone who can offer their unique experience to our collective achievements.

Reporting to the Associate Director (Enterprise Partnership) or Associate Dean, depending on seniority, the incumbent will lead corporate outreach and business development initiatives to promote NUS' education and training programmes, establish strategic partnerships and drive business growth.

The position is offered on an initial 3-year renewable contract, with the possibility of conversion to regular employment, subject to satisfactory performance. Remuneration follows a 12-month salary structure, with an annual variable bonus subject to performance and prevailing University policies. Appointment grade will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.

* Develop and implement business development strategies to expand and diversify the corporate client base across public and private sectors.

* Develop and present customised training proposals, converting business opportunities into confirmed engagements and repeat partnerships.

* Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify emerging trends and inform business development strategies.

* Organise and participate in corporate engagement events to enhance institutional visibility and strengthen partnerships.

* At least 8 years’ relevant work experience, with at least the last 4 years in a similar capacity.
* Highly client conversant, analytical and meticulous.
* Strong business development, project management and administration skills.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication (verbal & written) and presentation skills; flexible in adapting public speaking/presentation styles to audience of diverse background and culture.
* Confident to engage staff members and with external stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong team player, able to work collaboratively with various stakeholders to achieve desired outcomes.
* Independent, resilient, resourceful and with good problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
* Energetic and self-motivated, results-driven and disciplined.
* Thrives in a fast- paced, results-oriented and ambiguous work environment.

  

To expedite application processing, a copy of academic certificates and transcripts from GCE O-level onwards should be uploaded via the online application portal. title: Engineering Director, APAC
description:
Global Switch are recruiting for an Engineering Director, based in Singapore, who will set the strategic direction and provide accountable leadership for engineering delivery across Global Switch’s data centre portfolio across Asia Pacific. This is an exciting time within Global Switch as we expand our presence in Asia Pacific with new data centres planned in Johor, Malaysia and Bangkok, Thailand. These will sit alongside our existing best-in-class data centres in Singapore and Hong Kong. You will ensure our engineering designs, standards and practices deliver resilient, cost-effective and sustainable infrastructure that supports our business objectives and evolving customer needs. Working closely with Operations, Projects and external partners, you will translate complex engineering challenges into clear, commercially sound decisions, optimise total cost of ownership and embed innovation across power, cooling and critical infrastructure systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide strategic and technical oversight of engineering designs, client briefs and infrastructure assessments, ensuring risks, defects and Single Points of Failure are identified and effectively addressed.
* Partner with Operations, Projects, OEMs and external specialists to improve resilience, maintenance outcomes and procurement, with a strong focus on whole-life cost, technical quality and operational performance.
* Lead, develop and inspire a high-performing engineering team, creating clear accountability and a collaborative culture that can deliver confidently through change, complexity and ambiguity.
* Drive sustainability, innovation and continuous improvement across power, cooling and critical infrastructure, improving energy and water efficiency, strengthening engineering governance and embedding lessons learned across future projects.

**About you**  
  
You are an accomplished engineering leader with the technical credibility, commercial judgement and strategic perspective to influence at senior level. You can balance long-term engineering strategy with practical delivery, bringing clarity to complex technical issues and building strong relationships across functions, regions and cultures. You take ownership, remain composed under pressure and create an environment in which people are encouraged to collaborate, innovate and continuously improve.  
  
**Key Requirements:**

* Significant senior engineering leadership experience within data centres, mission-critical infrastructure or another complex, highly regulated engineering environment.
* Deep technical understanding of critical infrastructure design, power and cooling systems, infrastructure resilience, defect remediation and engineering risk management.
* A strong track record of leading and developing engineering teams, setting clear standards and driving performance, accountability and cultural change.
* Strong commercial awareness, including experience of procurement, OEM and supplier relationships, capital investment decisions and total cost of ownership.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical matters clearly, influence without formal authority and align regional delivery with global strategy.

**About Global Switch**  
Global Switch is a trusted name in the industry, with over 25 years of experience and a commitment to long-term partnerships and sustainability.  
  
We value excellence and teamwork, and we always strive to deliver the best customer service and satisfaction. We are a team of skilled and passionate professionals, proud of who we are and what we do. Joining us means becoming part of a team that values learning and growth.  
  
**As an equal-opportunity employer, Global Switch is committed to providing a working culture that values diversity and inclusion and is committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a barrier-free recruitment process and working environment.**

title: Senior Operations Manager (Shipping)
description:
Our client is a major Oil & Gas commodity trading firm headquartered in China, with a significant presence in the downstream energy sector. They are currently expanding their Shipping Operations team and are seeking a
  
  
Senior Operations Manager (Shipping)
  
  
to support their growing operations.
  
  
Reporting to the Managing Director, the incumbent will be leading a team of 4 staff and overseeing the overall shipping operations function. He / She will be responsible for managing end-to-end vessel operations, ensuring efficient voyage execution, operational compliance and alignment with commercial requirements.

The role also involves overseeing vessel vetting and compliance requirements, monitoring voyage performance, managing laytime and demurrage matters, and resolving operational disputes and claims, ensuring proper handling of shipping documentation, contractual obligations and operational risk matters, while maintaining effective controls over voyage-related costs and disbursements.
  
  
Successful applicants can look forward to work within an established organization with global footprint.

Min a Bachelor’s Degree in Maritime Studies, Logistics, Shipping, or a related field
  
  
At least 8 years of working experience in the post-fixture shipping operations with min 2 years in a managerial position, preferably within Oil & Gas Commodity Trading house, shipowner firm, shipping firms, etc
  
  
Strong understanding of shipping & chartering operations, with good commercial acumen and stakeholder management skills
  
  
Good knowledge of voyage and time charter operations, vessel vetting, marine operations, cargo handling procedures and relevant industry compliance standards.

Sound understanding of charterparty obligations, shipping documentation, maritime risk management and relevant insurance matters.

title: Global Corporate Banking - Subsidiary Banking - Intra-Asia Greater China Desk, Managing Director
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

The senior Greater China Desk banker will play a key leadership role within the Intra-Asia Subsidiary Banking franchise, with primary responsibility for driving the growth of our Greater China corporate client business across Asia Pacific region.

The role will focus on deepening relationships with leading Greater China corporates as they expand their business, investments and financial activities across ASEAN and the broader Asia Pacific region. The successful candidate will combine strong senior-client connectivity in Greater China with a deep understanding of cross-border corporate banking, capital allocation, risk management and broader institutional banking product suite.

As a senior member of the Intra-Asia team, the individual will also help shape the strategic direction of the franchise, develop the Greater China coverage team and serve as a senior bench leader capable of taking the Intra-Asia Greater China business to the next level.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead the Greater China Intra-Asia growth strategy:
  + Drive sustainable revenue growth and returns from the Greater China portfolio. Maintain disciplined prioritization of capital and resources, with a strong focus on relationship returns, wallet capture and cross-product penetration.
  + Own and drive the strategy for Greater China-headquartered corporates operating and investing across Asia, with particularly focus on ASEAN and other priority platforms such as RTC, RHQ, IHQ in Hong Kong and Singapore corridors.
  + Identify structural growth themes and emerging client opportunities arising from Chinese corporates' regional and global expansion, including manufacturing relocation, supply-chain diversification, energy transition, digital infrastructure, technology, innovation economy and AI infrastructure sectors.
  + Translate these themes into actionable client strategies, prioritized prospect pipelines and measurable revenue opportunities.
  + Partner with Greater China and regional leadership to continuously refine the target client universe and resource allocation across the franchise.
* Drive senior client coverage and origination:
  + Develop trusted relationships with CFOs, Treasurers and other senior decision-makers at leading Greater China corporates.
  + Lead strategic dialogue with clients around their cross-border banking and financing needs, including payments/cash management, liquidity, trade finance, market FX and rates, lending, capital markets and other strategic financing solutions.
  + Originate complex, multi-product and multi-country opportunities by connecting clients with the bank's capabilities across markets and products.
  + Act as a senior escalation and relationship point for strategically important Greater China-headquartered clients across Asia Pacific region. Facilitate senior connectivity between Greater China corporate decision-makers and the bank's regional and global leadership.
  + Build effective coverage models that combine strong headquarters relationships with high-quality subsidiary coverage in destination markets. Coordinate client strategy across countries and products to ensure a consistent, enterprise-wide approach to priority relationships.
* Provide franchise leadership:
  + Serve as a senior member of the Intra-Asia leadership team and contribute to broader strategy and management of the franchise.
  + Provide leadership, coaching and sponsorship to Greater China Desks bankers and help develop the next generation of senior coverage talents.
  + Raise standards around client planning, origination, execution and senior stakeholder management.

Required Qualifications and Skillsets:

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related discipline.
* Minimum 13 years of relevant corporate banking experience, including coverage of China-linked clients and/or Greater China corridors.
* Significant corporate banking or institutional client coverage experience, ideally including substantial Greater China and cross-border responsibilities. Mandarin proficiency (spoken and written), aligned to client coverage needs.
* Strong understanding of transaction banking, markets, credit, trade finance, and the ability to connect these into cohesive client solutions. Proven relationship management and origination capability, including negotiation and long-term client stewardship.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating complex, multi-product and multi-country opportunities with multiple stakeholders and tight execution timelines. Strong analytical skills and commercial judgment, with the ability to align opportunities to risk appetite and controls.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills; ability to influence and coordinate across internal stakeholders and client teams. Strong organization skills with ability to manage multiple concurrent deliverables while maintaining execution quality and deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications and Skillsets:

* Familiarity with multinational subsidiary treasury operating models, including cross-border liquidity structures, cash concentration, and intercompany flows.
* Demonstrated leadership capability with a collaborative, team-oriented approach, effectively partnering across coverage and product stakeholders to drive shared objectives and business outcomes.
* Track record of effective partnership with Risk, Compliance, and Credit stakeholders in a high-control environment, including issue escalation and remediation support.

**ABOUT US**
  
  
J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

description:
Explore the possibilities across our global house of brands.

Defined by inclusivity rather than exclusivity, Tapestry embraces the exploration of individuality and invests in helping you grow personally and professionally. Every individual in our global house has the opportunity to make an impact, learn and be part of our growing and unique story.

At Tapestry, we have the freedom to express ourselves and run with our best ideas across Coach and Kate Spade New York. We share a profound belief in both our individual and collective potential, and know that with hard work and dedication, anything is possible.

  

Lead Merchandise Financial Planning (“MFP”), Consensus Demand Planning and Inventory Planning for the Business Unit (“BU”), serving as a strategic planning partner to the BU Head and Buying Leaders. You will translate commercial ambition into topline financial and inventory plans, orchestrate consensus demand planning, and drive decisions on inventory investment and coverage, while identifying risks and opportunities and mobilizing cross-functional action. You will own MFP, OTB and financial guardrails, while BU Buying Leaders retain accountability for commercial decisions, including assortment and ranging.

You will also lead the evolution to our next-generation integrated planning model, building more specialized Demand Planning capabilities and connected ways of working across the business.

  

**Merchandise Financial Planning, OTB & Coverage**
--------------------------------------------------

* Own the consolidated BU Merchandise Financial Plan, translating Global targets and the brand plan into sales, margin and inventory targets by category and linking growth blocks to the 5P framework (People/Consumer, Product, Price, Place and Promotion).

* Own the BU OTB and forward-cover position, ensuring inventory investment remains aligned with demand and financial targets.

* Lead investment trade-offs and decisions across product departments, resolving or escalating gaps to BU and Global targets.

* Own in-season reforecasting and validate chase & cancellation proposals against demand, coverage and OTB.

* Report on key MFP metrics to the Head of the BU and senior leadership.

**Consensus Demand Planning**
-----------------------------

* Lead the BU consensus demand planning process translating the brand plan's Five Ps assumptions (People/Consumer, Product, Price, Place and Promotion) into a credible view of consumer demand by category, challenging assumptions and driving alignment on a single consensus demand view.
* Drive the identification and resolution of gaps between the unconstrained demand plan, financial targets and inventory supportability, bringing forward risks, opportunities and recommended actions, and facilitating timely decisions and escalations.
* Model upside and downside scenarios, put a value on risks and opportunities in units, dollars, and margin and recommend where to place bets.
* Drive continuous improvement of the system-generated forecast by identifying performance gaps, capturing learnings from commercial adjustments and actual results, and feeding those insights back to Global Forecasting to refine the baseline.

* Hold the team accountable for forecast accuracy, bias and Forecast Value Add.

* Facilitate the Consensus Demand & Inventory Review as part of IBP governance.

**Inventory Planning & Deployment**
-----------------------------------

* Establish inventory targets and policies across all life-cycle segments, including SKU targets

* Oversee the VMI program and support execution of new programs and initiatives.

**Demand Planning Leadership & Transformation**
-----------------------------------------------

* Establish and champion best practices for SKU-level Demand Planning across the BU.

* Lead and develop the MFP, Consensus Demand and Inventory Planning organization, building future capability, talent and succession.

* Partner with the Global Forecasting function as it is established to shape forecasting capabilities, ensure BU commercial requirements are reflected in model design, and drive adoption, performance and continuous improvement within the BU.

* Lead the transition to our next-generation integrated planning model, building specialized Demand Planning capabilities and driving adoption of connected, exception-based ways of working that shift time from manual processes to higher-value judgment and decisions.

Hold teams accountable for using system data as the source of truth, resolving data-quality and reconciliation issues, and escalating matters to the appropriate Global standard owners.  



**Our Competencies for All Employees**  
**Courage** : Doesn’t hold back anything that needs to be said; provides current, direct, complete, and “actionable” positive and corrective feedback to others; lets people know where they stand; faces up to people problems on any person or situation (not including direct reports) quickly and directly; is not afraid to take negative action when necessary.
  
**Creativity** : Comes up with a lot of new and unique ideas; easily makes connections among previously unrelated notions; tends to be seen as original and value-added in brainstorming settings.
  
**Customer Focus** : Is dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal and external customers; gets first-hand customer information and uses it for improvements in products and services; acts with customers in mind; establishes and maintains effective relationships with customers and gains their trust and respect.
  
**Dealing with Ambiguity** : Can effectively cope with change; can shift gears comfortably; can decide and act without having the total picture; isn’t upset when things are up in the air; doesn’t have to finish things before moving on; can comfortably handle risk and uncertainty.
  
**Drive for Results** : Can be counted on to exceed goals successfully; is constantly and consistently one of the top performers; very bottom-line oriented; steadfastly pushes self and others for results.
  
**Interpersonal Savvy** : Relates well to all kinds of people, up, down, and sideways, inside and outside the organization; builds appropriate rapport; builds constructive and effective relationships; uses diplomacy and tact; can diffuse even high-tension situations comfortably.
  
**Learning on the Fly** : Learns quickly when facing new problems; a relentless and versatile learner; open to change; analyzes both successes and failures for clues to improvement; experiments and will try anything to find solutions; enjoys the challenge of unfamiliar tasks; quickly grasps the essence and the underlying structure of anything.
  
  
**Our Competencies for All People Managers**  
**Strategic Agility** : Sees ahead clearly; can anticipate future consequences and trends accurately; has broad knowledge and perspective; is future oriented; can articulately paint credible pictures and visions of possibilities and likelihoods; can create competitive and breakthrough strategies and plans.
  
**Developing Direct Reports and Others** : Provides challenging and stretching tasks and assignments; holds frequent development discussions; is aware of each person's career goals; constructs compelling development plans and executes them; pushes people to accept developmental moves; will take on those who need help and further development; cooperates with the developmental system in the organization; is a people builder.

title: Senior Manager, Group internal audit
description:
Be a Part of Something BIG!
  
  
The Senior Manager, Group Internal Audit – Technology is a senior specialist role within Singtel Group Internal Audit, reporting directly to the Audit director, and is responsible for providing independent, objective, and risk-based assurance over Singtel’s technology, cybersecurity, and digital environments. The Senior Manager leads and delivers complex technology and cybersecurity audits, engagements, overseeing audit planning, execution and reporting, and providing robust and evidence-based challenge to key stakeholders. The role contributes to the development of the technology audit plan and ensures audit outcomes are high quality, actionable, and support effective risk management and control improvement. Audit outputs contribute directly to management assurance, Audit Committee reporting, and regulatory disclosures. Group Internal Audit operates as a key pillar of Singtel’s corporate governance framework and reports functionally to the Singtel Group Audit Committee.
  
  
Make an Impact by
  
  
Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, risk-based technology and cybersecurity audits across Singtel Group.
  
  
Develop Audit Planning Memorandums (APMs), defining audit objectives, scope, risks, and audit approach.
  
  
Design and implement audit programs and procedures aligned to Group Internal Audit methodology and professional standards.
  
  
Assess the design and operating effectiveness of IT general controls, application controls, cybersecurity controls, and technology governance frameworks.
  
  
Evaluate major technology initiatives and systems under development to ensure appropriate governance, controls, documentation, and security-by-design.
  
  
Provide independent assurance over cybersecurity risk management, including protection of networks, cloud environments, systems, and sensitive data.
  
  
Assess compliance with relevant laws, regulations, industry standards, and Singtel policies (e.g. data protection, cybersecurity, technology risk).
  
  
Identify emerging technology risks and assess Singtel’s control maturity and risk posture.
  
  
Perform control advisory reviews for significant in-flight programs and strategic initiatives where required.
  
  
Identify root causes of control deficiencies and develop practical, commercially grounded recommendations.
  
  
Prepare high-quality audit reports with minimal supervision and ensure alignment and agreement of findings with senior management.
  
  
Lead audit kick-off and closing meetings with senior executives, ensuring clear communication of objectives, scope, findings, and risk implications.
  
  
Provide clear, credible challenge to senior stakeholders while maintaining strong professional relationships and audit independence.
  
  
Escalate significant or high-risk matters to the Audit Director and support Audit Committee reporting.
  
  
Coach, train, and review the work of less experienced auditors, embedding audit methodology, quality standards, and professional judgement.
  
  
Provide technical leadership in technology and cybersecurity auditing across the function.
  
  
Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of technology audit methodology, tools, and practices.
  
  
Oversee tracking and validation of management action plans and perform follow-up reviews to ensure timely and effective remediation.
  
  
Support annual audit planning, resource management, and prioritisation of technology audit coverage.
  
  
Contribute to ad-hoc assignments, investigations, and Audit Committee-related matters as required.
  
  
Stay current on emerging technology, cybersecurity threats, and industry developments, applying insights to strengthen audit coverage and impact.
  
  
Skills for Success
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline.
  
  
Professional certification such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, or CIA.
  
  
Extensive experience in technology audit, IT risk, cybersecurity, or internal audit, preferably within large, complex organisations.
  
  
Strong understanding of telecommunications, digital platforms, and large-scale technology environments.
  
  
Hands-on experience auditing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern architectures.
  
  
Proven ability to lead complex audits and engage credibly with senior management.
  
  
Excellent analytical, report writing, and influencing skills.
  
  
Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?
  
  
Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!
  
  
The Singtel Group is Asia's leading communications group, providing a wide spectrum of multimedia and infocomms technology (ICT) solutions across 3 global business units.
  
  
Group Consumer focuses on next-generation communication, infotainment and technology services to consumers and small businesses. Group Enterprise provides innovative and comprehensive ICT solutions, i.e. satellite services, international data and managed services, cloud computing, enterprise mobility services, and end-to-end solutions. Group Digital L!fe strives to bring people together with a cutting edge mix of digital services such as NextGen TV, e-books, music, digital concierge, cloud-based gaming and hyperlocal content.
  
  
Headquartered in Singapore, Singtel’s 130 years of operating experience has played a pivotal role in the country’s transformation into a major communications hub. Our Australian arm, Optus is an innovative leader in integrated telecommunications. Through our strategic investments in five regional mobile operators, Telkomsel, Globe Telecom, Advanced Info Service, PBTL, and Bharti Airtel, we are a major communications player in Asia and Africa.
  
  
Singtel is the largest listed company on the Singapore Exchange by market capitalisation. We have a vast network of offices in countries and territories throughout Asia Pacific, in Europe, USA and Australia. The Group employs more than 21,000 staff worldwide and has served 468 million mobile customers globally as of 31 March 2013.

0 to 2 years in an agency, marketing or client facing role; fresh graduates welcome.
  
  
**Strong written English:** you can turn messy information into a clear slide or email.

An internship or role at a marketing, creative or digital agency.
  
  
Hands on experience with GA4, Meta Ads Manager or Google Ads.

Bahasa Indonesia or Mandarin, useful for working with our regional team and clients.

Direct mentorship from the Director of Business Development, in real client meetings from your first month.
  
  
Base salary of S$2,800 to S$3,200 per month, depending on experience.
  
  
A path to Account Manager as your client skills grow.
  
  
Varied work across creative, digital, tech and AI projects, and NexGen's own products.
  
  
Structured training in AI tools and workflows.
  
  
Leave and medical benefits in line with company policy.

description:
**Company Description**

**About AbbVie**

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**

The MSL Oncology – Hematology will play a crucial role in AbbVie’s preparedness for the launch of new hematology products. This individual will be responsible for addressing evidence and educational gaps and collaborating with external scientific stakeholders to develop partnerships that support and expedite opportunities for patients to access AbbVie’s advanced therapeutics.

Responsibilities:

* Provide scientific and technical leadership to ensure professional and credible relationships with thought leaders and external experts of strategic importance to AbbVie.
* Ensure a strong medical and scientific presence for AbbVie in key academic centers by facilitation of research and educational initiatives, while supporting requests for medical and scientific information on products or areas of therapeutic interest to AbbVie.
* Support internal teams such as sales, marketing and members of the Affiliate Brand Team to develop their scientific and technical expertise through the delivery of scientific update presentations. Work collaboratively and cross-functionally with other in-field members while retaining functional independence.
* Assist in the initiation; oversight and follow up of assigned clinical studies and medical projects initiated within the therapeutic area for which the MSL carries responsibility (e.g. post marketing clinical activities such as registry/database projects, epidemiological surveys, post-authorization studies (phase IV). All such activities must comply with applicable local laws, guidelines, codes of practice, SOPs, and AbbVie R&D (GPRD) SOPs.
* Act as the point of contact with thought leaders to facilitate Investigator Initiated Study (IIS) ideas and requests for support to the local and global medical teams as appropriate.
* Serve as a point of contact within the Medical Affairs team for thought leaders and external experts within an assigned geographic area to satisfy their needs for scientific knowledge in a therapeutic area and, when requested, relevant AbbVie medicines, to support their safe, effective and appropriate use.
* Deliver credible presentations on scientific matters to physicians, individually or in groups (meetings, clinical sessions, etc.), were requested, but with the focus on Tier 1 and 2 thought leaders.
* Participate in the selection process to identify appropriately qualified thought leaders the Company would wish to engage in collaborative efforts – such as potential research collaborations, or educational and advisory roles (Advisory Boards, Congresses, Symposia, etc.); while ensuring a high level of scientific or educational integrity in these collaborative efforts.
* Facilitate medical and scientific field intelligence – for example, competitor research and medical strategies, educational activities – and communicate, where appropriate, within the Company.
* Attend relevant scientific meetings and Conferences. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop summaries of key data and other scientifically relevant information to inform AbbVie strategic priorities and initiatives.  
  Upon request, assist physicians with requests for access to AbbVie medicines on a named patient or compassionate use basis, subject to all applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Provide key thought leaders / external experts and internal medical and clinical teams with scientific and technical support for publications of scientific or medical interest.
* Ensure that all activities and interactions are conducted with due regard to all applicable local, global and national laws, regulations, guidelines, codes of conduct, Company policies and accepted standards of best practice.
* Location: A field based role with up to 20% of an individual’s time may be spent working in the affiliate medical team head office, typically – the remainder of time being spent as field based. This is subject to local needs, and the discretion of the ASEAN Medical Director.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Medical, Pharmacy or other bachelor’s degree in scientific discipline or higher (PhD)
* A background in medical affairs or a related field, along with experience in working closely with the pharmaceutical industry.
* Strong understanding of the clinical landscape, including the regulatory and payer landscape in Singapore.
* Excellent communication and proven relationship-building skills in effectively establishing new links with external stakeholders.
* Possess strong organizational skills, the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

### **ABOUT WORLD TABLE TENNIS**

World Table Tennis is where the sport’s fiercest battles meet bold ideas and creative minds. WTT is powered by a global crew of innovators, storytellers, and game-changers, who bring energy, expertise, and imagination to everything they do.

We’re not your typical workplace; we’re the global engine behind a sport on the rise. So whether it’s staging iconic global events or redefining fan experiences, this is where bold ideas get built, and where every role has impact. At WTT, the arena simply hits different.

### **EVENTS & EXPERIENCE MANAGER**

The Events & Experience Manager will support the successful planning and delivery of WTT events, ensuring consistent operational standards and a high-quality experience for players, officials, spectators, partners and other stakeholders.

Working closely with the Heads of Events, Event Managers, Competition Managers, Event Organisers and relevant WTT departments, the position will coordinate event preparations, operational requirements, branding and event experience initiatives.

The role will also contribute to event bidding processes, the development of operational manuals and the continuous improvement of WTT events.

While reporting to one designated Head of Events, the position may support activities across the wider WTT event portfolio.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES**

##### **Event Planning & Coordination:**

* Support the planning, preparation and delivery of WTT events in accordance with WTT Event Manuals and operational standards.
* Coordinate event timelines, operational requirements and deliverables with Event Organisers and relevant WTT departments.
* Organise and participate in event planning meetings, maintain progress trackers and monitor key deadlines.
* Support event readiness assessments and follow up on outstanding operational requirements.
* Attend assigned events and provide onsite operational support, including issue resolution and escalation where required.

##### **Event Experience & Activation:**

* Support the development and implementation of a consistent, high-quality event experience across the WTT portfolio.
* Coordinate with Commercial, Creative Media & Engagement, Sport Presentation and other departments on event branding, presentation and activations.
* Support initiatives to enhance the experience of players, spectators, partners and other stakeholders.
* Identify creative opportunities to improve event engagement and strengthen the WTT brand.

##### **Event Organiser & Stakeholder Coordination:**

* Maintain effective communication with Event Organisers, host organisations, suppliers and relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor operational deliverables and ensure timely follow-up on outstanding requirements.
* Support site inspections, planning meetings and event evaluations.
* Assist Event Managers and Heads of Events in resolving operational and stakeholder-related matters.

##### **Event Bidding & Host Assessment:**

* Support the coordination of event bidding processes and host-city assessments.
* Assist in preparing and reviewing event proposals, operational requirements and supporting documentation.
* Monitor event-related administrative and financial obligations in coordination with relevant departments.
* Support the evaluation of potential host cities, venues and event organisers.

##### **Event Manuals & Operational Standards:**

* Contribute to the development and updating of WTT Event Manuals, operational guidelines, procedures and planning tools.
* Maintain accurate event documentation, progress reports and operational records.
* Support the standardisation of event planning and delivery processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through new procedures, technologies and event management tools.

##### **Cross-Departmental Coordination & Reporting:**

* Work closely with WTT Events, Operations, Commercial, Creative Media & Engagement, Sport Presentation and other relevant departments.
* Ensure event requirements, timelines and operational information are communicated effectively.
* Provide regular progress updates, identify outstanding matters and escalate significant risks or delays.
* Support post-event evaluations and the implementation of lessons learned across the event portfolio.

### **REQUIREMENTS**

##### **Essentials:**

* Degree or equivalent qualification in Event Management, Sports Management, Business Administration or a related field.
* At least three years of relevant experience in sports event management, live events or international event delivery.
* Experience coordinating event delivery with event organisers, venues, suppliers and other stakeholders.
* Understanding of event operations, logistics, branding and stakeholder services.
* Strong organisational, administrative and project management skills, with the attention to detail needed to manage multiple projects, competing deadlines and changing priorities under pressure.
* Ability to communicate clearly, work collaboratively across cultures and take the initiative to resolve problems.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and event or project management tools.
* Willingness to travel internationally, work flexible hours during event periods and support different event functions as needed.

##### **Desirables:**

* Experience working in professional sport or delivering international sporting events.
* Experience delivering event activations or supporting host-city bids.
* Experience developing event manuals or operational procedures.
* Creativity and a commitment to improving the event experience for participants and stakeholders.

title: SA/AVP, Data & Analytics - SMBC
description:

* Support the end-to-end delivery of the APAC Data Hub Programme and related data transformation initiatives.

**Education**

description:

The Head, M&E provides technical and operational leadership to ensure YWCA’s properties, mechanical and electrical systems and shared facilities remain safe, compliant, reliable and fit for purpose. The role drives preventive maintenance, asset performance, service standards, sustainability and effective use of resources.
  
  
The role also leads assigned capital improvement, renovation, building systemsand renovation and upgrading projects from feasibility and planning through procurement, execution, testing, commissioning and handover. Working with internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors and authorities, the Head, M&E delivers projects that meet approved scope, budget, quality, safety and schedule requirements while minimising disruption to ongoing operations.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
1. Safeguard Building Operations& Asset Reliability
  
  

* Ensure reliable operation of M&E systemsand building facilities through risk-based preventive and corrective maintenance.
* Establish service and asset-performance standards that reduce breakdowns, downtime and operational disruption.
* Oversee building inspections, condition assessments and rectification plans to maintain safe, functional premises.
* Ensure responsive resolution of building-userissues and effective coordination of cleaning, security, landscaping and related services.

* Own assigned building, renovation, lift and M&E improvement projects across the full project lifecycle, from requirements and feasibility through completion.
* Develop project briefs, budgets, schedules, milestones, risk registers and implementation plans for management approval.
* Coordinate architects, engineers, consultants, contractors and internal users; resolve design, technical and site issues to maintain progress.

3. Ensure Safety, Regulatory Compliance & Risk Control
  
  

* Maintain compliance with applicable building, fire, electrical, lift, workplace safety and environmental requirements, with support from appropriately appointed qualified persons.
* Implement emergency preparedness, incident-response and business-continuity measures for buildings and projects.
* Identify, assess, escalate and mitigate operational and project risks, ensuring timely closure of incidents and corrective actions.
* Monitor contractors’ safety performance, permit requirements and adherence to approved specifications and safe work practices.

4. Optimise Budgets, Procurement & Contractor Performance
  
  

* Plan and manage approved operating and project budgets, balancing lifecycle cost, service quality and value for money.
* Prepare or review technical scopes, tender specifications, quotations and recommendations for procurement and contract award.
* Manage maintenance contracts, service-level agreements and vendor performance against cost, quality, delivery and compliance expectations.

5. Drive Sustainability & ContinuousImprovement
  
  

* Identify opportunities to improve energyefficiency, environmental performance and responsible resource use.
* Evaluate smart facilities technologies andprocess improvements using cost-benefit, reliability and service-impactconsiderations.
* Use maintenance, incident and asset data toprioritise upgrades and long-term capital planning.

6. Build Capability & Stakeholder Confidence
  
  

* Lead and develop technical and facilitiespersonnel, clarifying accountabilities, service expectations and capabilityneeds.
* Build effective relationships with buildingusers, Hotel and programme teams, consultants, authorities and servicepartners.
* Communicate project impacts, operationalrisks, decisions and progress clearly to management and affected stakeholders.

description:

He/she identifies and manages risks and where necessary raises concerns and escalates issues in a timely manner to Front Management and/or second line of defence. * A natural team player
* Persistent and persuasive
* Passionate about client service
* Possesses good judgement and ability to work under pressure

-----------------------------------

* Experience in scam and fraud operations, banking products, regulatory requirements or operational risk is an advantage, but not a prerequisite.
* Must be prepared for the operational demands of the role, including shift work, weekends and non- standard working hours where rostered or business needs require. The role offers competitive compensation package commensurate with its responsibilities.

Collaboration and influence – works constructively across teams and communicates credibly with stakeholders at all levels.  

**Technical Competencies**

title: Cluster Learning & Development Manager - Conrad Singapore Marina Bay and Conrad Singapore Orchard
description:
At Conrad Hotels & Resorts, we believe that true luxury is being yourself. As a member of Hilton's luxury portfolio, Conrad delivers intuitive service, meaningful connections, and purposeful experiences that empower both our guests and our Team Members.
  
  
The Cluster Learning & Development Manager serves as a strategic business partner and culture champion responsible for driving learning excellence, leadership development, talent growth, service culture, and organizational effectiveness across Conrad Singapore Marina Bay and Conrad Singapore Orchard.
  
  
This role is instrumental in cultivating a high-performance learning culture that reflects Conrad's Luxury Service Standards, Hilton Values, and Employer of Choice aspirations. The incumbent acts as a catalyst for continuous learning, leadership capability building, and cultural transformation while ensuring that all Team Members are equipped to deliver exceptional guest experiences with passion, purpose, and excellence.
  
  
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
  
  
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive team member training and development programs to enhance team skills and performance; assessing training needs, designing and updating training courses to ensure that the training content matches the team members' job responsibilities and career paths; managing training budgets to ensure maximum return on training investment. As a
  
  
Cluster
  
  
Learning & Development Manager
  
  
, you’re not just managing training initiatives for hotel team members – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
  
  
**Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:**  
Learning & Development Strategy
  
  

* Develop and execute the annual Cluster Learning & Development Strategy aligned with business goals, Conrad Brand Standards, and Hilton's global learning framework.
* Lead the design, implementation, and evaluation of all learning and capability-building initiatives across both hotels.
* Establish a culture of continuous learning that supports operational excellence, talent retention, and career growth.
* Identify learning needs through performance data, guest feedback, quality audits, and business priorities.
* Ensure training interventions deliver measurable improvements in guest satisfaction, team engagement, and operational performance.

Luxury Service Culture & Brand Excellence
  
  

* Champion the Conrad Luxury Service Culture and ensure all Team Members understand and embody Conrad's service philosophy.
* Facilitate and sustain brand immersion programmes that reinforce luxury hospitality standards and memorable guest experiences.
* Lead initiatives that strengthen service excellence, guest engagement, and personalized luxury experiences.
* Collaborate with department leaders to embed brand standards into everyday operations and team behaviors.

Leadership Development
  
  

* Develop leadership capability at all levels through structured learning programs, succession planning initiatives, and coaching interventions.
* Facilitate Hilton leadership development programs and support participation in regional and global learning initiatives.
* Coach Department Heads, Managers, and Supervisors in leadership effectiveness, performance management, communication, and people development.
* Support talent reviews and succession planning processes to strengthen leadership bench strength across both properties.

Team Member Development
  
  

* Drive onboarding, orientation, and assimilation programmes to ensure a strong Team Member experience from day one.
* Manage and facilitate all mandatory Hilton and hotel-specific training programs.
* Design learning pathways that support technical skills, service excellence, cross-functional exposure, and career growth.
* Support individual development plans and facilitate career conversations across all levels.
* Mentor high-potential Team Members and emerging leaders.

Talent Management & Organizational Development
  
  

* Partner with the Human Resources team and business leaders to support talent management, succession planning, and workforce capability development.
* Support organizational change initiatives, culture transformation projects, and employee engagement strategies.
* Conduct learning and development needs analyses to address capability gaps and future business requirements.
* Facilitate interventions that improve team effectiveness, collaboration, and workplace culture.

Departmental Training Excellence & Train-the-Trainer Programme
  
  

* Develop, implement, formalize, and continuously enhance a comprehensive Cluster Train-the-Trainer (TTT) Programme across Conrad Singapore Marina Bay and Conrad Singapore Orchard.
* Establish a structured departmental trainer framework to ensure every department maintains qualified and certified trainers who support ongoing learning and capability development.
* Partner with Department Heads to identify, appoint, and develop Departmental Trainers and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
* Facilitate Train-the-Trainer certification programmes focusing on adult learning principles, facilitation skills, coaching techniques, presentation effectiveness, and learning evaluation.
* Ensure departmental trainers are equipped to deliver onboarding, technical skills, luxury service standards, compliance, and brand-related training programmes consistently.
* Monitor trainer effectiveness through training audits, observations, participant feedback, and business performance indicators.
* Conduct regular trainer calibration sessions to ensure consistency in learning delivery and alignment with Conrad Brand Standards and Hilton learning philosophies.
* Create and maintain a training governance framework that drives accountability for learning delivery within every department.
* Recognize and celebrate training champions who demonstrate excellence in developing Team Members and fostering a learning culture.

Training Planning & Coordination
  
  

* Lead the annual and quarterly learning planning process across both hotels, ensuring training initiatives are strategically aligned with business priorities and operational requirements.
* Develop comprehensive learning calendars and training schedules that maximize participation while minimizing operational disruption.
* Prioritize learning activities effectively across multiple stakeholders, locations, and business demands.
* Ensure all learning programmes are delivered within established timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Maintain strong project management discipline in the planning, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of all learning initiatives.
* Utilize data and workforce insights to forecast learning needs and proactively address capability gaps.

Operational Partnership
  
  

* Build strong partnerships with General Managers, Executive Committee Members, and Department Heads to align learning initiatives with business needs.
* Conduct regular training reviews and learning effectiveness discussions with department leaders.
* Support operational departments with coaching, facilitation, and performance improvement initiatives.
* Ensure learning interventions support key commercial, operational, guest experience, and people metrics.

Learning Administration & Compliance
  
  

* Manage Hilton learning systems and ensure compliance with all required training and certification programmes.
* Maintain accurate training records, training reports, and compliance documentation.
* Monitor completion rates and effectiveness of mandatory, brand, safety, and compliance training.
* Ensure all learning activities meet company, legislative, and operational requirements.

Internship, Education & External Partnerships
  
  

* Develop strategic partnerships with educational institutions, hospitality schools, and training providers.
* Manage internship programmes, management trainee programmes, and industry attachment opportunities.
* Represent both hotels at learning, talent, and employer branding initiatives.
* Maintain active relationships with relevant government agencies and workforce development organizations.
* Stay informed on national training grants, funding schemes, and workforce development initiatives applicable to the hospitality industry.

Financial Management
  
  

* Prepare and manage the annual Cluster Learning & Development budget.
* Monitor monthly training expenditure and maximize training resources efficiently.
* Ensure effective utilization of Hilton learning resources, government grants, and training support programmes.
* Track return on investment and overall effectiveness of learning initiatives.
* The Management reserves the right to make changes to this job description at its sole discretion and without advance notice.

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
  
  
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
  
  
Hospitality
  
  
. Acting with
  
  
Integrity
  
  
and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
  
  
Leadership
  
  
. A belief that
  
  
Teamwork
  
  
drives the best outcomes. A sense of
  
  
Ownership
  
  
and accountability. And a focus on the
  
  
Now
  
  
, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
  
  
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
  
  
Education
  
  

* Degree or Diploma in Human Resources, Learning & Development, Hospitality Management, Organizational Development, Psychology, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* Professional certifications in learning, facilitation, coaching, or talent development are advantageous.

Experience
  
  

* Minimum 5 years of progressive Learning & Development experience within luxury hospitality, hotels, or service industries.
* Prior experience in a management-level L&D role.
* Cluster or multi-property experience preferred.
* Experience in leadership development, organizational development, talent management, and facilitation.

Knowledge & Skills
  
  

* Strong understanding of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies.
* Strong knowledge of luxury hospitality service standards.
* Excellent presentation, facilitation, and communication skills.
* Proven coaching and mentoring capability.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Excellent project management and organizational skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Learning Management Systems (LMS), and digital learning platforms.
* Ability to analyze training data and demonstrate business impact.

Essential Competencies
  
  

* Proven experience designing, implementing, and managing Train-the-Trainer programmes and departmental trainer networks.
* Strong organizational, planning, and project management capabilities.
* Exceptional time management skills with the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities across a cluster environment.
* Ability to develop structured learning roadmaps, training calendars, and succession-focused development plans.
* Strong attention to detail and follow-through with demonstrated execution excellence.
* Ability to influence stakeholders and drive accountability for learning outcomes across all departments.
* Excellent facilitation, coaching, and mentoring skills.
* Strong analytical capability with the ability to measure and demonstrate learning effectiveness and business impact.

How We’ll Help You Thrive
  
  
At Hilton, the hospitality we’re known for doesn’t end with our guests. We proudly invest in our Team Members’ wellbeing, supporting you through all of life’s moments. When you join Hilton, our exceptional care extends to you with unmatched perks and benefits, including\*:
  
  
Incredible travel perks – Enjoy 110 nights of deeply discounted travel, with room rates as low as $40 USD/night at our world-class hotels through our Go Hilton travel program
  
  
Health & welfare benefits – From checkups to dental cleanings to new glasses, we offer a variety of health plans that keep you covered
  
  

* Benefits availability may vary depending on Team Member’s location as well as terms and conditions of employment and are subject to the terms and conditions of each specific program/plan.

Located in the vibrant Marina Bay, a mere 20 minutes from Changi International Airport, Conrad Singapore Marina Bay is one of the Lion City’s most esteemed addresses for the business and leisure traveller. The 512 guest rooms hotel exudes an air of effortless modern luxury with Asian touches. The hotel is an ideal venue for meetings, conferences and social events, with a magnificent Ballroom catering up to 550 guests, a glass-enclosed Junior Ballroom, as well as twelve other function rooms. Savour local and international cuisine at the hotel’s award-winning restaurants. The hotel boasts an art collection featuring over 3,400 pieces of sculptures and paintings by both notable local and international artists. Follow us on Facebook and Instagram.
  
  
About Conrad Hotels & Resorts
  
  
Spanning five continents with a benchmark of nearly 50 properties, Conrad Hotels & Resorts creates a seamless connection between bold design, impactful experiences and curated contemporary art to inspire the conscientious traveler. Conrad is a place where guests are empowered to explore through intuitive service and experiences that authentically connect them with local culture. In addition to its award-winning hotel offerings, the brand also features an expanding residential portfolio combining sophisticated design, best-in-class amenities and purposeful service in sought-after destinations. Experience Conrad Hotels & Resorts by booking at conradhotels.com or through the industry-leading Hilton Honors app. Hilton Honors members who book directly through preferred Hilton channels have access to instant benefits. Learn more about Conrad Hotels & Resorts at stories.hilton.com/conradhotels, and follow the brand on Instagram and X.

title: Head, Community Engagement & Partnerships
description:
The Head, Community Engagement & Partnerships is a key member of AMP’s management team, contributing significantly to AMP’s leadership by shaping organisational priorities, strengthening cross-functional collaboration and shared accountability, and fostering a cohesive and inclusive management culture across AMP and its entities.
  
  
The Head provides strategic leadership and oversight of AMP's programmes and service delivery, ensuring that initiatives are responsive to the needs of clients and aligned with the organisation's mission, strategic priorities, governance requirements, and service standards. The role oversees the planning, development, implementation, and evaluation of programmes to achieve meaningful and sustainable outcomes for the community.
  
  
The Head is responsible for ensuring programme quality, managing operational risks and resources, overseeing budget utilisation, and driving continuous improvement in service delivery. The role also leads workforce and volunteer planning, develops the capabilities of staff and volunteers, and fosters strategic partnerships with government agencies, community partners, and other stakeholders to strengthen programme effectiveness and community impact. Through a client-centric and strategic approach, the Head supports organisational excellence while advancing AMP's outreach and service objectives.
  
  
MAIN DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
1. Build Professional Partnerships and Collaborations
  
  
a) Develop and maintain strategic partnerships with other agencies, other organisations, and stakeholders to strengthen service delivery and create integrated support pathways for clients
  
  
b) Collaborate with external agencies and partners to co-design, implement, and enhance programmes that address emerging community needs and achieve desired social outcomes.
  
  
c) Develop and implement community outreach strategies to engage target client groups, strengthen community awareness, and expand the reach and impact of AMP's services.
  
  
d) Identify service gaps, emerging social trends, and community needs to inform programme development and improve the effectiveness of social service interventions.
  
  
e) Manage stakeholder engagement, communications, and feedback to foster strong relationships, gather insights, and drive continuous improvement in programmes and services.
  
  
f) Represent AMP in external engagements, sector discussions, and collaborative initiatives to promote AMP's interests, contribute to sector development, and strengthen partnerships across the social service ecosystem.
  
  
2. Planning, Theory of Change (ToC) and Programme Development
  
  
a) Develop and review the division's strategic direction, ToC, programme framework, and implementation plans to ensure alignment with AMP's mission, strategic priorities, and community needs.
  
  
b) Translate strategic objectives and desired outcomes into clear programme priorities, service models, and operational initiatives that deliver measurable outcomes for clients.
  
  
c) Identify emerging social trends, community needs, and service gaps to inform programme development, resource allocation, and service enhancement.
  
  
d) Establish priorities for programme implementation and service delivery, taking into consideration organisational capacity, stakeholder needs, available resources, and opportunities for impact.
  
  
e) Drive monitoring and evaluation of programme effectiveness and initiatives against intended outcomes and ToC, and drive continuous improvement to enhance service quality, operational efficiency, and client outcomes.
  
  
f) Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to align strategies, strengthen service integration and ToC and advance AMP's long-term social impact objectives.
  
  
g) Provide recommendations to Senior Management and the Board on programme development, sector trends, and policy changes.
  
  
h) Steward divisional performance and service delivery to achieve strategic objectives and advance AMP's mission and vision.
  
  
3. Demonstrate Corporate Governance
  
  
a) Establish and oversee programme governance, quality assurance, risk management, and compliance frameworks to ensure effective oversight, regulatory compliance, and alignment with organisational and funding requirements.
  
  
b) Drive and strengthen the division's audit, controls, and assurance framework to uphold accountability, mitigate operational risks, and ensureadherence to organisational policies, regulatory standards, and governancerequirements.
  
  
4. Manage Resources
  
  
a) Lead strategic resource planning and allocation across programmes and functions to optimise organisational effectiveness and address evolving operational priorities.
  
  
b) Establish and oversee volunteer management frameworks, policies, and practices to strengthen volunteer engagement, governance, and programme delivery capabilities.
  
  
c) Drive infrastructure, systems, and resource planning initiatives to support the division's current operational requirements and future growthneeds.
  
  
d) Oversee resource utilisation and capacity planning to ensure sustainable service delivery and optimal deployment of organisational resources.
  
  
e) Review and approve funding proposals, business cases, and resource investments to ensure alignment with strategic priorities, operational needs, and desired organisational outcomes.
  
  
5. Develop Organisational Capability for Service Delivery
  
  
a) Drive capability development strategies to strengthen the division's professional competencies, leadership bench strength, and service delivery capabilities.
  
  
b) Assess current and future workforce capability requirements and establish capability-building priorities to support the division's strategic objectives and evolving service needs.
  
  
c) Lead the development and implementation of learning, talent, and succession plans to ensure organisational readiness and sustainability.
  
  
d) Cultivate a high-performance and continuous learning culture that promotes professional excellence, innovation, and service effectiveness.
  
  
e) Strengthen leadership and management capabilities across the division to enhance organisational resilience, employee engagement, and operational performance.
  
  
f) Champion workforce planning and talent development initiatives to ensure the division is equipped with the skills and expertise required to meet current and future service demands.
  
  
SECONDARY DUTIES
  
  
a) Participate in inter-divisional project committees and render support to other department events as and when required.
  
  
REQUIREMENTS
  
  
Minimum 10 years of progressive leadership experience in the social service or related sector.
  
  
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; postgraduate qualifications are an advantage.
  
  
Proven track record in leading programme portfolios, service delivery, stakeholder engagement, and organisational initiatives.
  
  
Experience in developing, implementing, and evaluating programmes that deliver measurable outcomes and community impact.
  
  
Experience working with government agencies, community partners, funders, volunteers, and other key stakeholders.
  
  
The Association of Muslim Professionals (AMP) was established on 10 October 1991, as an important resolution of the First National Convention of Singapore Malay/Muslim Professionals which was held on 6 and 7 October 1990. The Convention was attended by 500 Malay/Muslim professionals who met to brainstorm new directions for the community. AMP was formed with core programmes in education, human resource development, social development and research.
  
  
AMP is a registered charitable organisation and is accorded the status of an Institution of Public Character.
