title: Response Operations Manager
description:
**About Blackpanda**

Somewhere in Singapore tonight, a server room is on fire. Not literally, though sometimes it might as well be. A ransomware note is blinking on a managing director's screen in a tower above Raffles Place. A family office in Paya Lebar is locked out of its own ledgers. A trading desk in MBFC is running orders on paper. Somewhere a CIO is staring at the ceiling at three in the morning, wondering who to call.

That call comes to us.

Blackpanda is Asia's premier cyber crisis response firm: Lloyd's of London-accredited, regionally headquartered, and built for one purpose, to walk in when the worst has already happened and walk out leaving the company still on its feet. We do incident response and digital forensics. We are pure IR, and we like it that way.

**Three channels, one operating force.** We reach the market in three ways, and every channel feeds the same unit.

* **Consulting.** Hourly, senior-led engagements for enterprises and board-level matters where complexity, sensitivity, or scale demand our most experienced operators.
* **IR-1.** Our proprietary fixed-cost subscription, sold through IT channels and underwritten on our own insurance paper. IR-1 puts a real response solution in the hands of mid-market and small companies, paid up front, before the breach, with our team on the other end of every activation.
* **Traditional cyber insurance.** Full-stack policies for the mature, board-level buyer, with our response practice on the inside of every claim. Not a panel. Not a vendor. Our own people.
  

**The Cyber In-Extremis Force.** At the centre of everything is the CIF. In extremis describes the moment a situation has moved beyond the tolerance of conventional units. In-extremis forces are the no-fail option. Blackpanda was founded by three former operators of the Commander's In-Extremis Force, and they are building the cyber equivalent the only way they know how: same standards, same discipline, same refusal to compromise on who gets to wear the patch.

Every responder on the CIF roster holds, or is actively earning, multiple SANS Institute certifications. The company pays for the coursework and the certifications. By the end of 2026, Blackpanda expects to field 25 full-time incident responders, by a wide margin the largest pure-IR team in Asia-Pacific and Japan.

**Our Core Values**

  

* **Sincerity:** If we say we'll do it, it's as good as done. In combat, you have to know your right flank will be there at 0200 when they said they would. The work is the same.
* **Unity:** Debate fiercely, then commit fully. We all row in the same direction.
* **Efficiency:** Timing beats speed, precision beats power, leverage beats strength.
* **Humility:** Humility forms the basis of honor. We listen, then we act, then we listen again.
* **Grit:** We don't sugarcoat setbacks or bad news. We face challenges head-on and we don't quit when it gets hard.

**Our Mission:** To provide digital emergency response to everyone.

**Our Vision:** Accessing cyber incident response is as universally accessible as dialing 9-1-1.

  

**What we are looking for**

The Response Operations Manager is the operational nexus of the Cyber In-Extremis Force. Reporting to the VP of Response and working hand-in-hand with the Executive Director of Response, you take every piece of administration, scheduling, reporting and cross-functional coordination off the shoulders of Response leadership and the responders, so they can spend their hours where they matter: on the keyboard, in front of clients, and in the war room.

Work reaches Response from every direction: IR-1 activations, ODIR consulting engagements, insurance claims, and IRR proactive readiness consulting. You make sure each piece of that work is received, staffed, tracked, handed off and closed cleanly, and that every other function in the company (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Technology, Insurance, People & Culture and Finance) has one reliable point of contact into Response.

You own the operating rhythm of the unit. You prepare the agendas, data and reporting packs for the weekly Response Operations sync with the C-Suite, the Directors' Weekly Meeting, and every internal operational meeting Response runs. You run the triage rotations, leave plans and overtime records. You keep the CIF training pipeline moving, from Immersive rotations through to SANS certifications, and you make sure performance reviews happen on time and to standard.

This is not a responder role, and you will not be expected to run investigations. You need to understand how incident response works well enough to know what a responder needs, when, and from whom. If you have run operations for a consulting, DFIR, MSSP or other high-tempo professional services team and want to build the operating backbone of the largest pure-IR team in APJ, we want to talk.

  

**Responsibilities and Duties**

**Engagement Intake and Response Operations**

  

* Act as the single intake and tracking point for all work entering Response: IR-1 activations, ODIR engagements, insurance claim activations, and IRR readiness consulting.
* Maintain the Response engagement tracker: case numbering, client, contract type, entitlements, assigned responders, status, hours and SLA clocks.
* Confirm, before work starts, what the contract entitles the client to (IR-1 tier, retainer hours, insurance policy limits, statement of work), and flag scope or entitlement gaps to Response leadership.
* Track IR-1 activation and response SLAs and escalate early when a clock is at risk.
* Run case closure: deliverables issued, hours finalised, evidence retention and disposal logged, lessons learned captured, and client feedback requested.

**Reporting, Metrics and Operating Rhythm**

  

* Own the agenda, pre-reads, data pack and action log for the weekly Response Operations sync with the C-Suite, the Directors' Weekly Meeting, and all internal Response operational meetings.
* Build and maintain Response metrics: engagement volume by channel, SLA adherence, utilisation, billable versus non-billable hours, overtime, subcontractor usage, training progress and review completion.
* Track decisions and due-outs from each meeting and chase them to closure.
* Turn raw data into clear reporting the C-Suite can act on, and flag trends (capacity strain, margin leakage, SLA risk) before they become problems.

**Scheduling, Capacity and Rotations**

  

* Build and publish the triage and on-call rotation across Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, the Philippines and Malaysia, covering time zones and public holidays.
* Maintain the Response leave plan and make sure coverage holds before leave is approved.
* Record overtime and out-of-hours work, and track time-in-lieu and fatigue across the team so workloads stay sustainable.
* Forecast capacity against pipeline and contracted demand, and give Response leadership the data to decide when to hire, when to use subcontractors, and when to push back on new work.

**Training, Certification and CIF Readiness**

  

* Own each responder's training plan, scheduling Immersive Labs rotations and tracking progress toward their SANS certification pathway.
* Coordinate SANS course enrolment, exam scheduling and training budget usage, including the 12-month retention requirement.
* Maintain the CIF certification register (who holds what, expiry and renewal dates) for internal planning, client proposals, insurance panels and audits.
* Report training progress to Response leadership and flag anyone falling behind their pathway.

**Performance and People Administration**

  

* Run the performance review calendar for Response with People & Culture: reminders, templates, deadlines and completion tracking.
* Check that reviews are completed to standard, on time, and catalogued correctly in the HR system.
* Coordinate responder onboarding and offboarding with People & Culture and IT, including equipment, tool access, training enrolment and access revocation.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

  

You are Response's one point of contact for every other function.

* Sales  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Responder triage schedules and availability; scheduling responders for pre-sales calls, scoping and proposal support
* Legal  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Collaborate with the Legal department to facilitate Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) and Master Services Agreements (MSAs) tailored to response engagements. Document and oversee contractual obligations and stipulations that impact service delivery protocols per agreement.
* Marketing  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Responder input for thought leadership articles, technical review of marketing materials, event and speaking engagements, and case study pipeline from closed engagements
* Customer Success  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Which work is coming into Response under which contract; clean operational handoff by connecting the right responders with the right Customer Success owner
* Technology  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Response tooling requirements; contracting, onboarding and licence renewals for tools and platforms, including Immersive Labs and other training requirements
* Insurance  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Readiness consulting services that support Insurance; activation of insurance claims and the Response work they require
* People & Culture  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Responder time for interviews and hiring; JD creation and approvals; IR subcontractor rotation and usage; onboarding responders with IT and into the company
* Finance  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Billable hours, timesheet compliance, and the metrics Finance needs for invoicing, WIP and margin reporting

**Subcontractors, Vendors and Tools**

  

* Maintain the IR subcontractor bench: onboarding, NDAs, rates, purchase orders, timesheets and quality feedback.
* Rotate subcontractor usage fairly and in line with what Response leadership approves, and track subcontractor spend against budget.
* Track Response tool licences, renewals and costs, and support procurement with Technology and Finance.
* Coordinate deployment logistics for on-site work: travel, visas, forensic kit and hardware inventory.

**Process, Compliance and Continuous Improvement**

  

* Document and maintain Response operating procedures and runbooks in Confluence.
* Support client and regulatory audit requests for Response (evidence handling records, staff vetting, certifications, on-premise requirements).
* Look for administrative work that can be automated, and use Blackpanda's approved AI tools to remove it.
  

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Minimum Requirements**

  

* 5+ years in operations, PMO, resource management or business operations, with at least 2 years supporting a consulting, DFIR, MSSP, legal, or other client-facing professional services team.
* Proven experience running scheduling, rotations and capacity planning for a team of 15 or more billable professionals.
* Strong reporting skills: able to build metrics, dashboards and leadership packs from raw data in spreadsheets and business systems.
* Experience running a leadership operating rhythm: agendas, pre-reads, action logs and follow-through.
* Working understanding of cybersecurity and incident response, enough to speak the language of responders and judge urgency, without needing to be a practitioner.
* Comfortable working across many functions at once, and able to say no, escalate, and hold people to deadlines, including senior stakeholders.
* Hands-on with modern work tools (Jira, Confluence, a CRM such as HubSpot, an HRIS such as BambooHR, Google Workspace), and keen to automate repetitive work with AI.
* Precise, organised communicator in written and spoken English.
* Calm under pressure, with the discretion to handle confidential client and incident information.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience in a 24/7 or on-call operations environment (incident response, SOC, emergency services, military operations or similar) at company-level size leadership levels (100+ personnel).
* Exposure to cyber insurance claims workflows, MSP channels, or subscription service delivery.
* Experience managing subcontractors or vendor rosters, including rates, POs and timesheets.
* Certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, or Lean Six Sigma.
* Mandarin, Japanese, Cantonese, Tagalog or Malay, in addition to English.
  

**What success looks like**

**First 90 days**

  

* One engagement tracker covering every IR-1, ODIR, insurance and IRR engagement, owned by you and trusted by Response leadership.
* Weekly Response Operations and Directors' meeting packs issued on time, every week, with a live action log.
* Triage rotation, leave plan and overtime records published and current.
* Training plan and certification register in place for every responder.

**First 12 months**

  

* 100% of performance reviews in Response completed on time and catalogued with People & Culture.
* Every responder on track against their Immersive and SANS pathway, with exceptions flagged early.
* Timesheet compliance and billable hours data that Finance can invoice from without rework.
* Response leadership spending measurably less time on scheduling, admin and internal coordination.
* Documented Response operating procedures in Confluence, and at least two administrative workflows automated.
  

**What we offer**

* 40 days paid leave per year inclusive of public holidays, which may be taken at the discretion of the employee subject to compliance with our Leave Policy and the approval of their manager.
* Limited Work From Anywhere policy allotment, allowing for work from alternate locations contingent upon coverage provided by teammates and approved by manager for 5 days per quarter.
* Enrolment in the company's comprehensive corporate health plan that includes a large direct billing network for medical and dental coverage.
* Opportunities for inter-office travel, including a required annual week-long Tribe Onsite meet-up.
* $5,000 USD/year professional training budget, contingent on approval from manager, with a 12-month retention requirement.
* Competitive base salary with performance-based variable compensation, plus equity participation in Blackpanda's growth.
  

**Declamation**

Candidates who successfully pass the Interview stage may be required to complete a Case Study, used to evaluate their knowledge and application of their skills in practical scenarios relevant to the role.

Blackpanda is committed to building a culturally diverse company, and we value a broad set of opinions in our team. As we grow, we are looking to build a team with a range of viewpoints at its core, and we encourage applications from minority candidates and all genders however you identify (X/F/M).

Blackpanda does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. We will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited candidates submitted by recruiters with whom we have not established explicit, written agreements for our job vacancies. By submitting any candidate information, recruiters agree to forfeit any claim to fees should their candidate be hired without an established agreement with Blackpanda.

title: Commercial Excellence Director
description:
**Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.**

**Our Point of Care diagnostic portfolio spans key heath and therapeutic areas, including infections disease, cardiometabolic, informatics and toxicology.**

**Working at Abbott**

  

* At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:
* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**The Opportunity**

As the **Commercial Excellence Director**, you will be responsible for driving sustainable revenue growth, forecasting accuracy, commercial performance, and business intelligence across the Diagnostics business. This role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Commercial Operations to optimize demand planning, revenue recognition, funnel management, pricing strategy, tender excellence, distribution management, and sales force effectiveness (SFE). The position serves as the commercial data and analytics leader and champion for disciplined execution to achieve growth plans and maximize business performance.

**What You’ll Do**

**Demand Planning & Revenue Management**

* Lead the end-to-end demand planning process to ensure accurate forecasting and alignment with business objectives
* Drive monthly and quarterly sales forecast reviews with commercial and finance teams.
* Establish forecast accuracy metrics and continuously improve demand planning capabilities.
* Ensure robust revenue recognition governance and compliance with corporate and financial policies.
* Identify business risks and opportunities affecting revenue delivery and implement mitigation plans.

**Funnel & Opportunity Management**

* Own commercial funnel management processes across all markets and business segments.
* Implement standardized sales pipeline governance, ensuring funnel quality, visibility, and predictability.
* Monitor conversion rates, opportunity progression, and sales cycle effectiveness.
* Drive opportunity reviews and commercial performance discussions with regional and country teams.
* Develop actionable insights to improve win rates and accelerate revenue realization.

**Sales Force Effectiveness (SFE) & KPI Excellence**

  

* Establish and monitor key commercial performance indicators across the region.
* Design and continuously improve SFE frameworks, dashboards, and performance tracking tools.
* Measure productivity, territory effectiveness, customer coverage, and sales execution quality.
* Partner with sales leadership to identify performance gaps and develop corrective actions.
* Lead initiatives that improve commercial productivity and overall business performance.

**Sales Analytics & Business Intelligence**

* Build advanced analytical capabilities to support strategic decision-making.
* Develop and maintain commercial dashboards, reports, and performance scorecards.
* Transform data into actionable business insights to identify growth opportunities and operational improvements.
* Lead market analysis, customer segmentation, and profitability assessments.
* Support leadership teams with scenario planning and business performance reviews.
* Pricing Strategy & Tender Management
* Develop and implement pricing strategies that maximize profitability while maintaining market competitiveness.
* Establish pricing governance frameworks and approval processes.
* Lead tender excellence initiatives, including bid evaluation, pricing recommendations, and margin optimization.
* Analyze tender performance, win/loss trends, and pricing effectiveness.
* Collaborate with sales, finance, and legal teams to ensure compliant and profitable tender submissions.
* Commercial Governance & Process Excellence
* Standardize commercial excellence processes across markets.
* Drive adoption of CRM and commercial performance management tools.
* Lead commercial operating reviews and business performance governance.
* Ensure data quality, process compliance, and reporting accuracy across the organization.
* Champion continuous improvement and digital transformation initiatives.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in Commercial Excellence, Sales Operations, Business Analytics, Commercial Planning, or related commercial leadership roles.  
  Strong commercial understanding preferably in diagnostics.
* Proven track record in leading commercial excellence functions within the Pharmaceutical, Diagnostics, Medical Devices, or Healthcare industries.
* Strong experience in demand planning, forecasting, revenue management, and commercial analytics.
* Demonstrated success in pipeline/funnel management and sales force effectiveness programs.
* Extensive experience in commercial governance.
* Experience leading regional or multi-country, multi-culture commercial operations is highly preferred.
* Strong preference for candidates from the pharmaceutical industry, diagnostics, or Point of Care.
* Good understanding of the Diagnostics industry, including laboratory workflows, diagnostic testing markets, healthcare procurement processes, and tender-driven business models.

title: Assistant Director of Food & Beverage
description:
About Us
  
  
voco Orchard Singapore provide guests with the world-renowned voco™ experience from the moment they walk through its doors. Famed to be hotels to count on, yet different enough to be fun, voco hotels are unstuffy hotels where people feel comfortable to relax, and just get on with life. Hotels that stand out from the crowd, voco combines familiar comforts with the indulgences of a hotel, to create somewhere that’s dependable, but not vanilla. Somewhere premium, but with a laidback spirit. Somewhere reliable, but different.
  
  
Your Day to Day
  
  
voco Orchard Singapore is seeking a dynamic and passionate Assistant Director of Food and Beverage. You’ll manage food and beverage operations to ensuring quality service and standards are maintained to deliver a memorable guest experience. Always following government regulations concerning health, safety or other requirements.

Keep an eye on competitor activity /industry innovation. Review and approve menu design and concepts with Executive Chef
  
  
Help prepare the hotel’s annual budget and the setting of departmental goals
  
  
Monitor budget and control expenses with a focus on food, beverage and labour costs
  
  
Drive promotions that deliver great dining experiences for guests at a good value
  
  
Manage everyday activity, plan and assign work ensuring you always have the right staffing numbers
  
  
Develop your team and improve their performance through coaching and feedback, and create performance and development goals for colleagues
  
  
Make sure all food and beverage equipment is in operational condition and regularly cleaned
  
  
Make sure all food and beverage facilities including banquet/convention spaces are clean and properly stocked to anticipated business volume.
  
  
Any other ad-hoc duties
  
  
What we need from you
  
  
Bachelor’s degree / higher education qualification in Hotel Management, culinary arts, or related field preferred
  
  
College and/or advanced training in food and beverage management
  
  
3 years of related experience, including supervisory experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  
  
Must speak local language
  
  
Alcohol awareness certification and/or food service permit or valid health/food handler card, as required by local law
  
  
What we offer
  
  
We’ll reward all your hard work with a great salary and benefits – great room discount and superb training.
  
  
Join us and you’ll become part of the global IHG family – and like all families, all our individual team members share some winning characteristics. As a team, we work better together – we trust and support each other, we do the right thing and we welcome different perspectives. You need to show us you care: that you notice the little things that make a difference to guests as well as always looking for ways to improve - visit www.http://careers.ihg.com to find out more about us.
  
  
**IHG is an equal opportunity employer:** Minorities / Females / Disabled / Veterans.
  
  
voco Orchard Singapore is the newest IHG hotel to open in Singapore, and the first voco hotel to open in Southeast Asia.
  
  
The name 'voco' derives from the Latin word for ‘to invite’ or ‘to come together’, and the very first thing you’ll notice at voco Orchard Singapore is the warmth of the welcome. Both informal and indulgent at the same time, our hotels each have their own character inspired by their location, and all feature playful, personal touches that guests remember long after check-out.
  
  
Our guests are the kind of people who know exactly what they want whether they’re travelling for work or pleasure and appreciate the time and space to really indulge and enjoy.
  
  
Located at the start of Orchard Road in Singapore, the hotel provides a stay in the heart of the city with exciting dining, shopping and entertainment options right on its doorstep. Comfortable guest rooms and suites offer city views and ample space to work or relax, and award-winning restaurants and MICE facilities enhance the experience.
  
  
Our warm intuitive voco hosts are ready to tailor-make incredible and memorable cosmopolitan experiences in the heart of Singapore, bringing to guests the best of dining and entertainment experiences.

title: Director, OCT Photo Eqpt & Ops Excellence

description:
**Your Job**

You will be the key Regional Category Management connection for assigned business segments and projects. You will support early sourcing engagement and successful product launches by aligning sourcing priorities, driving material readiness, coordinating activities across procurement categories, and enabling timely decisions and risk escalation.

**Our Team**

You will work closely with Business Units, NPD Sourcing, Buyers, Quality, Project Management, Engineering, Global Category Managers and Directors, and Quality Program Management. You will also collaborate with external suppliers to support sourcing execution, material readiness, project milestones, and product launches.

**What You Will Do**

* Own sourcing execution and launch readiness for assigned projects, from business award through production launch.
* Lead Clear-to-Build reviews, material-readiness checks, and launch-readiness assessments.
* Ensure material availability supports project milestones, validation builds, ramp-up activities, and production-launch requirements.
* Coordinate low-volume production orders and other sourcing support required during project development and launch.
* Serve as the key RCM connection to Business Units and project teams, enabling earlier engagement and stronger support for NPI activities.
* Translate business priorities and project requirements into clear sourcing actions across procurement categories.
* Consolidate project status, communicate risks and decisions, and escalate issues requiring cross-functional or management support.
* Identify supply-chain risks that may affect project timing, material readiness, cost, or launch execution.
* Drive mitigation plans with accountable functional owners and track actions through closure.
* Lead sourcing-risk reviews during project development and maintain visibility of risks, mitigation progress, and escalation requirements.
* Coordinate sourcing support for engineering and supplier changes.
* Ensure sourcing impacts are assessed and incorporated into project schedules and readiness plans.
* Facilitate stakeholder alignment when project scope, timing, or priorities change.
* Perform other duties as assigned by management.

**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, Operations Management, or a related field.
* At least five years of experience in sourcing, supply chain, procurement, project management, or new product introduction, including cross-functional project leadership within a manufacturing environment.
* Knowledge of product-development and launch processes.
* Strong project-management, planning, and execution capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to influence others and drive accountability without direct authority.
* Strong supply-risk management, escalation, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Working proficiency in ERP/MRP systems and Microsoft Office applications.
* Fluent English communication skills.

**What Will Put You Ahead**

* An advanced degree or relevant professional certification in supply chain, procurement, or project management.
* Experience coordinating multi-category sourcing activities, production transfers, engineering changes, supplier changes, or complex product launches within a regional or global organization.
* Commercial and sourcing knowledge across multiple procurement categories.

description:
Singapore - Singapore

**Defying Imagination at Amgen**

At Amgen, every team member contributes to a mission that extends beyond individual roles: serving patients worldwide. This shared commitment drives our pursuit of excellence and innovation and supports Amgen’s position as a global biotechnology leader. Our collaborative culture enables us to research, manufacture, and deliver products that reach more than 10 million patients around the world. If you are seeking a career with purpose, Amgen offers an opportunity to make a meaningful difference.

**Live**

**What you will do**

Amgen is one of the world’s leading independent biotechnology companies. For over 4 decades, Amgen has pioneered biotechnology breakthroughs, to bring state-of-the-art medicines from laboratory to the patient. Amgen has not only discovered and developed innovative human therapeutics, but has invested in cutting edge manufacturing capability and support services to deliver these exciting therapies to medical teams around the world. Japan and Asia Pacific (JAPAC) is the fastest growing region in Amgen. Now we are hiring a **Senior Manager, Illicit Trade, Theft, Risk & Supplier Assurance – JAPAC** based out of **Singapore or Malaysia or Thailand.**

**Live**

**What you will do**

**Accountabilities:**

Reporting to the Senior Director, Product Security, within Global Security (GS), the Senior Manager, Illicit Trade, Theft, Risk & Supplier Assurance – JAPAC will execute on regional efforts to protect patients and Amgen products from external threats across the regulated supply chain and illicit markets.

The role covers supply chain security, illicit trade, and brand protection, with a focus on threats such as diversion, theft, counterfeiting, and unauthorized marketing of Amgen products. The Senior Manager will direct regional incident response, investigations, and remediation for the region, while coordinating with global Product Security colleagues and partners across Amgen.

The role will develop and implement regional strategies, policies, procedures, and standards in partnership with key stakeholders. It will also work with industry groups, government agencies, law enforcement, health authorities, suppliers, and other external partners to strengthen product security and patient safety across APAC.

**Responsibilities:**

* Support Product Security efforts across APAC to protect Amgen’s product portfolio from external threats, including counterfeiting, diversion, theft, illicit generics, and unauthorized marketing.
* Provide support for regional supply chain security initiatives in partnership with Supply Chain Security and Operations.
* Support and facilitate cross-functional governance with representatives from Global Security, Legal, Operations, Supply Chain, Legal, Corporate Audit, and other relevant functions.
* Define and implement regional strategies for threat monitoring, incident reporting and response, counterfeit deterrence and authentication, enforcement, and remediation.
* Collaborate with the Product Security Intelligence team to monitor physical and online markets for suspicious activity involving Amgen products.
* Investigate suspected or confirmed illicit activity affecting Amgen products, working with internal stakeholders and, as appropriate, law enforcement, health authorities, and industry partners.
* Assess threats and vulnerabilities affecting active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), materials, finished products, returns, sites, and the regulated supply chain; develop and implement mitigation plans.
* Support the development and use of tools, systems, and security technologies to monitor threats and strengthen protection across the supply chain.
* Provide Amgen leaders with metrics, key performance indicators, and reports on emerging and ongoing threats in the region.
* Develop and deliver education and awareness initiatives for internal and external audiences.
* Represent Amgen in relevant industry and government working groups, task forces, and committees, and advocate for the company’s interests.
* Coordinate the regional supply chain security audit framework and program in partnership with internal stakeholders.
* Facilitate proactive, for-cause, and pre-contract security audits of vendors, suppliers, and business partners.
* Build and maintain relationships with law enforcement, emergency services, health authorities, and other relevant agencies to support effective communication and response.
* Coordinate with regional and functional directorates across Global Security and with global Product Security colleagues to align efforts.
* Select, train, and manage contract workers and consultants, as needed. This may include drafting requests for proposals, making recommendations, negotiating contracts, providing direction, and reviewing deliverables and invoices.
* Conduct and manage internal and external investigations as needed, maintaining appropriate chain of custody and evidence management.

**Win**

**What we expect of you**

**Qualifications and Expectations**

* Extensive knowledge of illicit supply chains, supply chain security, and effective investigation and remediation practices.
* Demonstrated experience conducting or managing investigations involving organized criminal activity.
* Expertise in chain of custody and evidence management.
* Strong working knowledge of GxP environments, including GMP and GDP.
* Experience with supply chain security standards and programs, such as TAPA and CTPAT.
* Experience conducting or supporting supply chain security audits and assessments, identifying control gaps, and recommending corrective actions.
* Proficiency with security systems and the ability to assess their effectiveness, recognize limitations, and recommend improvements.
* Sound judgment and the ability to act swiftly in a dynamic threat environment.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to gather and evaluate information and prepare clear, concise reports.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks, work well under pressure, and communicate effectively with leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including consensus-building, presentation, and professional writing abilities.
* Ability to influence, engage, and inspire teams, and to build effective relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Experience working with key partners as part of an Incident Management Team.
* Self-motivated and able to work independently while collaborating across a complex organization.
* Commitment to the highest standards of integrity, compliance, and confidentiality.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree and seven to nine years of experience in private-sector global or corporate supply chain security, enforcement, investigations, or related program management; biopharmaceutical industry experience preferred.
* Experience working across APAC markets and with regional law enforcement, health authorities, industry groups, or other relevant partners.
* Supervisory law enforcement and/or military experience desirable but not required.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Willingness to travel approximately 20% of the time, including overnight and weekend travel.
* Professional security or investigative certifications, such as Certified Protection Professional (CPP), Physical Security Professional (PSP), or Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), preferred but not required.

**Thrive**

**What you can expect of us**

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, so we work to care for our teammates’ professional

and personal growth and well-being.

* Vast opportunities to learn and move up and across our global organization

* Diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where teammates are empowered to bring ideas to the table and act

* Generous Total Rewards Plan comprising health, finance and wealth, work/life balance, and career benefits

title: Strategy & Corporate Development Manager
description:
About Peak Energy
  
  
Headquartered in Singapore, Peak Energy develops, owns, and operates renewable assets across Asia Pacific (APAC). With over 300 MW of operating assets and 1 GW of projects in development, our portfolio spans Japan, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, the Philippines, Thailand, Singapore and Indonesia. With activities encompassing the full range of renewable energy business models - including utility-scale development, off-site PPAs, onsite PPAs, and energy storage applications – Peak Energy is a one-stop partner for corporates seeking to decarbonize their operations in APAC. We believe in establishing long-term partnerships with our corporate customers, to accompany them in their decarbonization journey, through cleaner, cheaper energy. Peak Energy is wholly owned by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets with approximatively USD 84 billion of assets under management.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and high‑performing Strategy Manager to join our Strategy & Corporate Development team. This is a pivotal role responsible for shaping Peak Energy’s strategic direction, supporting major investment decisions, and partnering closely with senior leadership across multiple markets.
  
  
The Strategy Manager will lead critical workstreams, manage interns or associates, contribute to Peak’s medium‑term strategy, and support corporate development and capital‑related initiatives across Asia.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Strategic Planning and Market intelligence
  
  
Lead the development of Peak Energy’s medium‑term business plan, portfolio strategy, and strategic priorities across markets.
  
  
Build and maintain a data‑driven market intelligence capability to support strategic decision‑making across the organization.
  
  
Own market, policy, regulatory, and competitive intelligence across multiple geographies.
  
  
Synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative insights into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
  
  
Partner with regional teams to assess market attractiveness, entry strategies, and growth opportunities.
  
  
2. Growth Capital & Investor insights
  
  
Analyze investor trends, capital flows, and transaction activity across renewable energy and infrastructure markets.
  
  
Generate forward‑looking intelligence on funding structures, risk appetite, and cost of capital.
  
  
Engage with investors, lenders, advisors, and other market participants to maintain a strong understanding of market dynamics.
  
  
Translate market engagement into strategic insights to inform capital strategy and deployment decisions.
  
  
Prepare high‑quality capital‑related materials, including investment narratives, strategy decks, and briefing papers.
  
  
3. Investment Decision Support & Corporate Development
  
  
Support Investment Committee (IC) processes, including commercial evaluation, risk analysis, and structuring of materials for investment approvals.
  
  
Review and challenge financial models, stress‑test assumptions, and ensure consistency with Peak Energy’s investment framework.
  
  
Support M&A, partnerships, joint ventures, and other corporate development initiatives, from initial assessment through execution.
  
  
Contribute strategic perspectives to investment theses and transaction structuring discussions.
  
  
4. Investor & Stakeholder Relations
  
  
Prepare high‑quality IC materials, Board summaries, and investor‑facing presentations.
  
  
Maintain clear, consistent, and professional communication with shareholders, ensuring timely sharing of updates and key information.
  
  
Project manage the preparation and delivery of quarterly reports to shareholders and associated financial models, ensuring accuracy and on‑time contributions from all teams.
  
  
Support the preparation and coordination of quarterly Board of Director meetings, including materials, briefings, and follow‑ups.
  
  
Ensure key communications and decisions are clearly conveyed to internal teams in a structured and effective manner.
  
  
5. Organisational & Operational Improvement
  
  
Identify and implement process, reporting, and organisational improvements to enhance decision‑making quality and speed.
  
  
Support the CEO, COO, and senior leadership with ad hoc strategic analysis and problem‑solving.
  
  
Establish best‑practice frameworks, processes, and templates across strategy, planning, and investment activities.
  
  
Assess the organisation’s requirements for artificial intelligence and advanced analytics, and develop a roadmap for adoption, integration, and value creation.
  
  
Lead or support strategic initiatives focused on sales excellence, operational efficiency, and cross‑functional collaboration to unlock growth opportunities.
  
  
Qualifications & Experience
  
  
MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.
  
  
Experience in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, investment banking, private equity, infrastructure project finance, or a high‑growth operating environment.
  
  
Proven track record of leading strategic projects end to end and influencing senior stakeholders.
  
  
**Strong commercial and financial acumen, including:**  
Understanding of IRR, cash flow statements, valuation methodologies, and project finance structures
  
  
Proficiency in financial modelling and analysis
  
  
Excellent problem‑solving and communication skills; ability to independently structure and solve complex problems.
  
  
Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI or similar tools is advantageous.
  
  
Passion for the energy transition and strong interest in renewables, energy storage, and infrastructure.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
High‑visibility role with direct exposure to senior leadership and investors.
  
  
Opportunity to shape strategy for a fast‑growing, pan‑Asian renewable energy platform.
  
  
A collaborative, mission‑driven culture with significant scope for ownership, impact, and career growth.
  
  
Peak Energy is a renewable energy platform with a focus on developing solar, wind and battery projects across Asia. As the region's consumption of energy rises, Peak Energy is dedicated to meeting these demands while contributing to carbon neutrality. We accomplish this by developing large utility-scale projects. These include some of the largest solar and wind farms in Korea and Japan.
  
  
Peak Energy is the renewable arm of Stonepeak Infrastructure Partners; a leading global infrastructure investment firm with +USD 57 Bn in assets under management. Our portfolio includes the offshore wind farm in Taiwan with plans to develop a further +5 GWp.
  
  
Our team has decades of experience and long-standing relationships. This combination of knowledge and relationships, combined with expertise in design and supply chains enables Peak Energy to deliver high performing, robust alternative energy systems on time and under budget.
  
  
At Peak Energy, you'll collaborate with passionate individuals, drive meaningful impact, and be at the forefront of Asia’s transition to renewable energy. We believe everyone is needed for carbon neutrality. Therefore, fresh ideas are always welcomed. Are you excited about disrupting traditional energy sources and developing a sustainable future? Come join our team and be a part of the energy revolution with Peak Energy!

title: Director, Securities Audit Lead, Internal Audit Department - SMBC
description:
Internal Audit department, Asia Pacific Division (IADAP) of SMBC is responsible for the audits of SMBC units and activities in Asia Pacific region, assessing the adequacy and effectiveness of internal control system, governance, risk management frameworks , operations and compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
  
  
With the expansion of APAC business and the broadened mandate to include Securities group companies under the parent holding company, Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group (SMFG), IADAP requires a senior leader to build and lead audit coverage of global markets and securities businesses.
  
  
As Securities Audit Lead, you will add value and improve the Bank/Securities Group Company's operations by bringing an efficient and disciplined approach to the effectiveness of risk management, control, and governance processes of Bank/Group Companies, specifically for global markets and securities businesses.
  
  
Y ou will travel and work closely with cross-functional and other group companies audit teams on a global and regional scale to deliver high-quality audit services. You will have the opportunity to work with stakeholders to evaluate internal controls and providing recommendations to strengthen these processes.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop a team of securities auditors
* Act as engagement lead for global markets and securities audits, including planning, key control evaluation and testing, report drafting and issues follow-up and closure in accordance with the Bank internal audit methodology.
* Coordinate with securities group company audit functions, including joint audit planning.
* Promote data analytics to assess the internal control environment.
* Establish and develop good working relationship with Management of Business Units relevant to global markets and securities businesses.
* Drive annual risk assessment and continuous monitoring for global markets and securities business by developing good understanding of business strategy, plans, products, processes performance, risks and issues to drive appropriate ongoing audit coverage.
* Represent IADAP in Bank's strategic initiatives / project meeting to promote / enhance the organisation's governance and risk culture.
* Contribute to the department's strategic initiatives and projects as opportunities arise

**Job Requirements**

* Approximately 15 years of experience in internal or external audit within the financial services or bank-securities industry, including at least 5 years leading Global Markets / securities audits and managing audit teams.
* Experience auditing securities or broker-dealer entities, or coordinating audits across group entities. Knowledge of Japanese securities firms is an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of FICC, equities, derivatives and global markets products and related risk frameworks.
* Familiar with execution of risk-based audit approach
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present audit findings and recommendations effectively.
* Good interpersonal and stakeholder management skills
* Degree in Finance/Business, or CPA or equivalent professional qualification.

title: Head of Contender & Feeder Series
description:
### **ABOUT WORLD TABLE TENNIS**

World Table Tennis is where the sport’s fiercest battles meet bold ideas and creative minds. WTT is powered by a global crew of innovators, storytellers, and game-changers, who bring energy, expertise, and imagination to everything they do.

We’re not your typical workplace; we’re the global engine behind a sport on the rise. So whether it’s staging iconic global events or redefining fan experiences, this is where bold ideas get built, and where every role has impact. At WTT, the arena simply hits different.

### **HEAD OF CONTENDER & FEEDER SERIES**

The Head of Contender & Feeder Series is responsible for the overall oversight, coordination and consistent delivery of WTT Star Contender, WTT Contender and WTT Feeder events worldwide.

In addition, the position oversees the coordination and development of central event services, ensuring consistent operational standards, efficient resource allocation and effective support across the WTT event portfolio.

The successful candidate will provide leadership to Event Managers and Competition Managers, work closely with Local Organising Committees (LOCs) and WTT departments, and contribute to improving event quality, operational efficiency and financial sustainability.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES**

##### **Event Portfolio Leadership & Delivery:**

* Oversee the planning, preparation and delivery of WTT Star Contender, Contender and Feeder events.
* Ensure consistent implementation of WTT event manuals, competition requirements and operational standards.
* Monitor event readiness, timelines, budgets and operational risks, providing guidance and intervention where required.
* Support event managers and competition managers in delivering high-quality events and resolving operational challenges.
* Ensure consistent service standards for players, officials, sport presentation and other stakeholders.

##### **Central Event Services:**

* Oversee the coordination and continuous improvement of central event services supporting the wider WTT event portfolio.
* Develop and maintain standardised operational procedures, planning tools, templates and reporting systems.
* Coordinate shared event logistics, operational support services and supplier requirements with relevant WTT departments.
* Support the development and implementation of event management systems, including accreditation, entries and operational reporting.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce duplication and optimise resources across events.
* Work closely with the heads of grand smash and champions to ensure consistent operational support across the WTT event portfolio.

##### **LOC & Stakeholder Management:**

* Maintain strong relationships with locs, national associations, host organisations and key stakeholders.
* Ensure event organisers understand and fulfil their contractual and operational obligations.
* Support the evaluation of potential host locations and event organisers.
* Participate in site inspections, planning meetings and event evaluations.
* Act as the senior escalation point for significant operational and stakeholder-related issues.

##### **Financial & Resource Management:**

* Monitor operational budgets and financial performance across the contender and feeder series.
* Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency and the financial sustainability of events.
* Support the evaluation of hosting proposals, operational budgets and resource requirements.
* Coordinate the effective allocation of event managers, competition managers and shared event resources.
* Work with WTT finance and relevant departments to monitor operational expenditure and event performance.

##### **Team Leadership & Cross-Departmental Coordination:**

* Provide leadership, direction and support to assigned event managers and competition managers.
* Establish clear responsibilities, objectives and performance expectations.
* Coordinate with WTT competition, operations, hospitality, it, commercial, sport presentation and creative media & engagement departments.
* Promote collaboration, accountability and knowledge sharing across the events team.
* Support staff development and continuous improvement of event delivery processes.

##### **Performance Review & Continuous Improvement:**

* Oversee post-event evaluations and ensure timely reporting.
* Identify recurring operational challenges and implement improvements across the portfolio.
* Contribute to the development and updating of WTT event manuals and operational guidelines.
* Promote innovation and the use of technology to improve operational efficiency and event quality.

### **REQUIREMENTS**

##### **Essentials:**

* Degree or equivalent qualification in sports management, event management, business administration or a related field.
* Significant experience in international sports event management, with a proven track record of overseeing multiple events and leading multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong understanding of event operations, competition management, logistics and stakeholder services.
* Experience working with Local Organising Committees (LOCs), national federations and international stakeholders.
* Strong project management, budgeting and resource planning skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, digital collaboration tools and event management systems.
* Willingness to travel internationally and work flexible hours during event periods.

##### **Desirables:**

* Experience delivering international table tennis events or events in other racket sports.
* Experience implementing or improving event management systems, particularly for accreditation, entries or operational reporting.
* Experience coordinating shared operational services across multiple events, such as staffing, logistics or supplier support.

title: Head, Transformation Execution
description:
**Job Profile Summary:**  
Prudential Singapore is advancing a bold transformation agenda under our Prudential initiatives — reshaping how we execute with discipline, rigor, and strategic foresight to enable sustainable value creation. This demands strong delivery governance, system stewardship, and execution maturity at scale.
  
  
The Strategy & Transformation Office (STO) anchors this transformation —ensuring the company’s most critical initiatives are delivered with speed, integrity, and results. This requires a step-change in how we lead execution across a complex, multi-year portfolio, embedding the capability and rhythm to deliver on ambition.
  
  
Role Purpose and Summary
  
  
As Head of Transformation Execution, you will lead PACS' enterprise delivery engine - ensuring that our strategic transformation portfolio translates strategy into measurable business outcomes. Beyond establishing delivery discipline and transparency, you will work with business leaders to actively shape execution choices, unblock performance, and strengthen the conditions required to realise value across the portfolio.
  
  
You will act as a key counterpart to the CSTO, anchoring cadence forums such as TWG while working closely with business, operations, finance, and technology leaders to improve portfolio performance. You will use health checks, diagnostics, and benefits insights to identify where intervention is needed, influence the movement of key value metrics, and lead special projects or performance recovery efforts where complexity or urgency is high.
  
  
This role is for a strategic operator — someone who can bridge execution muscle with leadership maturity, able to translate complexity into clarity and deliver results at scale.
  
  
**Job Description:**  
Transformation Operating Rhythm
  
  

* Lead the Transformation Working Group (TWG), ensuring timely visibility of delivery health, interdependencies, and escalation points
* Shape the cadence of enterprise delivery— linking ambition, initiative health, and decision-making forums
* Translate portfolio insights into action by working with accountable executives and initiative teams to remove delivery barriers, make trade-offs, and improve execution outcomes

Program Governance & Risk Management
  
  

* Steward the enterprise transformation portfolio (High 8 digit value), driving project health checks, portfolio diagnostics, and recovery plans
* Own delivery governance — ensure standards are applied, risks are surfaced early, and decisions are acted upon
* Interface directly with Group Technology, Group Transformation, Group Risk, and Audit

Portfolio Value & Benefits Realisation
  
  

* Lead portfolio-level benefits realisation, ensuring delivery milestones are connected to measurable business outcomes and value metrics through Kiplot, Power BI, or equivalent tools
* Partner with business, Finance, and Strategy leaders to validate benefit assumptions, establish clear baselines and owners, and maintain alignment between initiative impact, strategic priorities, and commercial outcomes
* Work closely with business owners to diagnose why expected benefits or performance metrics are not moving, agree targeted interventions, and influence corrective action across initiatives
* Provide a portfolio-wide view of benefits, including value at risk, cross-initiative dependencies, emerging trade-offs, and opportunities to accelerate or increase value
* Challenge initiative teams constructively on benefit ambition, delivery choices, and outcome evidence, escalating material gaps while retaining clear business accountability for realisation

Execution Uplift & Capability Building
  
  

* Strengthen execution discipline through tools, templates, coaching, and feedback loops
* Partner with project managers, change leads, and business stakeholders to raise the bar of delivery rigor

Special Projects, Health Checks & Execution (COE)
  
  

* Lead initiative and program health checks to assess readiness, risk, and performance gaps
* Stand up and deploy impact teams into high-priority or at-risk initiatives
* Drive special projects or turnaround missions requiring rapid mobilization and leadership
* Represent PACS’ internal execution capability— offering structured support into enterprise-critical issues

**Who we are looking for:**  
Competencies and Behaviours Expected
  
  
·
  
  
Execution Discipline & Leadership Maturity
  
  
: You bring structure, insight, and calm under pressure. You operate with ownership, integrity, and high judgment
  
  
·
  
  
**Business Partnership & Value Influence:**  
You combine commercial judgement, data, and constructive challenge to help business leaders shift performance metrics and realise value, without taking accountability away from benefit owners
  
  
·
  
  
Systems Thinking & Interdependency Navigation
  
  
: You see the whole —connecting across teams, functions, and forums to keep the system aligned and focused
  
  
·
  
  
Strategic & Delivery Fluency
  
  
: You speak both strategy and execution. You elevate enterprise conversations by grounding them in risk, capacity, and cadence
  
  
·
  
  
Performance Uplift & Coaching
  
  
: You model and embed high standards. You’re comfortable giving feedback, growing talent, and building enduring systems
  
  
Role Requirements / What You Bring to the Team
  
  
You are a senior transformation leader with deep experience navigating complex portfolios and operating models. You understand how to lead through systems —balancing stakeholder alignment, governance design, and execution performance. You bring presence, resilience, and sharp delivery instincts.
  
  
PRUDENTIAL ASSURANCE COMPANY SINGAPORE (PTE) LIMITED

title: Head of Human Capital
description:

Lead the organisation's People & Culture function, combining reliable HR operations with strategic workforce and talent development. Ensure employees are recruited well, supported fairly, developed intentionally and connected to the organisation's mission and values.
  
  
The role is both strategic and hands-on, providing advice to leadership while overseeing day-to-day HR delivery, governance, culture, capability, and future workforce needs.

Build succession plans and talent pipelines for critical roles.

Strengthen the employee experience from onboarding to exit.

Drive learning, leadership development, coaching and manager capability-building.

Partner with Organisational Development and leaders to strengthen values, serving leadership and workplace culture.
  
  
Lead staff engagement, listening, recognition and wellbeing initiatives, with visible follow-through.
  
  
Compensation and employee relations

Manage annual salary and bonus reviews and oversee payroll controls.
  
  
Provide trusted advice on grievances, disciplinary matters, performance concerns and sensitive conversations.
  
  
Communication and change
  
  
Communicate policies, benefits, people initiatives and organisational changes clearly and sensitively.
  
  
Support leaders and managers in explaining people decisions and guiding employees through change.
  
  
Others
  
  
Any other related duties in New Hope CSL as assigned by Reporting Officer
  
  
Accountability
  
  
Reports to Deputy Director of Organisational Development
  
  
Competency Requirement
  
  
Core Competencies
  
  
Aligned with the New Hope CSL's mission and values.
  
  
Strategic but willing to be hands-on.
  
  
Empathetic, fair and decisive, with high integrity.
  
  
Collaborative, self-directed and confident in handling sensitive matters.
  
  
Strong knowledge of employment practices, employee relations, compensation, benefits and HR governance.
  
  
Experience in workforce planning, competency frameworks, performance, learning or succession planning.
  
  
Strong communication, judgement, discretion, coaching and change management skills.
  
  
Technical Competencies
  
  
Proficiency in IT Systems and Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).
  
  
Education and Experience
  
  
Degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, Organisational Development or a related field.
  
  
At least 10 years of progressive HR or People & Culture experience, including 3 to 5 years in a senior role.
  
  
Experience across HR operations and strategic talent or human capital development.
  
  
Social service or non-profit experience is preferred.
  
  
The intent of this job description is to provide a representative summary of the major duties and responsibilities of the position. You may be required to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically presented in this description. This job description does not constitute a contract of employment.
  
  
New Hope Community Services (New Hope CS) is a social service agency working to bring change into the lives of the displaced and disadvantaged in the community.
  
  
Since 2004, we have been empowering our beneficiaries with opportunities to better their own lives. We provide a range of services and programmes such as temporary shelter, casework, mentoring, job-matching, life-skills training and support with long-term housing and employment. Together with our 3P Partners — Public, Private and People — we serve all people regardless of race or religion.
  
  
We are a full member of the National Council of Social Service since 2005 and have been granted Institutions of a Public Character (IPC) status until 2026.
  
  
Our Vision
  
  
To be a Beacon of New Hope to the Displaced and Disadvantaged in the Community.

Livestock Express is the global leader in safe livestock transportation. From our Singapore office, we manage every aspect of our vessels in-house, including chartering, operations, ship management and QHSE.

You will manage assigned commercial contracts from start to finish, helping every voyage deliver the best possible operational and financial result.

Proficient in MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  
  
A proactive, organised team player who communicates clearly and stays calm under pressure

Applicants must be legally eligible to work in Singapore

Join a global market leader with a clear purpose and a collaborative Singapore-based team. You will gain broad exposure across chartering, operations and ship management, with the opportunity to develop your shipping career.

title: Head of Membership
description:
The Role
  
  
We are seeking a commercially driven and personable Head of Membership to grow our membership community, strengthen retention and lead the complete Member journey—from the first enquiry and Club tour to onboarding, everyday visits and renewal.
  
  
The role leads both the Membership team and the Member Experience team, with direct responsibility for reservations, concierge services, Member recognition and relationship management. It combines strategic commercial leadership with hands-on oversight of the interactions that shape how Members experience the Club.
  
  
The successful candidate will be a confident ambassador and a genuine host: someone who builds lasting relationships, understands individual preferences and ensures Members feel recognised, valued and connected. Success will be measured not simply by new memberships secured, but by the strength, engagement and loyalty of the community.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Membership Strategy, Acquisition & Revenue
  
  

* Develop and deliver the annual membership strategy and departmental budget, taking accountability for acquisition, joining-fee and subscription revenue, retention and net membership growth.
* Build a qualified prospect pipeline through Member referrals, corporate relationships, strategic partnerships, wine and food communities, and targeted initiatives developed with Marketing and Commercial & Events.
* Lead the enquiry-to-membership process, ensuring timely follow-up, engaging Club tours, clear communication of membership value and consistent application of the Club’s admission procedures.
* Maintain accurate forecasts and conversion reporting, assessing acquisition channels and campaign results to direct resources towards effective, sustainable growth.

2. Member Experience Team Leadership
  
  

* Directly manage the Member Experience team, overseeing reservations, concierge services, arrivals, Member recognition and day-to-day enquiries. Establish clear service standards, responsibilities and escalation procedures.
* Ensure every interaction—from a telephone call or reservation request to arrival and departure—is warm, professional, accurate and discreet.
* Oversee reservation management, waitlists and special requests, working closely with Operations to balance availability, Member access and service capacity in accordance with approved Club policies.
* Establish regular reviews of forthcoming reservations so that Member preferences, first visits, special occasions and relevant service requirements are communicated to Operations, Culinary and Wine teams before arrival.

3. Onboarding, Engagement & Community Building
  
  

* Own a structured onboarding journey, including welcome communications, Club orientation, team introductions and follow-up throughout the first 90 days, helping new Members feel comfortable and become active participants in Club life.
* Maintain a visible presence in the Club, building relationships beyond formal appointments and ensuring recognition extends across the membership community.
* Use Member interests, preferences and feedback to recommend relevant dining experiences, tastings, masterclasses and social occasions, encouraging participation without making interactions feel transactional.
* Work with Marketing, Commercial & Events, Wine and Operations to shape engaging programmes and communications, contributing Member insight while coordinating with the teams responsible for delivery.

4. Retention, Relationships & Service Recovery
  
  

* Lead a proactive retention programme, identifying reduced engagement, unresolved concerns and other signs of potential resignation, with clear ownership of personalised follow-up.
* Oversee renewals, reactivations and resignation requests, ensuring Members receive timely, accurate information and that the reasons behind departures are understood and reported.
* Take ownership of sensitive Member concerns and escalated complaints, coordinating appropriate resolution with the General Manager and relevant departments and following through directly with the Member.
* Turn recurring feedback into practical improvements to service, communication and the membership experience, rather than treating each concern as an isolated case.

5. Membership Administration, Systems & Governance
  
  

* Oversee accurate processing of applications, approvals, membership categories, account changes and benefits, applying approved fees and policies consistently and escalating exceptions for authorisation.
* Work closely with Finance on subscription notices, billing information, payment follow-up and account discrepancies, ensuring financial accuracy without compromising the Member relationship.
* Maintain the quality of membership and Member Experience records across the Club’s membership systems and SevenRooms, working with authorised colleagues to keep profiles, preferences and interaction histories accurate.
* Protect confidential Member information, uphold agreed data-access and amendment procedures, and provide regular reporting on acquisition, renewals, resignations, engagement and service performance.

6. Team Development & Cross-Club Collaboration
  
  

* Recruit, coach and develop the Membership and Member Experience teams, with clear objectives, regular feedback and practical training in Club knowledge, communication, hosting and service recovery.
* Manage staffing, rosters and departmental resources to provide appropriate coverage during operating hours, peak periods and key Club events.
* Build a culture of ownership: team members should anticipate needs, communicate clearly and follow requests through to resolution rather than simply passing them between departments.
* Work closely with Group Membership leadership and counterparts across the Clubs to maintain consistent standards, coordinate visiting-Member arrangements and support access to approved reciprocal privileges.

Candidate Requirements
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  

* Proven experience in a luxury private members’ club or a similarly exclusive, membership-led hospitality environment, with a strong understanding of member expectations, discretion, personalised service and club culture.
* Substantial experience in membership management, relationship management or premium hospitality, including responsibility for leading teams and delivering measurable business and service outcomes.
* Demonstrated success in growing membership or a comparable high-value client portfolio, improving retention, building referral networks and developing long-term relationships.
* Experience personally engaging with senior executives, high-profile individuals and discerning international clientele, while maintaining confidentiality and professional boundaries.

Commercial & Operational Capabilities
  
  

* Strong understanding of the full membership lifecycle, including prospecting, Club tours, applications, onboarding, engagement, renewals, reactivations and service recovery.
* Commercial acumen, with the ability to set targets, manage departmental budgets, forecast membership revenue, monitor conversion and retention, and turn performance data into action.
* Working knowledge of CRM and membership systems, with the ability to maintain accurate Member profiles and reporting; experience with SevenRooms or equivalent guest relationship platforms is advantageous.
* Sound judgment in managing reservations, concierge arrangements, sensitive Member requests and service escalations in a high-touch hospitality setting.

Leadership, Relationships & Personal Attributes
  
  

* A polished, approachable and confident host with outstanding interpersonal, presentation and written communication skills, able to build trust and represent the Club with credibility.
* A hands-on people leader who can coach, motivate and hold Membership and Member Experience teams accountable for consistently exceptional standards.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Operations, Wine, Culinary, Marketing, Events and Finance.
* Highly organised, culturally aware and solutions-oriented, with calm judgment under pressure, close attention to detail and a proactive approach to anticipating Members’ needs.
* Willingness to maintain a visible presence at the Club and support evening, weekend or special Member events as business needs require.

Additional Advantages
  
  

* An established professional network within Singapore’s premium hospitality, private club, corporate or luxury lifestyle communities, with the ability to create meaningful introductions and partnerships.
* A genuine interest in fine wine, gastronomy and curated cultural experiences, aligned with 67 Pall Mall’s membership community.
* Relevant qualifications in hospitality management, business, marketing or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience is equally valued.

**Standard Worldwide:**  
67 Pall Mall is a private members’ club like no other – founded by wine lovers, for wine lovers.
  
  
**Standard Worldwide:**  
This is a club which actively encourages members to share interest in the world’s finest wines with like-minded people; with a diverse wine list crafted to excite, challenge and captivate the club’s members.
  
  
**Country Specific:**  
From the historical penthouse on the top floor of Shaw Centre, we exist to bring people together over a shared love of wine, primarily to experience the diversity of our cellar, but also to meet new people and hear new ideas. We want to create a unique ambience, a sense of belonging and community, where wine enthusiasts from all walks of life can enjoy their passion.
  
  
**Standard Worldwide:**  
We encourage motivated individuals to join our diverse and inclusive team, where your unique perspectives and experiences are valued and celebrated.

title: Head of Commercial Operations, APAC
description:
Purpose
  
  
This is a senior leadership role with accountability for the performance and transformation of Commercial Operations across 10 APAC markets. The role spans two equally important mandates: running a high-performing, cost-efficient operations function today and leading the multi-year programme to modernise it. The right candidate will be as comfortable in a quarterly performance review as they are shaping a three-year automation roadmap and credible with underwriters, technology teams, and senior regional leadership alike.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Operational Leadership
  
  
Own end-to-end Commercial Ops performance across APAC — issuance, bookings, submissions, indexing, renewals, and endorsements.
  
  
Drive productivity, quality, and cost-to-serve targets.
  
  
Lead and develop a distributed team of operations managers and senior specialists, including in CBS hub teams in Philippines and KL.
  
  
Partner closely with P&C and A&H underwriting leaders to ensure operational delivery aligns with underwriting appetite and service expectations.
  
  
Maintain clear performance frameworks that give senior stakeholders timely and accurate visibility of ops health — reporting cadences, KPIs, escalation paths
  
  
Manage operational risk proactively, including process controls, audit readiness, and regulatory compliance across markets.
  
  
Transformation & Change
  
  
Lead the Commercial Ops transformation programme including automation initiatives, workflow platforms, and legacy system migration from business case through to benefits realisation.
  
  
Define and own the multi-year FTE and cost reduction roadmap, ensuring initiative sequencing is realistic and savings are trackable.
  
  
Act as the primary commercial operations voice in enterprise transformation programmes.
  
  
Build the case for investment where required; prepare and present business cases to regional and global stakeholders.
  
  
Drive adoption of new tools and processes across markets, managing the people and change dimension in step with the technical delivery owners.
  
  
Establish baseline measurement and benefits tracking frameworks so transformation impact can be reported with confidence.
  
  
Stakeholder Engagement
  
  
Build trusted relationships with underwriting, finance, technology, and HR leaders across APAC markets.
  
  
Influence without authority — navigate complex, matrixed stakeholder environments to drive alignment and move programmes forward.
  
  
Represent Commercial Ops in regional leadership forums; provide clear, evidence-based reporting to the Head of Operations & Transformation, APAC.
  
  
Engage with country-level operations teams and market heads to embed regional strategy within local delivery.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
Essential
  
  
Substantial experience in P&C commercial insurance operations; direct underwriting operations or underwriting leadership experience is required; candidates without this background will not be considered.
  
  
Demonstrated track record leading operational teams across multiple APAC markets, ideally including hub or shared services environments.
  
  
Experience owning and delivering transformation programmes (not just participating in them) with measurable outcomes in efficiency or FTE reduction.
  
  
Strong commercial acumen; able to build, defend, and track business cases for investment.
  
  
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders across underwriting, finance, and technology in a matrixed organisation.
  
  
Excellent communication skills; equally effective in an exec briefing as in a working-level problem-solving session.
  
  
Highly Regarded
  
  
Familiarity with automation and AI tools in an insurance operations context — workflow platforms, intelligent document processing, and unstructured data ingestion.
  
  
Experience working with centralised processing hub models in APAC.
  
  
Exposure to commercial insurance systems such as Duck Creek, Quadient or equivalent policy administration platforms.
  
  
Formal programme or change management credentials (e.g. PMP, MSP, Prosci) are a plus, though not required.

We have an exciting opportunity and are looking for someone who can match our passion and commitment to our customers and partners.
