description:
Asendia empowers businesses to grow across borders with a range of international e-commerce and mail delivery services. Launched in 2012 by La Poste and Swiss Post, Asendia has the combined expertise of over 1500 employees across 4 continents. With operations across the world, we bring together a wealth of international and local expertise, and a network that delivers to over 200 countries and territories. Asendia’s heritage as a mail business is unrivalled, but today we are also at the forefront in providing e-commerce parcel solutions for e-tailers selling internationally. We provide a number of value-added services too, including returns, fulfilment and lettersshops, and we have acquired a number of companies to enhance our services, including eShopWorld a global e-commerce software business.
  
  
Asendia is committed to providing equal opportunities. In accordance with the applicable local laws, regulations, and ordinances, all qualified applicants will receive fair consideration for employment without regard to age, race, gender, religion, national origin, ethnicity, sexual orientation, marital status and family responsibilities, disability, or any other protected characteristics.
  
  
WE ARE LOOKING FOR........
  
  
Senior Associate, Finance
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
We are seeking a
  
  
Senior Associate, Finance
  
  
to join our team in Singapore. Reporting to Head of Finance, Singapore / South Asia, you will predominantly be responsible for overseeing end-to-end financial control, reporting, and compliance for Asendia Singapore entity, including strong financial close, balance sheet governance and accurate billing across cross-border logistics, e-commerce, and postal services. You will partner closely with stakeholders to safeguard revenue integrity, cash flow, and overall financial performance.

Oversee financial close processes and maintain strong balance sheet controls.
  
  
Prepare management accounts in accordance with Singapore / International Financial Reporting Standards.
  
  
Prepare financial and variance analysis, and performance insights for management and HQ.
  
  
Support internal and external audits.
  
  
2. Accounts Receivable (AR) & Cash Flow Management
  
  
Oversee end-to-end AR processes to drive timely collections in collaboration with Sales.
  
  
Monitor Account Receivable aging, Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), and customer credit exposure, managing escalation and credit controls.
  
  
3. Billing & Revenue Governance
  
  
Own and govern billing processes and ensure alignment with contractual terms and agreements.
  
  
4. Tax & Statutory Compliance
  
  
Ensure compliance with Singapore tax and statutory requirements.
  
  
Support cross-border tax matters and ensure accurate handling of duties, taxes and foreign exchange documents.
  
  
5. Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management
  
  
Act as a finance business partner across stakeholders, providing financial input on pricing, contracts, and business initiatives.
  
  
Any job-related tasks as assigned by supervisor.
  
  
Your Profile
  
  
A. Qualifications
  
  
A minimum of a degree in Accounting or Finance, or equivalent; professional qualification advantageous (e.g. CA/CPA/ACCA).
  
  
Minimum 8 years’ experience in finance control, preferably in logistics, e-commerce, or supply chain.
  
  
Hands-on experience with SAP FI/CO preferred and shared service models.
  
  
B. Core Competencies
  
  
i. Driving Success
  
  
Ensures the work being done adds value by contributing to the growth of the business
  
  
Executes on strategic plans and provides improvement measures to management
  
  
ii. Communicating Information
  
  
Confidently delivers consistent and clear messaging to diverse audiences
  
  
Challenges the status quo
  
  
iii. Adjusting to Change
  
  
Demonstrates willingness to move out of comfort zone
  
  
Empowering of business to identify and actively drive change to reach business objectives
  
  
Our Facts
  
  
**Our Vision:** We empower our customers worldwide with seamless access to global markets through our innovative and sustainable cross-border e-commerce logistics solutions.
  
  
**Our Values:** Deliver for our customers, Strive for excellence, Collaborate as one team.
  
  
**Our APAC Core Competencies:** Driving success, Communicating information, and Adjusting to change are essential competencies that drive our strategy in APAC.
  
  
Employees wellbeing and corporate social responsibility are at the heart of our core values. We wish to instil a strong culture of corporate social responsibility within every employee and hope to create a positive and productive environment where employees can thrive.

description:
Description:

Description:

Your background

* At least 1 year experience in banking industry in a client-facing capacity is a MUST
* Preference to candidates who have prior relevant banking experience in Asia with knowledge of Treasury Management products & implementation of the same (especially multi-geography H2H implementations)
* ISO 20022 XML standard
* Transmission protocols such as SFTP, FTPS and AS2
* Swift FileAct
* Ability to deal effectively with multiple deadline-driven, customer-sensitive projects and tasks across multiple countries.
* The ability to negotiate and adapt to complex, multifunctional relationships within the client environment as well as the bank environment.
* Comfortable with direct client and line partner interaction, with proven client interaction abilities (at both senior decision making and day to day operations levels)
* Capable of understanding new information at a rapid pace and apply to the work
* Ability to present ideas and information effectively in group settings
* Demonstrate initiative, critical thinking, follow-through, flexibility and ability to work with minimum supervision
* Very strong analytical, problem solving, ideation and time management skills
* Expert in Microsoft Office (and/or other analytical software)
* Strong writing, presentation and oral communication skills
* Able to take high level information and drill down to detail level that can be shared and communicated to various audience levels
* Excellent interpersonal skills; positive attitude; team player; and flexible

What you can expect

As Client Migration Advisor, you will work as part of a team to successfully migrate our clients into the new payments processing system. The purpose of this role is to ensure a seamless migration of our clients into the new system with zero or minimal changes at client’s end. This position will support the roll out of the new application across APAC. This role will liaise between clients and the bank’s team across multiple countries.

We are looking for self-driven, fast-learner, flexible and customer-oriented professionals who can drive migration activities and be main point of contact for clients. This is a great opportunity for someone who may be looking to into a role that specializes in payments and treasury management as part of their next career phase.

What you will do

* Manage migration activities of multiple clients across multiple regions simultaneously ensuring a seamless migration from planning, testing, GO LIVE and post GO LIVE
* Coordinate with multiple internal and external teams ensuring that issues and concerns arising from migration are addressed in a timely manner
* Educate and counsel clients on the migration-related activities and manage their expectations
* Perform application setups, submit request for transmission channel, ensure end to end testing is conducted, obtain required client signoffs, stage move to production, and ensure initial live files are processed successfully.
* Conduct migration-related trainings and new application features to clients either virtually or in person
* Coordinate migration activities across multiple workstreams including Sales, Fulfilment, Technical Team, Operations, Vendor, Data Transmission, and Product Management resources.
* Provide accurate and timely updates to both internal and external stakeholders

title: Product Sales Operations Manager - Satellite Connectivity & Terminal Solutions
description:
Extend Networks (X10)
  
  
delivers next-generation satellite network infrastructure and intelligent user terminal solutions across multi-orbit constellations (GEO, MEO, and LEO). We are pioneering the concept of a fully integrated satellite and cellular based Network-as-a-Service infrastructure solution. This ground-breaking model was developed to meet the demanding business and mission critical needs. As part of our APAC expansion, we are looking for someone who thrives on breaking new ground and is ready to own our product and sales operations cycles across the region.
  
  
ROLE SUMMARY
  
  
We are seeking a technically grounded Product/Sales Operations Manager specializing in satellite networks and user terminals. Serving as the critical bridge between product engineering, sales team and customers, you will shape solution designs of end-to-end terminal-to-teleport architectures, keep product and project documentation accurate, build compelling vertical use cases, and translate customer operational needs into scalable product roadmaps.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
Network & Terminal Solution Design (Pre/Post-Sales)
  
  

* End-to-End Architecture Design: Architect tailored satellite connectivity solutions spanning user terminals, RF subsystems, satellite modems/routers, and ground hubs.
* RFx & Technical Proposals: Lead technical responses to RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, producing detailed system diagrams, bill-of-materials (BoM) pricing, and commercial packaging (CapEx, OpEx, and Hardware-as-a-Service models).
* PoCs & Field Trials: Scope, coordinate, and evaluate customer proof-of-concept (PoC) deployments, over-the-air (OTA) terminal demonstrations, and factory acceptance tests (FAT).

Product Documentation & Vertical Use Cases
  
  

* Technical Product Documentation: Author, maintain, and standardize customer-facing product documentation, including terminal datasheets, network architecture whitepapers, SLAs, installation/commissioning guides, and release notes.
* Use Case Development: Define, validate, and document vertical-specific operational use cases (e.g., maritime fleet digitalization, cellular backhaul, emergency response, and multi-orbit primary/backup failover) to demonstrate clear business value and ROI.
* Sales Enablement Collateral: Create reusable pre-sales toolkits, solution blueprints, reference designs, competitive battle cards, and technical presentation decks for internal sales teams and global channel partners.

Project Administration
  
  

* Customer Interface: Lead customer project implementation. Deliver full lifecycle and driving seamless onboarding and issues resolution. Support project managers and delivery teams with scheduling, milestone tracking, risk and issue logs, and status reporting.
* Manage purchase orders, vendor and supplier coordination, shipping and logistics, and customs or export documentation where relevant.
* Oversee contract administration: order forms, change requests, renewals, and acceptance signoffs.
* Tracking: project budgets, invoicing milestones, and handover to operations and support.

Product Lifecycle & Ecosystem Management
  
  

* Product Design Support: Design and perform sustainable end-to-end network sizing to support scalable product deployments and long-term capacity growth
* Voice-of-Customer (VoC) & Roadmap Input: Capture market feedback on terminal requirements, tracking performance, and network management features to feedback into product roadmaps.
* Multi-Orbit & SD-WAN Integration: Define requirements for multi-orbit handover logic (GEO/MEO/LEO), WAN bonding, SD-WAN orchestration, QoS traffic shaping, and cloud-based NMS.
* Compliance & Type Approvals: Collaborate with regulators, engineering team, and satellite operators to ensure terminal certifications, type approvals, and export compliance.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS
  
  
Preferred Experience & Skills
  
  

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical/RF Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent industry experience).
* Industry Background: 7+ years of experience in product management, pre-sales solutions architecture, or systems engineering within satellite communications, VSAT, or wireless telecom.
* Terminal & Modem Expertise: Hands-on familiarity with satellite terminal hardware (stabilized maritime antennas, land-mobile/COTM, flat-panel ESAs) and hub/modem platforms (e.g., ST Engineering iDirect, Hughes, Gilat, Comtech).
* Networking & RF Fundamentals: Solid understanding of RF link budgets, DVB-S2X/TDMA waveforms, IP networking, and terminal control protocols.
* Documentation & Storytelling: Proven track record of writing clear technical documentation, solution briefs, and commercial use cases tailored to both C-level buyers and network engineers.
* Technical Writing Tools & Network sizing: Proficiency in diagramming and documentation tools alongside link budget modeling software.
* Commercial Acumen: Experience structuring managed service SLAs, airtime/terminal bundles, and total cost of ownership (TCO) models.

This candidate should be comfortable communicating both verbally in teams and our triage calls along with being able to provide written communication when needed, this is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong L2 support experience who is looking to grow their technical expertise.

This DevOps role sits at the intersection of development, operations, and support for the CAS Erica for Employees platform, which runs on Amelia SoundHound. * Create and maintain approved counterparty, issuer, instrument, security, settlement-instruction, calendar, portfolio, product and other reference-data records in Murex, TSDS and relevant platforms.

* Review requests for completeness, validity and required approvals before processing, and clarify incomplete or ambiguous instructions with requestors.

* Perform maker or checker activities in accordance with segregation-of-duties requirements and maintain clear before-and-after evidence.

* Apply data standards, naming conventions, mapping rules and effective dates consistently across systems and entities.

* Monitor static-data requests and exception queues, prioritize time-critical requests, and meet agreed service levels and operational cut-offs.

* Investigate data issues and downstream breaks, perform root-cause analysis, coordinate remediation and prevent recurrence.

* Maintain controlled repositories for validated settlement instructions and supporting records, and ensure changes are traceable and auditable.

* Support periodic control activities such as dormant-record reviews, access reviews, data-quality checks, reconciliations and procedure reviews.

* Assess static-data implications for new products, new entities, system changes and projects; participate in requirements gathering, testing and implementation.

* Work with Global Markets, Operations, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Technology and external data providers to resolve data dependencies and control gaps.

* Identify opportunities to automate data sourcing, validation, enrichment, publication, monitoring and exception handling.

* Maintain current procedures and reference guides; support training, cross-skilling, business continuity and knowledge transfer.

* Comply with Bank policies, data-governance standards, operational risk requirements and applicable regulatory obligations.

  

**Skills and Experience**
=========================

* Degree or equivalent professional qualification preferred.

* Good knowledge of Treasury products such as securities, derivatives, foreign exchange and money markets.

* Good understanding of front-to-back trade processing and the related operational risks and controls.

* Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with sound judgement and accountability.

* Able to prioritize effectively and work accurately in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment.

* Improvement-oriented mindset with an interest in automation, data quality and operational efficiency.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; familiarity with Murex, SWIFT or other Treasury platforms is advantageous.

* Experience in static data, reference data, instrument or counterparty setup, settlement instructions, or Treasury systems is advantageous.

* High level of attention to detail and an understanding of how data changes affect trade processing, accounting, settlement and reporting.

  

**Working Requirements**
========================

* The role may require support outside standard business hours, including selected public holidays or weekends, based on product and market coverage.

* Location is in Tampines.

  

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* Accurate and timely completion of assigned activities within agreed service levels and cut-off times.

* Prompt identification, escalation and resolution of exceptions, with clear audit trails.

* Consistent adherence to maker-checker controls, procedures, operational risk standards and regulatory requirements.

* Constructive collaboration across teams and active contribution to process improvement, automation and team capability building.

**What we offer:**
==================

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

title: Bid Estimator (Pre-sales/Tender/ Proposal - Electronic Security)
description:
Reports to Group Bid Manager
  
  
About The Role
  
  
As a Bid Estimator at AVTEL, you will be at the forefront of our project bidding process, playing a crucial role in securing high-value and complex bids. This position is integral to our operations, ensuring that we maintain our competitive edge in the marketplace through meticulous pricing and take-offs for a diverse range of projects.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Site Surveys:** Conduct comprehensive site surveys to gather detailed information and expand client briefs, enabling the creation of accurate and compelling bids.
  
  
**Process Management:** Develop and implement standardized processes to efficiently manage a high volume of bids, ensuring consistency and quality in every proposal.
  
  
**Supplier Communication:** Engage with suppliers and sub-contractors across Europe, Asia, and the US to negotiate the best pricing and terms, fostering strong relationships that benefit AVTEL.
  
  
**Bid Coordination:** Lead and participate in group-wide bid processes, collaborating closely with the lead salesperson and other team members to establish key priorities and drive successful outcomes.
  
  
**Detailed Take-Offs:** Perform precise take-offs and measurements for all aspects of security projects, ensuring that every bid inquiry is met with a thorough and effective response.
  
  
**Sales Meetings:** Actively participate in sales meetings to set priorities, provide insights, and assist team members in maintaining momentum throughout the bid process.
  
  
**Global Collaboration:** Work closely with other AVTEL Group entities in Asia to create bids for global customers, leveraging our international presence to deliver exceptional solutions.
  
  
Who we are looking for
  
  
We are seeking a dynamic and hands-on professional with a strong background in bid estimation, technical design, or pre-sales—ideally within the security, construction, or ICT sectors. The ideal candidate will have three to five years of relevant experience with a proven ability to manage complex, multi-regional bids. A solid understanding of system integration design and pricing is essential, along with excellent organizational, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
Skills & Experience Required
  
  
Three to five years of proven experience in bid estimation, technical design, or pre-sales roles in electronic security, construction, ICT, or related industries.
  
  
**Bid Management:**  Demonstrated ability to of putting together large, complex and multi-disciplinary bids.
  
  
**Technical Expertise:** Strong technical understanding of design solutions and pricing in a systems integration context. Knowledge of Integrated Electronic Security Systems like CCTVs, Alarm Systems, etc
  
  
**Lenel Access Control:** A strong knowledge of Lenel hardware and software configurations.
  
  
**CCTV:** knowledge of both IP and Analogue CCTV systems including the use of network video recorders and software.
  
  
**Integrated Systems:** Experience with major integrated Access Control/CCTV/Intruder systems/Perimeter detection systems that are fully integrated.
  
  
**Intruder Alarms:** Basic competency in measurement and pricing intruder alarms.
  
  
**Service:** You will have a good working knowledge of service in the security industry and shall be able to price various service solutions.
  
  
Working knowledge of pricing jobs in the international market especially EMEA and APAC regions.
  
  
**Organizational Skills:** Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
  
  
**Technical Proficiency:** Proficient in Microsoft Office 365 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams), SharePoint, and bid portals.
  
  
**Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills, capable of engaging with stakeholders at all levels.
  
  
**ERP/CRM Systems:** Experience with NetSuite or similar ERP/CRM systems is desirable.
  
  
**Team Collaboration:** Ability to work independently and as part of a global, cross-functional team.
  
  
Key Attributes
  
  
Results-oriented and commercially aware.
  
  
Critical thinker with excellent attention to detail.
  
  
Proactive and solution focused.
  
  
Comfortable working across time zones and diverse cultures.
  
  
Work Arrangements
  
  
Fully office-based at our Ubi office, Singapore.
  
  
At AVTEL (https://www.avtelglobal.com/), we keep our customers safe through our security integration & project consulting services. Our focus is delivering high quality solutions through innovative, cost-effective systems, outstanding customer support & project delivery by our dedicated project teams. The people we employ are our future; constantly learning and improving, they lead our business to its successes.
  
  
If you are looking to make an impact in the electronic security industry, collaborate with talented & committed global team members & embrace a future focused on our AVTEL core values (
  
  
https://avtelglobal.com/our-values
  
  
); integrity, commitment, caring, courage, excellence & environmental sustainability — apply now!

title: Senior Service Desk Technician (Networking), APAC
description:
The Senior Service Desk Technician (Networking), APAC is responsible for hands-on desktop support, help desk ticket resolution, and first line (Tier 1) network troubleshooting for all local end users. This role combines traditional help desk and desktop support duties with basic network support (Wi-Fi, switches, cabling, connectivity) and other hands-on site needs such as AV/meeting room setup and new-hire equipment provisioning.

The person in this role must be comfortable working independently, exercising good judgment on when to escalate, and coordinating with Analogic's central Infrastructure, Network/Firewall, and Cybersecurity Operations teams for issues beyond Tier 1 scope.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for all IT help desk requests at the site, including hardware, software, and account/access issues.
* Provide first line (Tier 1) network troubleshooting for common issues such as Wi-Fi connectivity, basic switch/port problems, and printer network drops; escalate more complex network issues to the Network/Firewall Manager.
* Perform new-hire IT provisioning (accounts, laptop setup) and departure processing (equipment return, access removal) following company onboarding/offboarding procedures and the access-deprovisioning standard set by Cybersecurity.
* Remote support of EMEA based SES sites via phone or remote desktop tools.
* Track IT asset/equipment inventory and software licenses for the site using the company's ITSM platform (Freshservice).
* Provide hands-on support for AV/video conferencing equipment, mobile devices, and meeting room technology as needed.
* Monitor and respond to antivirus/endpoint alerts escalated by the central Cybersecurity Operations team, coordinating remediation at the local level as directed.
* Monitor tickets in the help desk queue; prioritize and complete work to meet or exceed response and resolution targets.
* Follow defined policies and procedures to manage workflow, including escalation of tickets per Analogic's IT escalation matrix (Infrastructure, Network/Firewall, Cybersecurity Operations, or Enterprise Applications, depending on issue type).
* Maintain basic technical documentation for site-specific configurations and equipment.
* Develop and maintain the technical knowledge needed to successfully support the site's user base and evolving technology needs.
* Collaborate closely and stay aligned with Analogic's corporate Help Desk team on ticket handling, tools, and standards, functioning as an extension of that team rather than an isolated site resource

**Education, Work Experience, Skills and Competencies Requirements:**

* Demonstrated hands-on experience providing help desk and desktop support in a business environment, with the ability to independently troubleshoot common hardware, software, access, and basic network connectivity issues
* CompTIA A+ and Network+ (or equivalent), or working toward, strongly preferred given the combined support and network scope of this role.
* Working experience of Windows desktop environments, Active Directory, and Microsoft 365 (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams).
* Basic understanding of networking concepts (Wi-Fi, switches, VPN, general troubleshooting).
* Strong communication and collaboration skills are essential; this role must stay closely aligned with the corporate Help Desk team and broader IT organization despite working at a distance from them day to day.
* Ability to work independent, with strong judgment on when to escalate to central teams.
* Energetic, customer-service oriented with a positive attitude.
* Demonstrated ability to develop efficient, effective, and innovative solutions.
* Excellent listening, verbal, written communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Team player with interpersonal and negotiation skills and the ability to influence others, despite working at a distance from the broader IT team.
* Ability to engage, learn, and support new technologies.

**Working Conditions:**

* Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
* The person in this position needs to occasionally move about the office, including data/network closets.
* Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer.
* The ability to communicate accurate information and ideas so others will understand.
* The ability to observe details at close range (within a few feet of the observer).
* May occasionally need to lift or move IT equipment (laptops, monitors, networking equipment).

title: Demand Generation Manager, Startups, APAC
description:
**About Stripe**  
  
  
  
  
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.  
  
  
  
**About the team**  
  
  
  
  
APAC Demand Generation is a team of marketers and channel specialists that builds strategies to engage prospects and customers, generate demand for Stripe's prioritized solutions, and contribute measurable business impact. The team partners closely with global and regional Campaigns, Product Marketing, Field Marketing, Performance Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Sales Development, Sales, and Marketing Operations. Its work spans APAC markets, customer segments, and stages of the customer lifecycle.  
  
  
  
**What you'll do**  
  
  
  
  
Stripe works with startups from their earliest days through global scale. The APAC startup ecosystem is diverse and fast-moving, with founders building for multiple markets, adopting new business models, and making foundational financial-infrastructure decisions earlier than ever.  
  
  
  
  
  
The Demand Generation Manager, Startups, APAC will be the day-to-day demand generation lead for the Startup segment in the region. This person will translate global Startup priorities into an integrated APAC plan, build regionally relevant programs, and independently lead cross-functional execution across channels and markets. The role will connect regional market insight with global strategy and use data to improve how Stripe reaches, engages, and converts startups across their growth journey.  
  
  
  
  
  
This role reports to the APAC Platforms and Startups Demand Generation lead.  
  
  
  
  
  
**Responsibilities**

  
* Develop and execute an integrated, multi-channel demand generation plan for startups across APAC, aligned with regional business priorities and global Startup strategy.
  
  
* Translate global campaigns into relevant regional programs, identifying where messaging, audience strategy, content, channel mix, or execution should be adapted for APAC markets.
  
  
* Lead cross-channel programs spanning paid media, lifecycle and email, content distribution, online and in-person events, field marketing, partner and ecosystem channels, and Sales Development follow-up.
  
  
* Own the day-to-day performance of the APAC Startup campaign portfolio, using funnel and campaign data to identify opportunities, diagnose gaps, recommend changes, and improve results.
  
  
* Partner with regional Sales and Sales Development teams to align priorities, strengthen lead follow-up, and connect marketing activity to pipeline and activation outcomes.
  
  
* Build strong working relationships with global Campaigns, Startup Marketing, Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Field Marketing, Startup Partnerships, and Marketing Operations.
  
  
* Represent APAC market needs and customer insights in global planning, and share regional results, learnings, and repeatable practices with global and regional partners.
  
  
* Develop programs that engage founders and startup decision-makers at different stages, from company formation and early product adoption through expansion and global growth.
  
  
* Work with campaign operations and instrumentation partners to establish clear measurement plans, maintain campaign hygiene, and ensure programs can be evaluated accurately.
  
  
* Independently manage multiple complex, cross-functional workstreams, setting clear goals, timelines, responsibilities, and dependencies while proactively resolving risks and blockers.
  
  
* Design and run experiments that improve audience engagement, conversion, channel effectiveness, and program scalability.
  
  

  
**Who you are**  
  
  
  
  
The successful candidate is an experienced demand generation marketer who combines strategic thinking with strong execution. This person is comfortable operating independently, leading through influence, and bringing structure to ambiguous problems. They understand how to build integrated programs across markets and channels and can turn performance data and customer insight into clear action.  
  
  
  
  
  
**Minimum requirements**  
  
  
  

  
* 8+ year experience developing and executing B2B demand generation, growth marketing, or integrated marketing programs in the technology industry.
  
  
* Experience owning multi-channel campaigns across multiple APAC markets, with a record of delivering measurable funnel, pipeline, activation, or revenue-related outcomes.
  
  
* Strong understanding of digital demand channels, including paid media, lifecycle and email marketing, content, online events, and lead management.
  
  
* Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex cross-functional programs, manage multiple workstreams, and anticipate and resolve execution risks.
  
  
* Strong analytical skills and experience defining KPIs, interpreting campaign and funnel performance, and translating findings into recommendations.
  
  
* Experience partnering closely with Sales and Sales Development teams on planning, execution, lead follow-up, and performance improvement.
  
  
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to align stakeholders across functions, markets, and levels of seniority.
  
  
* Strong judgment, curiosity, and a bias toward action in a fast-moving and evolving environment.
  
  

  
  
  
**Preferred qualifications**  
  
  
  

  
* Experience marketing to startups, founders, developers, or fast-growing technology companies.
  
  
* Familiarity with the APAC startup ecosystem, including accelerators, venture capital firms, technology communities, or other founder channels.
  
  
* Experience in payments, financial technology, SaaS, financial infrastructure, or an adjacent industry.
  
  
* Experience regionalizing global campaigns and balancing global consistency with meaningful local-market adaptation.
  
  
* Knowledge of account-based marketing, partner marketing, marketing automation, experimentation, and performance optimization.
  
  
* Experience working in a highly matrixed global organization.
